items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出一种残差学习框架，用以减轻训练比以往更深网络的难度。我们把网络层显式地重构为学习相对于层输入的残差函数，而不是学习没有参照的映射。我们给出充分的实验证据，表明残差网络更容易优化，并且能够从大幅增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 上，我们评估了深达 152 层的残差网络，它比 VGG 深 8 倍，但复杂度更低；将这些残差网络集成后，在 ImageNet 测试集上取得 3.57% 的误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名。我们还分析了 CIFAR-10 上 100 层与 1000 层的网络。表征的深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要；仅凭极深的表征，我们就在 COCO 目标检测数据集上获得 28% 的相对提升。深度残差网络是我们参加 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，我们也在 ImageNet 检测、ImageNet 定位、COCO 检测和 COCO 分割任务上获得第一名。
items.highlight_zh: 残差学习让 152 层网络更易训练，并夺得 ILSVRC 2015 分类冠军。
items.digest_zh: ① 研究的问题：神经网络越深表达能力越强，但深层网络很难训练，简单堆叠层数会出现退化，训练误差反而上升。② 方法：作者把若干层原本要学的映射 H(x) 改写为残差 F(x)=H(x)−x，让这些层只学「相对输入的修正量」，再加一条恒等捷径把输入的 x 加回去。这样不增加参数、不增加计算量，梯度可沿捷径直接回传，优化更容易。③ 结果：在 ImageNet 上训练了深达 152 层的残差网络，比 VGG 深 8 倍，但复杂度更低；集成后在测试集上错误率 3.57%，获 ILSVRC 2015 分类第一；在 CIFAR-10 上还尝试了 100 层与 1000 层；把深层特征用于 COCO 目标检测，取得 28% 的相对提升，并在 ImageNet 检测/定位、COCO 检测/分割上均列第一。④ 为何重要：它证明了深度本身是视觉识别的关键，并给出一种可推广、能稳定训练极深网络的结构，此后成为大量视觉模型的基础骨干。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 进行高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机理上理解其功能。经过巨大的实验努力，约 10 万种蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只占已知数十亿条序列的一小部分；测定单个结构往往需要数月到数年的艰苦工作。要填补这一空白并实现大规模结构生物信息学，需要准确的计算方法。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将采取的三维结构，即「蛋白质折叠问题」中的结构预测部分，50 多年来一直是重要的开放问题。尽管已有进展，现有方法仍远未达到原子精度，尤其是在没有同源结构可用时。本文提出首个能经常以原子精度预测蛋白质结构的计算方法，即使在没有已知相似结构的情况下也是如此。我们在具有挑战性的第 14 届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）中验证了完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold，多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法。最新版 AlphaFold 的核心是一种新颖的机器学习方法，它把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物学知识（利用多序列比对）纳入深度学习算法的设计中。
items.highlight_zh: 首次实现不依赖同源结构的近原子精度蛋白质结构预测。
items.digest_zh: ① 问题：蛋白质功能由其三维结构决定，但实验测定（冷冻电镜、X 射线晶体学等）一个结构往往要数月到数年，目前只有约 10 万种蛋白有结构，而已知序列有数十亿条，覆盖严重不足。仅凭氨基酸序列算出结构的「蛋白质折叠问题」已提出 50 多年，此前方法在缺少相似结构参考时，精度远达不到原子级。② 方法：作者彻底重新设计了神经网络模型 AlphaFold，把关于蛋白质的物理与生物先验知识——尤其是多序列比对（MSA）中蕴含的进化共变信息——融入深度学习算法的结构设计，并用 CASP14 盲测来检验（参赛者看不到答案）。③ 结果：在 CASP14 中，AlphaFold 多数目标的预测精度可与实验测定的结构相媲美，并显著优于其他参赛方法，是首个在无同源结构时仍能稳定给出原子级精度的方法。④ 为何重要：它把结构预测从「少数情况可用」推进到「普遍可用」，有望大幅加速结构生物学与药物研发，使大规模结构生物信息学成为现实。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：先用深度学习设计一组协同工作的被动衍射层，之后该架构便能学会实现多种功能。我们通过 3D 打印的 D2NN 实验验证了这一框架的成功：在太赫兹波段学会实现手写数字分类和成像透镜功能。借助现有的丰富 3D 打印与其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这一全光深度学习框架能以光速执行计算机神经网络所能实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中获得应用，同时催生能够借助 D2NN 学习完成独特任务的新型相机设计与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用 3D 打印的被动衍射层实现以光速运行的全光神经网络。
items.digest_zh: ① 问题：主流神经网络依靠电子芯片计算，速度与能耗受限。能否让光在传播过程中直接完成神经网络的计算？② 方法：作者提出衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）：把若干片被动衍射层叠在一起，每层对通过的光波做相位调制（相当于网络的一层权重），光波逐层衍射传播，在输出面形成结果。各层的相位分布由计算机用深度学习（误差反向传播）离线设计好，器件制造完成后无需供电与运算，光穿过即完成推理。③ 结果：团队用 3D 打印制作了太赫兹波段的器件，实验上实现了手写数字分类和「成像透镜」两种功能，验证了该框架可行。④ 为何重要：它把计算搬到光域，原理上能以光速、低功耗并行处理；配合成熟的 3D 打印、光刻与空间光调制器，可用于全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，并催生能「学习」特定任务的新型相机与光学元件。需注意其能力来自离线设计好的固定层，属于特定任务的光学处理器。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种非常有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍一个可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，数据科学家广泛使用它在众多机器学习挑战中取得最先进的结果。我们提出一种新的稀疏感知算法用于处理稀疏数据，并提出加权分位数草图用于近似树学习。更重要的是，我们给出关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，以构建可扩展的树提升系统。结合这些洞见，XGBoost 能用远少于现有系统的资源，扩展到数十亿样本以上。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知与缓存优化让 XGBoost 以极少资源扩展到数十亿样本。
items.digest_zh: ① 问题：梯度提升树在表格类数据上效果极好、应用广泛，但当数据规模达到数十亿样本、特征又很稀疏时，如何构建一个既快又省资源的端到端训练系统是一大工程难题。② 方法：XGBoost 提出稀疏感知的切分查找算法，能自动处理缺失值与稀疏数据；提出加权分位数草图，用近似方式高效地为连续特征寻找分裂点；并从系统层面给出关键洞见——按特征预排序、以块结构提高缓存命中率，通过数据压缩与分片支持大数据与分布式计算，以及在建树时并行计算。③ 结果：结合这些设计，XGBoost 能用远少于当时已有系统的计算资源扩展到数十亿样本以上，并在众多机器学习竞赛与任务中取得当时最优的结果。④ 为何重要：它把统计建模思路与系统级优化结合起来，成为数据科学中最常用的工具之一；文中关于缓存、压缩与近似分位数的方法，对后来大规模机器学习系统的设计也有广泛影响。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：面向语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 通过在所有层中以左右两侧上下文为联合条件，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需额外增加一个输出层进行微调，就能在问答、语言推断等大量任务上构建最先进的模型，而无需对任务特定架构做大幅修改。BERT 在概念上简单，在实证上强大，在 11 项自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 得分提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 提升至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 提升至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练加单层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务成绩
items.digest_zh: 一、研究了什么问题：此前的语言表示模型大多只能单向（从左到右）读句子，或只在浅层做双向融合，无法在每一层同时利用上下文两侧的信息；而且每做一个下游任务往往要重新设计网络结构。论文希望用一个通用的预训练模型解决多类语言理解任务。二、用了什么方法：BERT 以 Transformer 编码器为骨架，在大量无标注文本上做预训练，让模型在每一层都能同时“看到”一个词左右两边的上下文，从而学到深度双向表示。预训练完成后，迁移到具体任务时只需在顶层加一个简单的输出层再做微调，不必改动主体架构。三、有什么结果：在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新最好成绩，包括 GLUE 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点）、MultiNLI 86.7%、SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 93.2、SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 83.1。四、为何重要：它确立了“大规模预训练+轻量微调”的范式，让同一个模型可以低成本迁移到问答、推断、分类等多种任务，成为后续自然语言处理模型的通用模板，也说明简单的设计配合大规模数据可以带来显著效果。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

reference_review.reason_zh: 单目、双目、RGB-D 与视觉惯性多地图 SLAM 的原始工作及作者代码，适合定位基线复现。
reference_review.limitations_zh: 需要正确的相机/IMU标定与时间同步；弱纹理、动态遮挡与实时算力需实测，GPL许可及其他商用条款需核对。

recommendation.reason_zh: 单目、双目、RGB-D 与视觉惯性多地图 SLAM 的原始工作及作者代码，适合定位基线复现。 截至 2026-11-13，Crossref 索引记录 4552 次引用，可作长期文献线索。

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能用单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机，并支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型，同时完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个主要创新是紧密耦合的基于特征的视觉惯性 SLAM 系统，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，因而能在室内外大中小场景中实时鲁棒运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个主要创新是多地图系统，它依赖一种召回率更高的新型位置识别方法。当视觉信息长期匮乏而跟丢时，系统会新建地图，并在重访已建图区域时与旧地图无缝合并。与只使用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 是首个在所有算法阶段复用全部历史信息的系统，可将时间上相隔很远或来自先前建图会话的共视关键帧纳入 bundle adjustment，提供大视差观测以提升精度。实验显示，在各传感器配置下其鲁棒性与文献最佳系统相当且显著更准；双目惯性 SLAM 在 EuRoC 无人机上平均精度 3.6 cm，TUM-VI 快速手持运动下达 9 mm。源代码已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的开源系统
items.digest_zh: 一、研究了什么问题：机器人和 AR/VR 设备需要一边移动一边实时推算自身位置并构建环境地图（SLAM）。过去的系统要么只支持某一种相机，要么跟丢后必须从头重建，无法把历史信息用起来。论文要做一个通用、鲁棒且高精度的开源系统。二、用了什么方法：ORB-SLAM3 以 ORB 特征为基础，把相机与惯性测量单元（IMU）的信息紧密耦合，全程用最大后验（MAP）估计求解，连 IMU 初始化阶段也如此。它还引入召回率更高的位置识别方法，支持“多地图”：跟丢时新建地图，回到旧区域时自动合并。一个关键设计是让所有算法阶段都能复用全部历史关键帧，即使这些关键帧时间相隔很远，也能参与 bundle adjustment 提供大视差约束。三、有什么结果：在多种相机配置下鲁棒性堪比当时最好的系统，精度显著更高，比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍；双目惯性版本在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均精度 3.6 cm，在 TUM-VI 的快速手持运动场景下达到 9 mm。四、为何重要：它把视觉、视觉惯性和多地图能力统一到一个开源库里，支持针孔与鱼眼镜头，并证明长期保存和复用历史信息能切实提高精度，为后续研究与工程应用提供了通用基线。

items.title_en: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: Spool：面向混合视觉语言模型的低延迟流式推理
items.abstract_en: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉辅助智能体、机器人等应用需要在有限的过去帧窗口（如最近两分钟）内及时回答关于近期视频的问题。混合视觉语言模型（VLM）将注意力层与 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）等线性循环层交错，适合这类场景，但维护滑动窗口代价高昂：循环层把所有历史帧压缩进一个共享状态，淘汰旧帧通常需要重跑整个窗口。作者观察到循环层的状态更新对状态是仿射的、系数由输入决定，因此每帧的影响可表示为一个可按结合律复合的变换。据此提出免训练框架 Spool：缓存逐帧状态变换，并随窗口推进高效复合，从而在不重放帧的情况下从各循环层状态中移除过期帧。
items.highlight_zh: 免训练缓存帧级状态变换，首字延迟降低约6.6倍
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：视频问答类应用（视觉无障碍助手、机器人）需要在一个有界的近端时间窗口内快速作答。混合 VLM（注意力 + GDN 等线性循环层）很适合这种流式场景，但一旦要“滑动窗口”就麻烦了：循环层把全部历史帧压成一个共享状态，想丢掉最老的帧，常规做法是把整个窗口重新喂一遍模型，延迟极高。
• 用了什么方法：作者发现循环层的状态更新是仿射变换，系数由输入决定，于是每一帧对状态的贡献可以写成一个变换，而这些变换可以按结合律复合。Spool 免训练地缓存每帧的变换，窗口前进时快速复合变换，并用逆操作把过期帧从状态中精确剔除，不必重放主干；为了让缓存的入队、复合开销够低，作者还设计了专用数据结构与 GPU kernel。
• 有什么结果：在 5 个开源混合 VLM 与 4 个视频推理基准共 20 组测试中，Spool 的 p95 首字延迟全部最低，相比两个 vLLM 基线中较快者，几何平均加速 6.6 倍，同时准确率平均提升 2.3 个百分点。
• 为何重要：无需重训模型、无需改动架构，就能让长视频流式推理又快又准。作者也如实说明边界：层内移除是精确的，但如同注意力中的 KV 淘汰，过期帧仍可能通过前层已缓存的输入留下残余影响。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Generation of protein conformations using a simple inverted transformer
items.title_zh: 用简单的倒置 Transformer 生成蛋白质构象
items.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics is an extremely powerful approach for studying protein behavior, but it requires enormous computational resources to obtain an adequate sampling of possible conformations. Recently, thanks to successes in predicting three-dimensional protein structures, there has been an explosion of research exploring the opportunities offered by deep learning to address the problem of protein conformational landscape. In this work, an artificial intelligence system based on a variant of the Transformer architecture is introduced and applied to the problem of determining the ensemble of three-dimensional structures that a protein can access and their statistical weight. After being trained on a dataset of conformations of a particular protein obtained using classical all-atom molecular dynamics, this neural network is able to directly generate physically plausible protein conformations similar to those obtained both through molecular dynamics and experimentally. The ordered sequence of conformations obtained as output of the neural network rapidly converges towards the most populated regions of the protein's conformational landscape, suggesting that the system may have learned not only the protein's three-dimensional organization but also the thermodynamic weights of the various feasible conformations. These features, combined with its simplicity and low computational load, make this Transformer variant an ideal candidate for the development of systems capable of performing generative molecular dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 分子动力学是研究蛋白质行为的强大手段，但要充分采样可能的构象需要巨大的计算资源。近年来三维结构预测的成功，激发了用深度学习探索蛋白质构象景观的研究热潮。本文提出一种基于 Transformer 架构变体的人工智能系统，用于确定蛋白质可访问的三维结构集合及其统计权重。在由经典全原子分子动力学获得的某种蛋白质构象数据集上训练后，该网络能够直接生成与分子动力学模拟及实验所得相似、物理上合理的蛋白质构象。网络输出的有序构象序列会快速收敛到构象景观中布居最多的区域，提示该系统不仅学到了蛋白质的三维组织方式，也学到了各种可行构象的热力学权重。这些特点结合其简洁性与低计算负荷，使其成为发展“生成式分子动力学”的理想候选。
items.highlight_zh: 倒置 Transformer 直接生成蛋白质构象并隐含学到热力学权重
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究什么问题：蛋白质不是一块固定形状，它会摆动、折叠出成千上万种构象；分子动力学（MD）能模拟这些构象，但要采得足够全面极其烧算力。作者想知道：深度学习能否绕开昂贵采样，直接“生成”蛋白质会出现的三维结构及其出现概率。
2) 用了什么方法：构造一种 Transformer 的变体（倒置结构），在某个特定蛋白质的全原子经典 MD 构象数据集上训练。训练目标是让它学会该蛋白质构象集合的分布，从而能一次性输出一整套构象而非单个结构。
3) 有什么结果：网络生成的构象与 MD 模拟结果、实验数据都相似，且物理上合理；更重要的是，它输出的构象序列会自然地向构象景观中“人口最密集”的区域收敛——这意味着模型不仅记住了三维长什么样，还隐含学到了各构象的热力学权重（即相对稳定性）。
4) 为何重要：方法结构简单、计算开销低，却兼具生成结构与统计权重的能力，为“生成式分子动力学”这一方向提供了可行原型：将来或可把昂贵的采样替换为快速的神经网络生成，用于药物设计、变构与折叠研究中快速估计构象系综。需要说明的是，目前结果基于单一蛋白质的数据集训练，泛化性仍有待验证。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Laser Processing for Energy Applications
items.title_zh: 面向能源应用的激光加工技术
items.abstract_en: Laser processing has emerged as a transformative technology in the energy sector, enabling precise, efficient, and scalable solutions for energy generation, storage, and sustainability. This chapter explores the diverse applications of laser technology in energy applications. It begins with an overview of laser-driven inertial confinement fusion for energy production, highlighting key experimental facilities and crucial laser parameters. The role of lasers in solar energy harvesting is examined, including photovoltaic cell optimization, concentrated solar power, and laser-assisted recycling of solar modules. The chapter further reviews recent developments into laser-based techniques for enhancing electrochemical performance through surface texturing at various scales. Advancements in lithium-ion battery technology are also discussed, focusing on next-generation materials, battery manufacturing processes, and the impact of laser techniques on performance, safety, and scalability. The chapter concludes with insights into future prospects for laser applications in sustainable energy solutions.
items.abstract_zh: 激光加工已成为能源领域的变革性技术，能够为能源生产、存储与可持续性提供精确、高效且可规模化的解决方案。本章系统探讨激光技术在能源中的应用：首先概述用于能源生产的激光驱动惯性约束聚变，介绍关键实验装置与核心激光参数；随后考察激光在太阳能利用中的作用，包括光伏电池优化、聚光太阳能发电以及太阳能组件的激光辅助回收；进一步回顾利用激光在不同尺度上进行表面织构化以提升电化学性能的最新进展；并讨论锂离子电池技术进展，聚焦下一代材料、电池制造工艺以及激光技术对性能、安全性和可扩展性的影响。最后展望激光在可持续能源方案中的应用前景。
items.highlight_zh: 综述激光加工在聚变、光伏与电池等能源领域的应用与前景。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：这是一篇综述性章节，回答“激光加工能在能源领域做什么”。作者把能源链条拆成生产、存储与可持续性三块，逐一梳理激光的角色——从激光驱动惯性约束聚变产能，到光伏电池优化、聚光太阳能与报废光伏组件的激光回收，再到锂电池的材料、制造与性能提升。
2）用了什么方法：作为综述，它不提出新实验，而是归纳代表性实验装置、关键激光参数（如能量、脉宽、聚焦条件）与工艺路线，并比较不同尺度的表面织构化对电化学性能的影响，同时串联电池制造流程中可插入激光工序的环节。
3）有什么结果：文章给出的是一张“技术地图”而非单一数据结论：激光在聚变点火实验中是关键驱动手段；在光伏环节可提升电池效率并支持组件回收；在电池环节，激光织构与加工能改善性能、安全性和可规模化程度。
4）为何重要：能源器件对精度、效率与量产成本同时敏感，激光正好兼具非接触、高精度和易自动化的特点。对不熟悉该领域的读者，这篇综述的价值在于快速建立“哪种能源问题可以用哪类激光工艺解决”的整体认知，并指出未来可持续能源方向的研发空间。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
items.title_zh: 结果均衡 PPO（Outcome-Balanced PPO）与策略诱导流矫正：面向基于流的 VLA 策略
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）可通过与环境交互优化期望任务回报，对基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行后训练，但带来两个挑战：策略更新会改变随机转移所用得分近似所依赖的速度场几何结构；稀疏的多任务 rollout 会让不同任务、不同优势符号之间的学习信号不均衡。作者提出一个 RL 框架，结合结果均衡 PPO 与策略诱导流矫正。前者利用任务成功率估计给正优势重加权，并在保持符号的前提下重新缩放正负优势；后者周期性用当前策略产生的 ODE 端点对拟合线性桥流，刷新后续随机优化所用的表示。作者在仿真操作基准上评估，并在 Real2Sim2Real 任务中研究组件组合，考察任务表现、优化行为与流一致性。该框架在仿真基准上成功率优于所评估的基线。
items.highlight_zh: 成功率重加权优势＋周期矫正流几何，提升 VLA 后训练成功率
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：基于流匹配（flow matching）的 VLA 策略可以用强化学习做后训练，靠与环境交互来最大化任务回报。但这会踩两个坑：一是策略一更新，底层速度场就变了，而随机采样转移所依赖的得分近似是按旧速度场做的，近似会失准；二是多任务、稀疏奖励的 rollout 让信号极不均衡——简单任务老是成功、难任务老是失败，正负优势的尺度也失衡。
• 用了什么方法：两条腿。其一是“结果均衡 PPO”：用任务成功率估计给正优势重加权，并对正、负优势分别重新缩放但保留符号，让各任务、各符号的信号更均衡；其二是“策略诱导流矫正”：定期把当前策略生成的 ODE 端点对拟合成一个线性桥流，刷新用于后续随机优化的表示，使采样与新的速度场保持一致。
• 有什么结果：在仿真操作基准上，该方法相比所评估的基线提升了成功率；作者另外在 Real2Sim2Real 任务上做了组件组合研究，考察任务表现、优化行为与流的一致性，以理解各模块的贡献。
• 为何重要：它把“流策略在 RL 训练中的表示漂移”当成一等公民来处理，而不是视而不见，为基于流的 VLA 后训练提供了可复用的稳定化思路，兼顾了信号均衡与采样正确性。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
items.title_zh: 藏文 OCR 的音节级与词级评测
items.abstract_en: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
items.abstract_zh: 藏文光学字符识别（OCR）目前主要用字符错误率（CER）评估。藏文标记音节边界但不标记词边界，因此计算词错误率需要分词器。本研究在排版、木刻版和两种手写体风格（单独及组合）上评测九种识别器配置，并报告音节级与词级错误率，据我们所知这在藏文 OCR 中尚属首次。配置涵盖 CTC 模型、带与不带训练后量化的 TrOCR 编码器-解码器以及一个视觉-语言模型，每种配置均以 CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词词错误率（SWER）评分。CER 的系统排序与更高层级错误率大体一致（Kendall τ≥0.833），仅有一对顺序相反。关于联合训练的影响，64 组比较中有 7 组 CER 与 SER 出现符号相反的显著变化。SER 无需分词器，且在三种分词器中的两种下与 SWER 排序一致（τ≥0.889）。各配置输出还被做词性标注、命名实体标注与机器翻译，并与参考文本结果比较。粗略而言，SER 降至 0.047 及以下时翻译 chrF 可达 60，SER 0.078 及以下时词性保持率达 0.8，而没有错误率能区分达到 0.6 实体保持率的系统。
items.highlight_zh: 首次为藏文 OCR 报告音节级与词级错误率及下游影响。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：藏文 OCR 通常只报字符错误率（CER），但字符错一个可能整段意思都变。藏文书写中音节有明确边界、词却没有边界，所以要算“词错误率”必须先分词，而分词本身又可能引入误差。作者想知道：换用音节级、词级指标，系统排名会不会变？这些指标和真实下游任务的表现又是什么关系？
2）用了什么方法：在排版印刷、木刻版以及两种手写体风格上（单独和混合）测试九种识别器配置，覆盖 CTC 模型、TrOCR 编码器-解码器（含与不含训练后量化）以及一个视觉-语言模型。每个系统同时算 CER、音节错误率 SER 和基于三种分词器的词错误率 SWER；再把识别文本送去词性标注、命名实体识别和机器翻译，与参考文本上的结果对照。
3）有什么结果：总体上 CER 与更高层级指标的排序高度一致（τ≥0.833），只有一对系统顺序相反；联合训练带来的变化在少数比较中出现 CER 与 SER 方向相反的显著差异，说明只看 CER 可能误判。SER 不需要分词器，却在多数情况下与 SWER 排序一致，是性价比很高的替代指标。下游方面，SER 低于约 0.047 时翻译质量（chrF）可达 60，低于约 0.078 时词性保持率达 0.8。
4）为何重要：它给藏文这类“有音节无词界”的文字提供了更贴合语言特性的评测方案，也提醒研究者和使用者：选指标时要考虑下游任务真正在意什么。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
items.title_zh: ResWAM：学习变化而非不变内容的世界-动作模型
items.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $π_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAM）为视觉-语言-动作策略（VLA）加入未来预测，使策略能预判自身动作将如何影响物理世界。现有 WAM 监督完整的未来观测，但一个动作块内观测往往变化很小，未来损失被复制静态背景所主导，而非学习任务相关的机器人与物体运动，限制了策略学习；同时它们依赖大型视频生成模型或独立世界模型，训练与推理算力沉重，妨碍闭环部署。作者提出视觉残差学习：在冻结的 DINOv3 特征空间中只监督从当前帧到未来帧的特征变化。该残差目标的特征秩更高、对场景变化的表征更丰富多样，且空间上集中于机械臂与被操作物体而非背景。作者进一步提出 ResWAM：总参数 2.3B，含一个 0.5B 的轻量双分支 DiT，通过条件流匹配联合训练动作分支与残差分支。在没有机器人预训练的情况下，ResWAM 在 LIBERO-Plus（81.1%）、RoboTwin 2.0（93.8%）与 RoboDojo（成功率 9.40%、得分 13.41）上取得最高平均成功率，且训练（2.7–4.0 TFLOPs）与推理（1.0–1.4 TFLOPs）算力最低；在真机 Open、Put、Stack 任务上以 92.7 ms 延迟取得 80.0% 平均成功率，比 π0.5 高 10.0 个百分点。
items.highlight_zh: 只预测未来特征残差，2.3B 模型以最低算力刷新多基准
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：世界-动作模型想让机器人“先预判再行动”，做法是让策略额外预测未来的观测画面。但直接监督整帧未来图像时，一个动作块内画面其实变化很小，大部分像素是不动的背景，损失被“抄背景”主导，真正有用的机械臂与物体运动信号被淹没。此外，很多方法靠大视频生成模型或单独的世界模型，算力开销大，难以做闭环控制。
• 用了什么方法：把监督目标从“完整未来特征”换成“未来特征减去当前特征”的残差，并且放在冻结的 DINOv3 特征空间里算。作者分析，这种残差目标特征秩更高、能更丰富地表达场景变化，空间上也集中在机械臂和被操作物体上。模型 ResWAM 共 2.3B 参数，其中只有一个 0.5B 的双分支 DiT，用条件流匹配同时训练动作分支与残差分支。
• 有什么结果：在不使用外部机器人轨迹预训练的情况下，LIBERO-Plus 达 81.1%、RoboTwin 2.0 达 93.8%、RoboDojo 达 9.40% 成功率（13.41 分），平均成功率最高，同时训练与推理算力最低；真机 Open、Put、Stack 平均 80.0%，比 π0.5 高 10 个百分点，延迟仅 92.7 ms。
• 为何重要：说明“学变化、不学背景”既是更干净的监督信号，也是省算力的路径，两者在这里并不冲突，反而互相成全。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
items.title_zh: 从人类注视中学习视觉接地推理
items.abstract_en: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.
items.abstract_zh: 人类视觉推理依赖系统性地探索并提取任务相关的视觉证据。人类注视为这一过程提供了窗口，因此可作为视觉-语言模型（VLM）中视觉接地推理的引导来源。但人类注视也包含噪声与冗余，迁移到 VLM 时可能效果不佳。本文收集了 7,109 次人类注视试验，覆盖多样且具挑战性的视觉推理任务，并用不同形式的注视引导训练接地推理模型。在图表理解、视觉搜索与计数任务的评估中发现：把人类注视作为接地推理的先验，始终优于用完整注视序列做监督。据此作者提出 GGR（Gaze-Guided Reasoner），在准确率匹配或超过领先接地推理基线的情况下，实现了更好的人类对齐与更可靠的视觉接地。强化学习虽不使用任何注视监督，仍可进一步提升任务准确率、注视对齐度与接地质量。行为分析显示，接受注视监督的模型在给出答案前会进行更多视觉探索。结果表明，人类注视的价值在于引导空间探索、塑造推理行为，而无需完全模仿人类行为。
items.highlight_zh: 把人类注视当先验而非模仿目标，提升 VLM 接地推理
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么问题：VLM 做视觉推理时常“看着图说瞎话”，缺少对关键证据的定位，即接地（grounding）不足。人类靠有目的的扫视寻找证据，眼动数据天然记录了这种探索过程；但人类注视里也有噪声、重复和因人而异的冗余，直接让模型模仿整条注视轨迹，可能把无用信息一并学走。
• 用了什么方法：作者采集了 7,109 次人类注视试验，任务多样且有挑战性（如图表理解、视觉搜索、计数），然后以不同形式的注视引导来训练接地推理模型，对比“把注视当作空间先验”与“监督完整的注视序列”两种做法。基于结论提出 GGR（Gaze-Guided Reasoner）。
• 有什么结果：三个任务域上，注视先验一致优于对完整注视序列的监督。GGR 在准确率上与领先的接地推理基线持平或更好，同时人类对齐更强、视觉接地更可靠；即使完全不给注视监督，用强化学习也能进一步提升准确率、注视对齐度与接地质量。行为分析发现，受注视监督的模型在得出答案前会做更多视觉探索。
• 为何重要：它给出一个反直觉但实用的结论——人类数据的价值不在于让模型“像人一样看”，而在于教它“先看该看的地方”，这为利用人类行为数据训练可解释、可对齐的视觉推理模型提供了新范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: ST-FateFlow: Continuous Gene-Spatial Reconstruction with Differentiation-Potential Learning from Time-Resolved Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: ST-FateFlow：从时间分辨空间转录组学中进行分化潜能学习的连续基因-空间重建
items.abstract_en: Time-resolved spatial transcriptomics provides a powerful view of dynamic biological processes by measuring cellular states together with their spatial organization across time. However, destructive profiling and experimental cost restrict observations to a few discrete time points collected from independent samples, with no known cell pairing across time. This makes it difficult to reconstruct gene expression and tissue organization at unobserved stages and to characterize differentiation-associated dynamics. Here, we introduce ST-FateFlow, a flow-matching framework for continuous gene-spatial dynamics and differentiation-potential learning. ST-FateFlow jointly learns gene-expression and spatial-coordinate velocity fields, enabling interpolation of missing time points and continuous modeling of transcriptional evolution and tissue remodeling. In parallel, it independently learns a time-conditioned differentiation potential, whose values organize cell states along inferred differentiation progressions and support the analysis of differentiation-associated transcriptional changes. Across multiple time-resolved spatial transcriptomics datasets, ST-FateFlow effectively captures coordinated gene-expression and spatial dynamics. Case studies further show that the learned potential landscapes are consistent with known developmental and regenerative trajectories and help identify candidate genes associated with differentiation progression.
items.abstract_zh: 时间分辨空间转录组学通过测量细胞状态及其跨时间的空间组织，为动态生物过程提供了强大的视角。然而，破坏性分析和实验成本将观测限制在从独立样本收集的少数离散时间点，且跨时间没有已知的细胞配对。这使得难以重建未观测阶段的基因表达和组织结构，也难以表征与分化相关的动态。在此，我们提出 ST-FateFlow，一个用于连续基因-空间动态和分化潜能学习的流匹配框架。ST-FateFlow 联合学习基因表达和空间坐标速度场，能够插值缺失时间点，并连续建模转录演化和组织重塑。同时，它独立学习一个时间条件的分化潜能，其值沿着推断的分化进程组织细胞状态，并支持分析与分化相关的转录变化。在多个时间分辨空间转录组学数据集上，ST-FateFlow 有效捕捉了协调的基因表达和空间动态。案例研究进一步表明，学习到的潜能景观与已知的发育和再生轨迹一致，并有助于识别与分化进展相关的候选基因。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Scaling laws in machine learning on non-ideal experimental data enable inverse design of radiative-cooling coatings
items.title_zh: 非理想实验数据上的机器学习标度律助力辐射致冷涂层逆向设计
items.abstract_en: Materials informatics increasingly targets multicomponent materials, yet experimental datasets inevitably contain non-ideal variations arising from imperfect uniformity and reproducibility in composition, coating formation, and measurement. Whether machine-learning prediction accuracy scales with amount of data under these conditions remains unclear. Here, we develop an automated platform that produced and optically characterized 11,520 radiative-cooling coatings spanning nine material and processing parameters. Forward and inverse neural networks, and a spectrum-conditioned diffusion model were trained on subsets of 10 to 10,000 samples. All models exhibited power-law scaling, with prediction errors decreasing with dataset size. Experimental inverse-design validation showed that larger datasets produced spectra closer to a broadband-emitter target. The diffusion model generated multiple candidate parameter sets, allowing selection among alternative solutions based on ease of fabrication, cost, and scalability. These results demonstrate predictable learning-curve scaling in non-ideal experimental data and provide a quantitative basis for estimating the benefit of additional experimental data, and thus the cost-effectiveness of materials-informatics.
items.abstract_zh: 材料信息学日益面向多组分材料，但实验数据集不可避免地包含非理想变异——来自成分、成膜与测量中的不均匀性和重复性不足。在这些条件下，机器学习预测精度是否随数据量增长而提升仍不清楚。作者搭建自动化平台，制备并光学表征了覆盖九个材料与工艺参数的 11,520 种辐射致冷涂层，并在 10 至 10,000 个样本的子集上训练正向/逆向神经网络以及一个光谱条件扩散模型。所有模型都表现出幂律标度行为，预测误差随数据集增大而下降。实验逆向设计验证显示，数据集越大，所得光谱越接近宽带发射目标。扩散模型可生成多组候选参数，从而依据制备难易、成本和可扩展性在替代方案中择优。这些结果证明了非理想实验数据中可预测的学习曲线标度行为，并为估算额外实验数据的收益、进而评估材料信息学的成本效益提供了定量基础。
items.highlight_zh: 万余涂层实验证明：非理想数据下误差仍按幂律随数据量下降
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究什么问题：材料信息学常用机器学习指导新材料设计，但真实实验数据从来不“干净”——成分不均、成膜不一致、测量有噪声。学界常用“数据越多模型越好”的经验，但在这种非理想数据下，精度是否仍按可预测规律提升？如果不成立，砸钱多做实验就可能不划算。
2) 用了什么方法：搭一个自动化平台，自动制备并光学表征 11,520 种辐射致冷涂层，覆盖九个材料与工艺参数；再用 10 到 10,000 个样本的不同规模子集，训练正向预测网络、逆向设计网络，以及一个以光谱为条件的扩散生成模型，系统考察数据量与精度的关系。
3) 有什么结果：三类模型都呈幂律标度（learning curve），误差随数据量增大而稳定下降，即使在非理想实验数据上也是如此；真实合成验证表明，用大数据集逆向设计出的涂层，其光谱更接近目标宽带发射谱。扩散模型还能一次给出多组候选配方，让研究者按制备难度、成本、可放大性来挑选。
4) 为何重要：这给出了“多做多少实验能换来多少精度”的定量曲线，可用来估算继续做实验的边际收益与性价比，从而把材料信息学从凭经验押注变成可预算的决策；同时说明生成模型在多解材料设计中的实用价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Eyes in the Update? Learning Where Rewards Land in Multimodal Reasoning
items.title_zh: 更新中的眼睛？学习奖励在多模态推理中的落点
items.abstract_en: Multimodal post-training has moved from broad instruction tuning toward reinforcement learning for image and video reasoning, where outcome rewards can improve final-answer accuracy. Yet these rewards are assigned to complete generated trajectories, while visual evidence is used only at sparse and uneven positions inside the response. Recent work has begun to make multimodal RL more token-sensitive through grounding signals or external token-level weighting. We ask a more specific question: can the allocation of the same trajectory-level reward be inferred from the model's own multimodal computation, rather than from an auxiliary annotator, perception module, or process label? We propose Gaze-RL, a representation-driven policy optimization method that redistributes completion-level advantage through a latent reward landing field. The field is computed from internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty, assigning larger update weight to positions that are both visually anchored and decision-bearing while remaining mean-one, so the total credit of each rollout is preserved and only its positionwise allocation changes. Gaze-RL requires no process supervision, auxiliary perception module, or architectural modification, and improves both Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 across a broad range of image and video benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态后训练已从广泛的指令调优转向面向图像和视频推理的强化学习，其中结果奖励可以提高最终答案准确率。然而，这些奖励被分配给完整的生成轨迹，而视觉证据仅在响应内部稀疏且不均衡的位置被使用。近期工作已开始通过依据信号或外部 token 级加权，使多模态 RL 更加 token 敏感。我们提出一个更具体的问题：相同轨迹级奖励的分配能否从模型自身的多模态计算中推断出来，而不是来自辅助标注器、感知模块或过程标签？我们提出 Gaze-RL，一种表示驱动的策略优化方法，它通过潜在奖励落点场重新分配完成级优势。该场由内部跨模态几何和局部预测不确定性计算，将更大的更新权重分配给既视觉锚定又承载决策的位置，同时保持均值为一，因此每次 rollout 的总信用得以保留，仅其逐位置分配发生变化。Gaze-RL 不需要过程监督、辅助感知模块或架构修改，并在广泛的图像和视频基准上改进了 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3.5。

items.title_en: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.title_zh: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏智能体的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Gamer，一个为复杂交互环境中的长时程任务构建的通用智能体框架。其端到端架构结合了感知、记忆管理和多步推理。共享的训练与部署流水线支持与常规 2D 图形界面和复杂 3D 模拟世界进行交互。我们首先在由数万小时设备级键盘和鼠标交互构建的数据集上进行继续预训练。这些轨迹覆盖模拟游戏和具身环境，使模型能够学习跨物理与虚拟域的环境动力学。随后，稀疏思考指令微调大幅减少冗余计算，同时保留复杂决策所需的推理。我们使用一种稳定的多轮强化学习方法训练长时程交互策略，该方法应对有限上下文窗口、累积的 rollout 误差和稀疏奖励。为支持实时交互，一个云边推理引擎可同时服务大量模拟游戏环境，支持无界上下文执行，并保持较低的在线推理延迟。在多个具有挑战性的 3D 开放世界游戏中，Gamer 展现出与熟练玩家相当的稳定泛化能力和运行效率。它在一系列常规 2D 游戏基准上也取得了有竞争力的结果。这些结果表明，即使是重复的键盘和鼠标轨迹，也能通过扩展数据规模和学习算法带来显著收益。在这些轨迹上训练有助于 Gamer 在同时具有物理和数字属性的环境中更稳定地学习复杂技能。该方法为能够在数字世界和物理世界中进行交互的通用智能体提供了一条路径。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出FAST-LIO2：一个快速、稳健且通用的LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。FAST-LIO2建立在高效紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波器之上，具有两项关键创新，使其能够实现快速、稳健且准确的LiDAR导航（与建图）。第一项是直接将原始点配准到地图（并随后更新地图，即建图），而无需提取特征。这能够利用环境中的细微特征，从而提高精度。消除手工设计的特征提取模块也使其自然适应具有不同扫描模式的新兴LiDAR；第二项主要创新是通过增量式k-d树数据结构ikd-Tree维护地图，该结构支持增量更新（即点插入、删除）和动态再平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d树）相比，ikd-Tree在实现更优整体性能的同时，天然支持在树上进行降采样。我们在来自多种公开LiDAR数据集的19个序列上进行了详尽的基准比较。与其他最先进的LiDAR-惯性导航系统相比，FAST-LIO2以低得多的计算负载持续实现更高精度。我们还开展了针对小视场固态LiDAR的各种真实世界实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2计算高效（例如，在大型室外环境中实现高达100 Hz的里程计与建图）、稳健（例如，在旋转高达1000 deg/s的杂乱室内环境中实现可靠位姿估计）、通用（即适用于多线旋转式和固态LiDAR、无人机和手持平台，以及Intel和ARM处理器），同时仍比现有方法取得更高精度。我们的系统实现FAST-LIO2和数据结构ikd-Tree均已在Github上开源。

items.title_en: GameRealm: Grounding Visual Learning in Interactive Games
items.title_zh: GameRealm：将视觉学习扎根于交互式游戏
items.abstract_en: Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale, richly annotated dataset that grounds visual observations in synchronized, game-native supervision. GameRealm encompasses over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay footage across all views. Beyond its unprecedented scale, GameRealm provides rich multimodal supervision, including metric depth, camera parameters, synchronized audio, control inputs, and 3D point trajectories. Its diversity further extends to flexible view configurations, spanning single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic recordings. To enable scalable acquisition across diverse game environments, we develop a unified data collection pipeline that combines human-operated interaction with agentic exploration. Extensive experiments across diverse visual learning tasks demonstrate that GameRealm consistently strengthens visual foundation models in both visual generation and geometric learning. These results establish GameRealm as a versatile and valuable data resource, unlocking new opportunities for advancing visual intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉基础模型是物理智能的核心，但其发展仍受制于碎片化的训练数据集、不一致的标注质量以及有限的多模态监督。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 GameRealm，一个大规模、标注丰富的数据集，它将视觉观测建立在同步的、游戏原生的监督之上。GameRealm 包含超过 1.2 亿 RGB 帧和覆盖所有视角的 1000 小时游戏画面。除前所未有的规模外，GameRealm 还提供丰富的多模态监督，包括度量深度、相机参数、同步音频、控制输入和 3D 点轨迹。其多样性还扩展到灵活的视角配置，涵盖单视图、立体、多视图和全景录制。为实现跨多样游戏环境的可扩展采集，我们开发了一个统一的数据采集流水线，将人工操作交互与智能体探索相结合。跨多种视觉学习任务的大量实验表明，GameRealm 在视觉生成和几何学习中均能持续增强视觉基础模型。这些结果确立了 GameRealm 作为一种多功能且有价值的数据资源，为推进视觉智能开辟了新机会。

items.title_en: Discovery of new antiviral agents through artificial intelligence: in vitro and in vivo results
items.title_zh: 通过人工智能发现新型抗病毒药物：体外和体内结果
items.abstract_en: In this research, we employed a deep reinforcement learning (RL)-based molecule design platform to generate a diverse set of compounds targeting the neuraminidase (NA) of influenza A and B viruses. A total of 60291 compounds were generated, of which 86.5% displayed superior physicochemical properties compared to oseltamivir. After narrowing down the selection through computational filters, nine compounds with non-sialic acid-like structures were selected for in vitro experiments. We identified two compounds, DS-22-inf-009 and DS-22-inf-021 that effectively inhibited the NAs of both influenza A and B viruses (IAV and IBV), including H275Y mutant strains at low micromolar concentrations. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed a similar pattern of interaction with amino acid residues as oseltamivir. In cell-based assays, DS-22-inf-009 and DS-22-inf-021 inhibited IAV and IBV in a dose-dependent manner with EC50 values ranging from 0.29 uM to 2.31 uM. Furthermore, animal experiments showed that both DS-22-inf-009 and DS-22-inf-021 exerted antiviral activity in mice, conferring 65% and 85% protection from IAV (H1N1 pdm09), and 65% and 100% protection from IBV (Yamagata lineage), respectively. Thus, these findings demonstrate the potential of RL to generate compounds with promising antiviral properties.
items.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们采用基于深度强化学习（RL）的分子设计平台，生成了一组多样化的化合物，靶向甲型和乙型流感病毒的神经氨酸酶（NA）。共生成 60291 种化合物，其中 86.5% 的理化性质优于奥司他韦。通过计算过滤缩小选择范围后，选出九种具有非唾液酸样结构的化合物进行体外实验。我们鉴定出两种化合物 DS-22-inf-009 和 DS-22-inf-021，它们在低微摩尔浓度下有效抑制甲型和乙型流感病毒（IAV 和 IBV）的 NA，包括 H275Y 突变株。分子动力学模拟显示，其与氨基酸残基的相互作用模式与奥司他韦相似。在细胞实验中，DS-22-inf-009 和 DS-22-inf-021 以剂量依赖方式抑制 IAV 和 IBV，EC50 值为 0.29 μM 至 2.31 μM。此外，动物实验表明，DS-22-inf-009 和 DS-22-inf-021 均在小鼠中发挥抗病毒活性，分别对 IAV（H1N1 pdm09）提供 65% 和 85% 的保护，对 IBV（Yamagata 系）提供 65% 和 100% 的保护。因此，这些发现证明了 RL 在生成具有有前景抗病毒特性的化合物方面的潜力。

items.title_en: Quantum differential interference contrast microscope
items.title_zh: 量子微分干涉对比显微镜
items.abstract_en: Optical sensing and imaging of transparent unstained biological and material specimen makes use of optical interference to translate phase shifts into intensity measurements, that are readily available in the optical domain. This is the case of Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) microscopes. However, environmental disturbances such as acoustic vibrations, air currents, temperature shifts, and mechanical drifts cause random phase noise that degrades the precision attainable in the estimation of the unknown phase shift. Although there are tools to compensate for these random phase drifts, such using common path interference techniques or phase stabilization systems, these are not always an option and its introduction is generally at the expense of device simplicity and robustness. Here we introduce a quantum version of Differential Interference Contrast microscopy (qDIC), that makes use of quantum interference for polarization analysis. When compared with standard schemes that make use of coherent light, our approach shows that the transfer of classical DIC microscopy into the quantum domain offers a route towards quantum-enhanced resilience to environmental disturbances, allowing the enhancement of phase sensitivity without sacrificing the simplicity and robustness of the optical setup.
items.abstract_zh: 对透明未染色生物和材料样本的光学传感与成像利用光学干涉，将相移转换为光学域中易于获取的强度测量。微分干涉对比（DIC）显微镜就是这种情况。然而，声振动、气流、温度变化和机械漂移等环境扰动会引起随机相位噪声，从而降低估计未知相移时可达到的精度。尽管已有工具可补偿这些随机相位漂移，例如使用共路干涉技术或相位稳定系统，但这些并非总是可选方案，且其引入通常以牺牲设备的简单性和鲁棒性为代价。在此，我们提出量子版本的微分干涉对比显微镜（qDIC），其利用量子干涉进行偏振分析。与使用相干光的标准方案相比，我们的方法表明，将经典 DIC 显微镜转移到量子领域，为实现量子增强的环境扰动鲁棒性提供了一条途径，从而在不牺牲光学装置简单性和鲁棒性的情况下增强相位灵敏度。

items.title_en: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言融合的缩放定律
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. We derive a scaling law that unifiedly describes these dynamics, enabling accurate loss predictions across mixture ratios, training steps, and model sizes. Crucially, our law characterizes the trade-off between early and late fusion: under a fixed data budget, early fusion preserves text performance while late fusion favors vision performance, yielding a trade-off that increasingly tilts toward early fusion as model size scales. Extensive experiments confirm that our scaling law reliably captures multimodal learning dynamics and governs fusion decisions.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已成为将多模态感知与文本理解相结合的核心基础模型。传统上，VLM 通过在多模态（图像-文本）数据上继续预训练现成语言模型来实现晚期融合，而自预训练开始就混合模态（早期融合）的方法近年来受到关注。然而，这些范式之间的基本权衡仍未被充分理解，导致训练配方昂贵且由启发式驱动。本文系统分析了这些多模态预训练过程的学习动力学，表明视觉-语言融合过程中的验证损失可以通过将基础学习轨迹（不同数据类型以不同速率贡献）与由模态间竞争驱动的分布偏移分离来建模。我们推导出一个统一描述这些动力学的缩放定律，能够在不同混合比例、训练步数和模型规模下实现准确的损失预测。关键在于，我们的定律刻画了早期融合与晚期融合之间的权衡：在固定数据预算下，早期融合保持文本性能，而晚期融合有利于视觉性能，随着模型规模扩大，这种权衡日益偏向早期融合。大量实验证实，我们的缩放定律可靠地捕捉多模态学习动力学，并支配融合决策。

items.title_en: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
items.title_zh: 自然语言编程：重新思考生成式 AI 时代的语言、记忆与认知
items.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows. This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures. Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence. Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.
items.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正在改变自然语言在计算系统中的作用。在经典自然语言处理（NLP）中，语言被视为计算的对象：可供分析、分类、翻译或生成的事物。大语言模型（LLM）挑战了这一观点，使自然语言日益成为一种可执行的认知媒介，人类通过它来组织推理、编排问题求解并调控人机混合工作流。本文提出自然语言编程（NLPg），作为传统 NLP 的理论与认识论延伸。NLPg 不局限于语言理解，而是将提示概念化为动态认知人工物，将目标、约束、假设、验证标准和中间推理状态外化。因此，提示不仅是一种技术交互手段，而是在分布式人类/AI 记忆架构中运行的一种对话式认知编程形式。基于分布式认知、延展心智、元认知和对话学习理论，本文提出对话工作记忆的概念，描述提示和对话状态如何作为临时外部记忆结构，支持推理连续性和反思性调控。我们进一步将现有记忆架构（BTMA、SKGE、RMR）映射到该框架中，说明情景、语义和元认知层如何支持长时程对话连贯性。最后，讨论了其对计算语言学和 AI 中介知识系统的启示，提出一种后符号与后界面范式，其中自然语言同时作为交流媒介、可执行规范、认知支架和分布式记忆架构发挥作用。

items.title_en: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
items.title_zh: ForceHarness：将力转化为动作与物理，用于冻结的前沿模型
items.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿多模态模型现已能够从图像零样本控制机器人，然而许多操作任务依赖于图像无法显示的接触力。将力引入仅通过 API 访问的冻结模型带来两个挑战。第一，接触的演化速度远快于 API 模型做出决策的速度，因此系统必须在模型之下对力闭环。第二，冻结模型无法解读原始力流，因此力必须以模型能够推理的形式返回。因此，我们提出 ForceHarness，一种让冻结模型无需演示或微调即可使用力的 harness。在仅凭腕部传感器或关节扭矩校准手部力之后，ForceHarness 通过自终止力原语应对第一个挑战，这些原语自行调节力并在接触事件时返回。为应对第二个挑战，一个物理翻译层将每条力轨迹转化为带有不确定性的物理量，作为工具结果。为了在相同条件下将 ForceHarness 与专家力控制器和学习策略进行比较，我们还构建了 HiddenPhys，一个具有隐藏物理变量的七任务 MuJoCo 基准。在没有腕部力传感器的真实机械臂上，ForceHarness 将 GPT-6 Astra 的零样本成功率从 3.3% 提升至 90.0%。在仿真中，它在公开的 ForceBench 套件上增加 17.5 个百分点，在 HiddenPhys 上增加 34.3 个百分点，在两个基准上均超过在演示上训练的力感知策略，并在 HiddenPhys 上匹配手写专家控制器。消融进一步表明，当给定物理量而非原始力值时，更小的模型会做出显著更好的决策。

items.title_en: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.title_zh: M3OPD-Reasoner：一种使用多教师同策略蒸馏进行多模态推理后训练的开源配方
items.abstract_en: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.
items.abstract_zh: 多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）使单个学生模型能够通过从自己生成的回答中学习，吸收多个领域教师的技能。我们提出多模态模型多教师同策略蒸馏推理器（M3OPD-Reasoner），一个完全开源的配方，用于在三个推理领域对视觉语言模型（VLM）进行后训练：图像 STEM、图像感知和视频。我们整理了两个数据集：用于监督微调（SFT）的 M3OPD-SFT-1.35M，以及用于带可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）的 M3OPD-RL-193K。在这些数据上，我们比较了从 Qwen3.5-9B 开始的后训练配方：在所有领域的混合数据上训练一个模型（MixSFT 和 MixRL），以及为每个领域训练一个教师，使用组序列策略优化（GSPO），直接训练或在 SFT 预热之后训练，并用 MOPD 将教师蒸馏到一个学生中。我们在对训练数据进行去污染后，在 21 个图像 STEM、图像感知和视频推理基准上评估。比较结果确立：直接从 Qwen3.5-9B 使用 GSPO 训练的教师进行 MOPD 是最佳配方：学生在其各自领域上紧密匹配每个教师，并在相同提示上平均高于混合训练基线。由于 MOPD 已经合并了 MixRL 否则必须学习的领域能力，其学生是 RL 更强的起点，我们追问相同数据能否让模型从那里走得更远：我们在 MOPD 学生之上加入 MixRL，使用相同提示和相同设置，据我们所知，此前没有 VLM 配方研究过这一点。相同提示仍然改善 MOPD 学生，且没有崩溃，并得到我们的主模型 M3OPD-Reasoner-9B。因此，MOPD 和 MixRL 可以作为连续阶段，从相同数据中获得更多收益。我们发布所有数据、训练代码以及每个阶段的检查点。

items.title_en: Why do continual physical learners need sleep?
items.title_zh: 为什么持续学习的物理学习者需要睡眠？
items.abstract_en: Sleep is widespread across the animal kingdom, including in organisms without a centralized nervous system. Does learning create a need for sleep, even without biology? To explore this question, we study a disordered spring network trained to perform a sequence of mechanical allosteric tasks through local changes in bond stiffness. We find that continual learning progressively reduces the network's ability to acquire new tasks as individual bonds become increasingly specialized. We identify an exact algebraic relationship between the polarization of bond dominance and the network's remaining learning capacity, providing a quantitative measure of this loss of adaptability. We then demonstrate that random internal perturbations allow individual bonds to estimate their mechanical dominance and locally adjust their stiffnesses to restore learning capacity. However, the forces associated with active learning bias these local measurements and interfere with restoration. Separating learning and repair into wake-like and sleep-like phases removes this interference and improves continual-learning performance. Our results suggest that the need for offline restorative phases can emerge from the mechanics of physical learning, even in systems without biological components.
items.abstract_zh: 睡眠在动物界广泛存在，包括没有集中神经系统的生物。学习是否会在没有生物学的情况下也产生对睡眠的需求？为探讨这个问题，我们研究一个无序弹簧网络，该网络通过局部改变键刚度来执行一系列机械变构任务。我们发现，随着单个键变得越来越专门化，持续学习会逐步降低网络获取新任务的能力。我们确定了键主导极化与网络剩余学习能力之间的精确代数关系，为这种适应性损失提供了定量度量。然后我们证明，随机内部扰动允许单个键估计其机械主导性并局部调整其刚度，以恢复学习能力。然而，与主动学习相关的力会使这些局部测量产生偏差并干扰恢复。将学习和修复分离为类清醒和类睡眠阶段可消除这种干扰并提高持续学习性能。我们的结果表明，对离线恢复阶段的需求可以从物理学习的力学中涌现，即使在没有生物组件的系统中也是如此。

items.title_en: Targeted material doping to enable the formation and coherent propagation of Laser Induced Periodic Surface Structures (LIPSS): the ZnO paradigm
items.title_zh: 定向材料掺杂以实现激光诱导周期性表面结构（LIPSS）的形成与相干传播：ZnO 范式
items.abstract_en: This work explores how the initial free carrier density governs the formation and coherent propagation of Low Spatial Frequency Laser-Induced Periodic Surface Structures (LSF-LIPSS). As a paradigm we have analyzed the behavior of ad-hoc-doped ZnO films. ZnO is a multifunctional Transparent Conducting Oxide (TCO) with many scientific and technologic uses including applications in biomedicine, photonics, sensing or photocatalysis. Many of them would benefit from the use of large area, electrically anisotropic surfaces. By introducing small amounts of Yb3+ as donor dopant in ZnO films grown by Pulse Laser Deposition (PLD), we have substantially improved its carrier density at room temperature (RT) and its electrical conductivity while preserving the functional properties of pure ZnO. For RT carrier densities ne > 1019 cm-3, coherent propagation of LSF-LIPSS has been successfully achieved upon irradiation with 350 fs laser pulses at 1030 nm at high repetition rate (500 kHz) and for laser scanning speeds well above 1 m/s. However, the ablation mechanism (ZnO sublimation at the LIPSS valleys) and the large melting temperature of ZnO, make the thermal conductivity of the substrate, the film thickness and the irradiation pulse duration to play a crucial role in determining the morphology of the LSF-LIPPS propagated over large areas, especially in avoiding film cracking. The results achieved upon optimization fully confirm the role of free carrier density in the large-scale propagation of high quality LSF-LIPSS in doped ZnO and enable using these structures to easily generate large electrical anisotropies over macroscopic regions with conductivities along the LIPSS several times larger than transversally.
items.abstract_zh: 这项工作探讨初始自由载流子密度如何主导低空间频率激光诱导周期性表面结构（LSF-LIPSS）的形成与相干传播。作为范式，我们分析了定制掺杂的 ZnO 薄膜的行为。ZnO 是一种多功能透明导电氧化物（TCO），在生物医学、光子学、传感或光催化等许多科学和技术应用中具有广泛用途。其中许多应用将受益于使用大面积、电各向异性的表面。通过在以脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长的 ZnO 薄膜中引入少量 Yb3+ 作为施主掺杂剂，我们显著提高了其室温（RT）载流子密度和电导率，同时保持纯 ZnO 的功能特性。对于 RT 载流子密度 ne > 10^19 cm^-3，在使用 1030 nm、350 fs 激光脉冲、高重复频率（500 kHz）且激光扫描速度远高于 1 m/s 的辐照下，已成功实现 LSF-LIPSS 的相干传播。然而，烧蚀机制（LIPSS 谷处 ZnO 升华）和 ZnO 的高熔化温度，使得衬底热导率、薄膜厚度和辐照脉冲持续时间在决定大面积传播的 LSF-LIPSS 形貌方面发挥关键作用，尤其是在避免薄膜开裂方面。优化后取得的结果充分证实了自由载流子密度在掺杂 ZnO 中高质量 LSF-LIPSS 大规模传播中的作用，并使这些结构能够轻松地在宏观区域上产生大电各向异性，沿 LIPSS 方向的电导率比横向高出数倍。

items.title_en: Regularized Score Centering
items.title_zh: 正则化得分中心化
items.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.
items.abstract_zh: 异步强化学习提高了训练吞吐量，但来自过期策略的数据以及训练与推理之间的数值不匹配可能使学习不稳定。为稳定离策略学习，得分中心化（SC）消除了奖励基线对期望更新的影响。我们的梯度诊断显示，与重要性采样（IS）相比，SC 的梯度更不极端，但当学习器远离生成数据的行为策略时，SC 仍可能失败。为限制这种策略不匹配，我们引入正则化得分中心化（RSC），它添加反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚，以鼓励学习器的下一 token 分布保持接近行为策略的下一 token 分布。RSC 在有或没有截断重要性采样（TIS）的情况下都有效，TIS 会限制 token 重要性权重。我们的理论分析支持这种方法，表明 KL 正则化改善了收敛保证。我们在数学推理和智能体任务上评估稠密模型和专家混合模型，包括在线购物、工具使用、游戏和完全异步软件工程。带 TIS 的 RSC 在所有智能体基准上大幅提高样本效率，在相同采样回答数量下获得更高训练奖励。在最终评估中，它在所有六个智能体任务上取得最佳性能，在 AppWorld 上提高 14.3%，在 BabyAI 上达到最强基线得分的 9.9 倍。

items.title_en: Visibility Graph Representations of Word Embeddings for Text Classification
items.title_zh: 用于文本分类的词嵌入可见图表示
items.abstract_en: Text classifiers depend on representations that expose the distinctions between classes in a form the learning model can use, and a restricted vocabulary changes which representation is most effective. This paper studies natural visibility graphs as an intermediate representation for news topic classification under controlled vocabulary budgets. Word embeddings are averaged into a fixed-length document vector, the vector is read as an ordered numerical series, and its natural visibility graph is passed to a classifier either as an ordered node-degree vector or as an adjacency matrix. On the four-class AG News benchmark, chi-square selection retains 100 to 1,500 words, and the graph inputs are compared with direct embedding-based representations from continuous bag-of-words, skip-gram, GloVe, FastText and BERT. With a fully connected classifier, the degree representation is the most accurate configuration from 700 selected words onward; it reaches its highest accuracy of 91.24% at 1,000 words and exceeds the BERT-based baseline by 0.29 percentage points at 1,500 words. In a separate convolutional comparison, the adjacency input reaches 86.16% at 1,000 words, against 83.12% for the strongest static embedding. The results indicate that visibility-derived features can be competitive once the selected vocabulary provides adequate coverage. We discuss the roles of graph compression, coordinate ordering and classifier choice, and the controls needed to establish the reliability of the small differences observed.
items.abstract_zh: 文本分类器依赖于能够以学习模型可使用的形式暴露类别间差异的表示，而受限词汇表会改变哪种表示最有效。本文研究自然可见图作为受控词汇预算下新闻主题分类的中间表示。词嵌入被平均为固定长度文档向量，该向量被读取为有序数值序列，其自然可见图以有序节点度向量或邻接矩阵的形式传递给分类器。在四类 AG News 基准上，卡方选择保留 100 到 1,500 个词，并将图输入与来自连续词袋、skip-gram、GloVe、FastText 和 BERT 的直接基于嵌入的表示进行比较。使用全连接分类器时，从选择 700 个词起，度表示是最准确的配置；它在 1,000 个词时达到最高准确率 91.24%，并在 1,500 个词时超过基于 BERT 的基线 0.29 个百分点。在单独的卷积比较中，邻接输入在 1,000 个词时达到 86.16%，而最强的静态嵌入为 83.12%。结果表明，一旦所选词汇表提供足够覆盖，可见图衍生特征可以具有竞争力。我们讨论了图压缩、坐标排序和分类器选择的作用，以及为确立所观察到的小差异的可靠性所需的控制实验。

items.title_en: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
items.title_zh: Heave-Ho：去中心化长时程多个人形机器人协作
items.abstract_en: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 协作有望将人形机器人的能力扩展到单个机器人所能达到之外。然而，实现这一潜力需要协调的全身交互、连贯的长时程规划以及机器人间的精确同步。我们提出 Heave-Ho，一个用于长时程协作多个人形机器人移动-操作的去中心化框架。在低层，我们开发了一个多智能体后训练框架，将人形机器人基础跟踪模型适配到人形机器人之间物理耦合的交互，使得仅凭局部观测即可实现协调的去中心化控制。在高层次，我们训练一个视觉-语言规划器，并设计基于语音的领导者-跟随者协调机制，以在没有网络通信的情况下同步去中心化执行。在两个相同人形机器人上训练后，我们的系统可扩展到最多十台机器人的团队，并无需重新训练即可泛化到异构团队。为基准测试这些能力，我们提出 HH-Bench，包含 12 项任务，涉及 2 至 10 个人形机器人组成的团队，包括异构团队。系统评估表明 Heave-Ho 持续优于基线方法，真实世界实验展示了在挑战性任务中的稳健去中心化协作。

items.title_en: Pixel is All You Need
items.title_zh: 像素即一切
items.abstract_en: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.
items.abstract_zh: 文本、图像、音频、触觉甚至机器人动作原则上都可以渲染到同一画布上，这指向在视觉内部统一所有模态的宏大目标。语言提供了自然的首个测试。为了将其纳入，视觉模型必须直接在像素中的文本上进行推理。然而，在广泛的图像、视频和统一多模态生成器中，我们发现其视觉生成模块无法在画布上对文本进行符号推理。只有当底层文本模块或提示重写器已经提供答案时它们才成功，这实际上将生成器降为单纯的渲染器；后训练几乎无法解决这一限制。为检验这一失败源于像素本身还是当前训练范式，我们从零训练了一族纯像素空间生成模型，不含任何文本通路。这些模型以图像为唯一输入和输出，直接在画布上读取问题、书写中间步骤并产生答案。值得注意的是，它们表现出大语言模型的标志性行为。性能随规模按幂律可预测地提升。逐帧书写中间步骤显著优于单帧回答，呼应思维链；而强化学习后训练进一步增强推理。此外，共享同一画布使同一模型能够跨模态推理，这是纯文本语言模型缺乏的能力。据我们所知，这是首次在无文本 token 的纯像素空间生成模型中对这些现象进行系统研究。

items.title_en: Whole-mount three-dimensional imaging and quantitative analysis platform for early brain development using dorsal forebrain spheroids
items.title_zh: 利用背侧前脑球状体的早期脑发育整体三维成像与定量分析平台
items.abstract_en: Three-dimensional culture systems have emerged as a bridge between in vitro and in vivo models. Organoids and spheroids derived from human stem cells can model cellular interactions, morphology and organization of the neocortex, and provide a platform for future translational research into neurological disorders. However, the heterogeneity commonly found in 3D culture systems presents considerable challenges for identifying significant, reproducible, and disorder-relevant phenotypes. Here, we present a rigorous methodological framework for the longitudinal analysis of dorsal forebrain spheroids, beginning with gross spheroid morphology, extending to structural phenotypes in rosette morphogenesis, and culminating in cellular analyses of neural progenitor cell proliferation and cell cycle dynamics. This workflow integrates isogenic iPSC-derived spheroid culture, whole-mount optical clearing, high-resolution 3D imaging and reconstruction, and cumulative EdU-labeling assays. Testing the sensitivity of this approach in an isogenic Down syndrome model, we reliably detected new features of altered spheroid growth, delayed rosette emergence, reduced rosette density, and prolonged progenitor cell cycle progression. This approach provides a reproducible strategy for measuring complex developmental phenotypes in 3D culture models and can be applied to neurodevelopmentally altered cell lines beyond Down syndrome.
items.abstract_zh: 三维培养系统已成为体外与体内模型之间的桥梁。源自人类干细胞的类器官和球状体能够模拟新皮层的细胞相互作用、形态和组织结构，并为未来神经系统疾病的转化研究提供平台。然而，三维培养系统中常见的异质性给识别显著、可重复且与疾病相关的表型带来了相当大的挑战。在此，我们提出一个用于背侧前脑球状体纵向分析的严谨方法学框架，从球状体总体形态开始，扩展到玫瑰花结形态发生中的结构表型，最终到神经祖细胞增殖和细胞周期动态的细胞分析。该工作流程整合了同基因 iPSC 来源的球状体培养、整体光学透明化、高分辨率三维成像与重建以及累积 EdU 标记测定。在同基因唐氏综合征模型中测试该方法的灵敏度时，我们可靠地检测到球状体生长改变、玫瑰花结出现延迟、玫瑰花结密度降低以及祖细胞细胞周期进程延长等新特征。该方法为测量三维培养模型中的复杂发育表型提供了可重复的策略，并可应用于唐氏综合征以外的神经发育改变的细胞系。

items.title_en: Zernike-efficient phase contrast with a scanned electron probe
items.title_zh: 基于扫描电子探针的 Zernike 高效相位衬度
items.abstract_en: For weak-phase objects, scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) with a far-field detector transfers at most half of the phase information per electron that Zernike phase-contrast (ZPC) conventional transmission electron microscopy (CTEM) achieves. We propose APEX (Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging), a scanned-probe mode that combines a defocused probe, a $π/2$ phase element in a magnified image of the probe crossover, and in-focus image-plane detection at each scan position. It applies the generalized Zernike framework of Dwyer and Paganin to a scanned probe. In a linear model of a thin weak-phase object with an ideal phase dot, APEX transfers nearly the full Zernike Fisher information over a wide band, substantially more than diffraction-plane four-dimensional STEM (4D-STEM). In idealized simulations of myoglobin in vitreous ice at a cryo-EM dose (elastic scattering only, no chromatic aberration, full coherence), ideal-dot APEX at a probe defocus of 1 $μ$m reconstructs the phase more accurately than defocused 4D-STEM ptychography with one untuned probe setting. At a defocus of about 25 $μ$m, a crossed laser phase plate (XLPP) acts as the $π/2$ element, and APEX of a periodic specimen cell comes close to CTEM with the same plate. In two dimensions, this mode is equivalent to laser phase-plate CTEM of a small, scanned area. A single simulated APEX scan with the XLPP also separates two myoglobin phase screens 150 nm apart in vacuum, at known depths, which is not possible with one ZPC CTEM exposure.
items.abstract_zh: 对于弱相位物体，使用远场探测器的扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）每个电子传递的相位信息至多为 Zernike 相位衬度（ZPC）常规透射电子显微镜（CTEM）所达到的一半。我们提出 APEX（Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging），一种扫描探针模式，结合离焦探针、位于探针交叉点放大图像中的 $π/2$ 相位元件，以及每个扫描位置处的聚焦像平面探测。它将 Dwyer 和 Paganin 的广义 Zernike 框架应用于扫描探针。在具有理想相位点的薄弱相位物体线性模型中，APEX 在宽频带上传递几乎完整的 Zernike Fisher 信息，显著多于衍射平面四维 STEM（4D-STEM）。在冷冻电镜剂量下玻璃态冰中肌红蛋白的理想化模拟中（仅弹性散射、无色差、完全相干），探针离焦为 1 $μ$m 的理想点 APEX 比使用一个未调谐探针设置的离焦 4D-STEM 叠层成像更准确地重建相位。在约 25 $μ$m 离焦下，交叉激光相位板（XLPP）充当 $π/2$ 元件，并且对周期性样品单元进行 APEX 成像接近使用相同板的 CTEM。在二维中，该模式等价于对小范围扫描区域进行激光相位板 CTEM。使用 XLPP 的单次模拟 APEX 扫描还可在真空中、已知深度下分离相距 150 nm 的两个肌红蛋白相位屏，而这用单次 ZPC CTEM 曝光无法实现。

items.title_en: VASR: Vector-Aware Assembly Planning with Equivalent Structures and Repair-Cost Feedback
items.title_zh: VASR：具备等价结构与修复代价反馈的向量感知装配规划
items.abstract_en: Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. To avoid penalizing valid alternatives to a reference assembly tree, we propose Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards. RHPO further uses repair-cost feedback to favor decisions with lower downstream correction costs among candidates with comparable equivalence-aware rewards. VASR achieves the highest Equivalent-Hard F1 among the evaluated methods, outperforming GPT6-Astra by 17.69 percentage points on the IKEA-derived test set while maintaining strong performance on an independent furniture dataset.
items.abstract_zh: 家具装配规划需要从单个零件与目标示意图中推断子装配层级。现有基于栅格的方法未显式利用 SVG 图纸中的几何与结构信息。我们提出 VASR 框架，将专用 SVG 编码器的特征与预训练视觉-语言模型的视觉表示相融合来预测装配层级。为避免惩罚参考装配树之外的有效替代方案，我们提出修复感知分层策略优化（RHPO）及层级保持的等价奖励。RHPO 进一步利用修复代价反馈，在等价感知奖励相当的候选中偏好下游修正代价更低的决策。VASR 在参与评测的方法中取得最高的 Equivalent-Hard F1，在 IKEA 衍生测试集上比 GPT6-Astra 高出 17.69 个百分点，同时在独立家具数据集上保持强劲性能。
items.highlight_zh: 融合 SVG 几何信息并引入等价奖励，装配规划超 GPT6-Astra 17.69 点。
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：给定一堆家具零件和一张装配示意图，让机器推断“先装哪个子组件、再装哪个”的层级化装配顺序。以往方法多把图纸当普通图片（栅格）处理，丢掉了 SVG 图纸里精确的线段、连接关系等几何与结构信息。
2）用了什么方法：作者构建 VASR 框架，一条支路用专门的 SVG 编码器读图纸的向量结构，另一条支路用预训练视觉-语言模型读整体图像，再把两路特征融合来预测装配层级。针对“装配顺序往往有多个正确解”的问题，提出 RHPO 训练策略：只要与参考装配树在层级上等价，就不惩罚；在此基础上，用“修复代价”作为额外信号，在几个看起来同样合理的候选里挑下游返工成本更低的那一个。
3）有什么结果：在 IKEA 衍生的测试集上，VASR 的 Equivalent-Hard F1 是所有评测方法中最高的，比 GPT6-Astra 高 17.69 个百分点；在一个独立家具数据集上也保持了很好的表现。
4）为何重要：它提醒我们，装配规划的评价不能只认“标准答案那一棵树”，否则会误伤同样可行的方案；同时说明图纸的矢量结构信息值得被显式建模。这对机器人自动装配、装配式建筑与教学辅助都有借鉴意义。
