items.title_en: Understanding Cross-Modal Inconsistency through Representation Subspaces in Omni Models
items.title_zh: 通过 Omni 模型中的表示子空间理解跨模态不一致性
items.abstract_en: Omni Models process audio, vision, and text within a unified language backbone, yet often produce different answers for semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. Existing representation-level analyses do not distinguish between information that predicts whether disagreement will occur and the representation whose perturbation affects the model's answer. In this paper, we estimate a low-dimensional Answer Subspace from answer-position representations and use it to separate answer-related components from the remaining representation. Across three Omni Models and two multimodal reasoning tasks, information predictive of cross-modal inconsistency lies mainly outside the Answer Subspace, concentrating in a reproducible two-dimensional representation that is not explained by a fixed modality offset. Matched interventions reveal distinct behavioral roles: perturbing the Answer Subspace substantially changes the model's predictions, whereas perturbing the disagreement representation, like a random subspace of the same dimensionality, leaves them almost unchanged. Our key finding is that cross-modal disagreement can be induced by misaligning modality-specific answer representations: perturbing the Answer Subspace for only one modality induces disagreement, whereas applying the same perturbation to both largely preserves agreement. Thus, the representation that predicts disagreement is distinct from the answer-level representation through which disagreement can be induced, showing that linear decodability does not imply behavioral efficacy.
items.abstract_zh: Omni 模型在统一语言主干内处理音频、视觉和文本，但对于跨模态语义等价的输入，常产生不同答案。现有表示层面分析没有区分预测是否会发生分歧的信息，与扰动会影响模型答案的表示。本文从答案位置表示中估计低维答案子空间（Answer Subspace），并用其将答案相关分量与其余表示分离。在三个 Omni 模型和两个多模态推理任务上，可预测跨模态不一致的信息主要位于答案子空间之外，集中在一个可复现的二维表示中，且不能由固定模态偏移解释。匹配干预揭示了不同的行为作用：扰动答案子空间会显著改变模型预测，而扰动分歧表示（如同等维度的随机子空间）几乎不改变预测。我们的关键发现是，跨模态分歧可通过使模态特定答案表示失配来诱发：仅对一种模态扰动答案子空间会诱发分歧，而对两种模态施加相同扰动则大体保持一致。因此，预测分歧的表示不同于可借以诱发分歧的答案级表示，表明线性可解码性并不意味着行为有效性。

items.title_en: Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation
items.title_zh: 按指令飞行：为无人机视觉-语言导航精炼世界-动作策略
items.abstract_en: Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.
items.abstract_zh: 自然语言引导的无人机导航可实现直观的人机交互和复杂环境中的灵活自主飞行。然而，可靠导航需要准确遵循指令、持续跟踪任务进度和安全避障，这对主要关注动作预测的现有世界-动作模型仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些限制，我们提出一个世界-动作学习框架，集成三种互补机制：具有针对性后训练的语言条件动作接口，用于产生指令响应运动；循环指令消耗预测，用于跟踪任务进度并确定终止；以及高斯场景后训练，通过轨迹模仿和可微几何反馈增强避障。闭环评估和消融研究表明，在顺序任务完成、安全到达目标和及时终止方面均有改进。此外，直接一步去噪降低了推理开销，真实世界室内外飞行验证了该框架的有效性。

items.title_en: ForceBody: Force-Paired Parametric Body Motion with Torque Uncertainty
items.title_zh: ForceBody：具有力矩不确定性的力配对参数化人体运动
items.abstract_en: Forces and torques drive human motion, central to biomechanics, robotics, and physics-aware animation, yet they are often absent from learning-based motion pipelines for body reconstruction and generation. Some motion datasets provide force annotations, but the paired motion sequences are incompatible with the parametric body models used in modern learning pipelines. In addition, existing datasets typically obtain joint torques through inverse dynamics, which is inherently sensitive to the quality of the input kinematics; however, they do not quantify the reliability of these torque estimates. We close this gap with ForceBody, the first dataset to bring ground truth force supervision into a parametric body representation, shipped with per-sample torque uncertainty. ForceBody pairs the SKEL body model with ground reaction forces and inverse-dynamics joint torques across 10,386 motion trials (9.7M frames, 26.9 hours) from 140 subjects. Each torque label is paired with a per-frame, per-joint uncertainty annotation obtained by Monte Carlo sampling through the inverse dynamics pipeline. We benchmark six architectures (MLP, Conv1D, LSTM, GRU, Mamba2, Transformer) on ground reaction force and joint torque prediction from SKEL motion. As one example use of the released uncertainty, finetuning a Transformer with per-sample uncertainty weighting reduces the MAE of joint torque estimation by 5%. Code and data are at https://github.com/DominoAI-Lab/ForceBody-NeurIPS-ED-2026.
items.abstract_zh: 力和力矩驱使人运动，是生物力学、机器人和物理感知动画的核心，但在用于身体重建和生成的基于学习的运动流程中常常缺失。一些运动数据集提供力标注，但配对的运动序列与现代学习流程中使用的参数化身体模型不兼容。此外，现有数据集通常通过逆动力学获得关节力矩，而这本质上对输入运动学的质量敏感；然而它们并未量化这些力矩估计的可靠性。我们用 ForceBody 弥补这一空白，这是首个将真实力监督引入参数化身体表示的数据集，并附带逐样本力矩不确定性。ForceBody 将 SKEL 身体模型与地面反作用力和逆动力学关节力矩配对，覆盖来自 140 名受试者的 10,386 次运动试验（970 万帧，26.9 小时）。每个力矩标签都配有一个逐帧、逐关节的不确定性标注，该标注通过逆动力学流程中的蒙特卡洛采样获得。我们在从 SKEL 运动预测地面反作用力和关节力矩的任务上对六种架构（MLP、Conv1D、LSTM、GRU、Mamba2、Transformer）进行基准测试。作为所发布不确定性的一种示例用法，使用逐样本不确定性加权对 Transformer 进行微调，将关节力矩估计的 MAE 降低 5%。代码和数据见 https://github.com/DominoAI-Lab/ForceBody-NeurIPS-ED-2026。

items.title_en: Determination of mitochondrial matrix pH during ischemia-reperfusion injury in the isolated mouse heart using a genetically encoded fluorescent sensor
items.title_zh: 使用基因编码荧光传感器测定离体小鼠心脏缺血-再灌注损伤期间线粒体基质 pH
items.abstract_en: Mitochondrial matrix pH (pHmtx) regulates cellular energetics, metabolite flux, and ion transport. Despite its importance in cellular energy metabolism and disease, pHmtx remains difficult to measure in the intact heart because pH-sensitive dyes are challenging to selectively target to the mitochondrial matrix. Changes in intracellular pH during cardiac ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) are significant and understanding pHmtx dynamics I/R would provide insight into mechanisms of injury. To overcome uncertainties associated with intracellular dye distribution, the pH-sensitive green fluorescent protein SypHer3 was stably expressed in the mitochondrial matrix of the adult mouse heart using adeno-associated virus (AAV). The isolated perfused heart was subjected to global no-flow ischemia, followed by reperfusion and SypHer3 fluorescence measured using an optical integrating sphere. Calibration of SypHer3 fluorescence fold-change against pH in isolated mitochondria enabled pHmtx quantification from SypHer3 fluorescence in the intact heart, based on an assigned starting pH of 7.47. We found that pHmtx decreased from 7.45 {+/-} 0.01 (n=5) during normoxia to 6.61 {+/-} 0.20 (n=5) after 20 minutes of ischemia, and reached 7.16 {+/-} 0.01 (n=5) within 1 minute of reperfusion. In paired experiments, we measured relative changes in mitochondrial Ca2+ (Ca2+m) in the isolated heart during I/R using the genetically encoded, mitochondrial-targeted Ca2+ sensor R-GECO1. Because R-GECO1 fluorescence is pH-sensitive, quantification of pHmtx is required to correct R-GECO1 fluorescence for pH-dependent effects. With correction for pH, R-GECO1 fluorescence increased 1.77 {+/-} 0.40-fold (n=7) within 20 minutes of ischemia and returned to baseline within the first minute of reperfusion, consistent with an increase in Ca2+m during ischemia that reversed upon reperfusion. In summary, we developed a fluorescence approach for measuring pHmtx, a key determinant of mitochondrial energetics and ion transport, in the isolated perfused mouse heart, providing time resolved quantitative estimates of pHmtx during I/R. Furthermore, this work expands the application of fluorescent sensors for interrogating mitochondrial physiology in the intact heart by providing a framework for accounting for pH-dependent effects on probe fluorescence.
items.abstract_zh: 线粒体基质 pH（pHmtx）调节细胞能量学、代谢物通量和离子转运。尽管 pHmtx 在细胞能量代谢和疾病中很重要，但在完整心脏中仍难以测量，因为 pH 敏感染料难以选择性靶向线粒体基质。心脏缺血-再灌注（I/R）期间细胞内 pH 的变化显著，理解 I/R 中的 pHmtx 动态将为损伤机制提供见解。为克服细胞内染料分布相关的不确定性，使用腺相关病毒（AAV）在成年小鼠心脏线粒体基质中稳定表达 pH 敏感的绿色荧光蛋白 SypHer3。对离体灌注心脏实施全局无流缺血，随后再灌注，并使用光学积分球测量 SypHer3 荧光。将离体线粒体中 SypHer3 荧光的倍数变化对 pH 进行校准，使得能够基于指定的起始 pH 7.47，从完整心脏中的 SypHer3 荧光定量 pHmtx。我们发现，pHmtx 从常氧期间的 7.45 ± 0.01（n=5）降至缺血 20 分钟后的 6.61 ± 0.20（n=5），并在再灌注 1 分钟内达到 7.16 ± 0.01（n=5）。在配对实验中，我们使用基因编码的线粒体靶向 Ca2+ 传感器 R-GECO1 测量了 I/R 期间离体心脏中线粒体 Ca2+（Ca2+m）的相对变化。由于 R-GECO1 荧光对 pH 敏感，需要定量 pHmtx 以校正 R-GECO1 荧光的 pH 依赖性效应。经 pH 校正后，R-GECO1 荧光在缺血 20 分钟内增加 1.77 ± 0.40 倍（n=7），并在再灌注第一分钟内恢复到基线，这与缺血期间 Ca2+m 增加且再灌注后逆转一致。总之，我们开发了一种在离体灌注小鼠心脏中测量 pHmtx（线粒体能量学和离子转运的关键决定因素）的荧光方法，提供了 I/R 期间 pHmtx 的时间分辨定量估计。此外，这项工作通过提供考虑 pH 依赖性对探针荧光影响的框架，扩展了荧光传感器在完整心脏中探究线粒体生理学的应用。

items.title_en: Observation of temporal routing of topological edge states
items.title_zh: 拓扑边缘态的时间路由观测
items.abstract_en: The switching or routing of topological edge states is crucial for disorder-immune state transfer. Previous experimental observations have primarily relied on optical waveguide arrays that treat the spatial coordinate as an equivalent temporal dimension. However, direct experimental observation of the routing dynamics of topological edge states in physical time remains challenging. Here, we report the experimental observation of temporal routing of topological edge states. By constructing a lattice composed of two coupled nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains, the topological edge states exhibit temporal routing behavior controlled by nonlinearity. As the excitation voltage increases from the linear regime, we observe that the voltage intensity distribution transitions from periodic interchain exchange to slowed interchain exchange and ultimately to localization with strongly suppressed interchain exchange, thereby validating the phenomenon of temporal routing. These dynamics are experimentally observed within a finite time window limited by circuit dissipation. Our findings provide valuable insights into the temporal manipulation of topological edge states.
items.abstract_zh: 拓扑边缘态的切换或路由对于抗无序态传输至关重要。此前的实验观测主要依赖将空间坐标视为等效时间维度的光波导阵列。然而，在物理时间中直接实验观测拓扑边缘态的路由动力学仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们报道了拓扑边缘态时间路由的实验观测。通过构建由两条耦合非线性Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链组成的晶格，拓扑边缘态表现出由非线性控制的时间路由行为。随着激励电压从线性区增加，我们观察到电压强度分布从周期性链间交换转变为减慢的链间交换，并最终转变为链间交换被强烈抑制的局域化，从而验证了时间路由现象。这些动力学是在受电路耗散限制的有限时间窗口内实验观测到的。我们的发现为拓扑边缘态的时间操控提供了有价值的见解。

items.title_en: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
items.title_zh: 推理在环：通过探究机制与测量实现抗体先导优化
items.abstract_en: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. Over seven rounds and about 1,010 design variants we built libraries from antibody lineage, structure and biophysics, and found from the raw curves that on each scaffold one thermal metric did not measure what its name implied. The libraries were built as controlled comparisons, so the results also show what each mutation contributes to each property. We fit a physical model of the curves, used it to choose metrics suited to each scaffold, and changed the experimental protocol, varying protein concentration and heating rate, to test the model against pre-registered predictions. Both leads improve on their parents in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation while improving or maintaining yield and purity.
items.abstract_zh: 实验室在环（lab-in-the-loop）系统——模型提出分子、自动化实验测定其性质、结果再用于重训模型——是抗体先导优化的常用思路。这类系统优化的“规格”由仪器信号计算出的指标定义，因此成败取决于这些指标能否很好地代理候选药物真正需要的性质。当某个指标是劣质代理时，再好的模型或再多数据都无法弥补，而识别此类问题通常需要专家审阅。本文报告在 BigHat Biosciences 的 Milliner 平台上开展的两项研发：一项针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体（VHH），一项针对抗间皮素单链可变片段（scFv），研究团队与通用 AI 智能体 Claude 共同将科学推理引入回路。经过七轮、约 1,010 个设计变体，我们基于抗体谱系、结构与生物物理构建文库，并从原始曲线中发现：每种骨架上都有一个热学指标并未测量其名称所暗示的性质。由于文库以受控比较方式构建，结果也揭示了各突变对各项性质的贡献。我们拟合曲线的物理模型，据此为每种骨架选择合适的指标，并调整实验方案（改变蛋白浓度与升温速率），以预注册的预测来检验模型。两个先导分子在亲和力、热稳定性与聚集方面均优于亲本，同时产量与纯度改善或保持不变。
items.highlight_zh: 把科学推理放进实验回路，揪出“名不副实”的指标并优化抗体
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究什么问题：抗体药物优化常用“实验室在环”模式：AI 设计分子、自动仪器测性质、数据回喂模型。但模型追求的目标其实是仪器信号算出的指标，若这指标并不能代表药物真正需要的性质（劣质代理），那么换更好的模型、加更多数据都没用——而发现这种问题往往只能靠人盯着原始数据看。
2) 用了什么方法：在 BigHat 的 Milliner 平台上做两场真实研发——抗白蛋白纳米抗体 VHH 与抗间皮素 scFv，共七轮、约 1,010 个设计变体。研究团队与通用 AI 智能体 Claude 一起把科学推理带入回路：依据抗体谱系、结构与生物物理原理构建文库，且特意把文库设计成受控比较，使每个突变的贡献可被拆解。
3) 有什么结果：从原始热熔曲线看出，每种骨架上都有一个“热稳定性”指标并不真正测量其名称所指的性质；拟合曲线的物理模型后，为每种骨架挑选了更贴切的指标，并修改实验方案（变动蛋白浓度与升温速率），用事先注册的预测来检验模型。最终两个先导分子在亲和力、热稳定性与抗聚集上均优于亲本，产量与纯度不降反升。
4) 为何重要：它指出 AI 驱动实验的真正瓶颈常在“测量与指标”而非“模型”，并提出一种可操作范式——让推理（人类专家＋AI 智能体）留在回路中，诊断代理指标失效、重设测量方式，把自动化优化从“盲目爬山”变成有机制理解支撑的科学过程。

items.title_en: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
items.title_zh: 更努力思考并不会带来更好的选择：推理努力提高了LLM购物智能体的置信度，但未提高其正确性
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为自主购物智能体，它们处理多模态商品列表（由视觉和文本数据组成），并代表消费者推荐购买。人们自然会假设，具有更强思考能力的模型会做出更高质量的购买决策。为了检验这一看法，我们针对此类智能体提出两个问题：要求模型更努力思考是否会让它选择更好的产品？它报告的置信度是否告诉我们它可能出错的可能性？我们在基于WebShop、Amazon的SQID和Wayfair的WANDS平台构建的三个产品选择基准上对十个前沿模型进行基准测试，以考察具有更强思考能力的LLM是否实际做出更高质量的产品购买决策。在所有三个基准上，我们发现增加思考努力并不会以统计上显著的方式提高决策质量。相同的思考努力变化在统计显著水平上提高了所报告的置信度，因此额外思考换来的是置信度而非正确性。我们还测量了这些模型在这些任务中的校准情况（即其报告的置信度百分比与真实正确率百分比匹配的程度），并表明大多数模型在每个努力水平上都没有良好校准。我们还发现错误具有强共享性：当一个模型在某任务上出错时，其他若干模型也往往在同一任务上出错。此外，在多个模型都出错的任务上，其中大量模型选择了同一个错误产品。

items.title_en: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
items.title_zh: 面向工业环境的移动机械臂机器人技术报告
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍Auriga Robotics的移动机械臂机器人的设计与实现，该机器人由沙希德·贝赫什提大学电气工程系机器人与智能自动化实验室开发。下文将该平台称为@Work Robot。该机器人面向工业任务，重点提高重复性或危险工作环境中的效率。它采用4轮麦克纳姆驱动实现全向移动，并配备带有3D打印夹爪的5自由度机械臂，用于物体处理和导航。电子部分包括围绕ESP32微控制器构建的定制PCB板，以及负责高层处理和实时系统控制的NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX。在软件方面，Hector SLAM提供建图与定位，A*负责路径规划，YOLO执行实时目标检测。这些模块利用融合传感器数据，实现稳健导航和可靠避障。总体而言，该系统展示了有效的软硬件集成，在类工业环境中的自主导航、物体处理和任务执行方面具有稳定性能。

items.title_en: Semantic-Guided Geometric Decoding for Token-Efficient Visual Grounding
items.title_zh: 面向令牌高效视觉定位的语义引导几何解码
items.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a unified interface for language-conditioned visual perception. In pixel-to-sequence grounding, autoregressive coordinate generation requires multiple sequential decoding steps per box, increasing inference cost with the number of instances. Pixel-to-embedding methods reduce this overhead but lack explicit spatial encoding when using a shared special token. We introduce SemGeo, a token-efficient visual grounding framework that represents each instance with a single grid token for coarse localization. A geometric decoder reuses visual features and hidden states to recover precise discrete box coordinates in parallel. To train proposal generation and box localization together, we introduce Gaussian soft labels that encode coordinate distances during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Reinforcement post-training further combines box-set rewards with coordinate supervision on model-generated proposals. This stage trains the language model and geometric decoder on their own predictions to mitigate the mismatch between teacher-forced training and inference. Across eight benchmarks spanning object detection, referring object detection, and document layout grounding, SemGeo achieves the highest F1@mIou among compared MLLMs on six benchmarks. It also delivers $2.07\times$ and $1.25\times$ the mean box-generation throughput of representative grounding baselines under vLLM and Transformers, respectively, while achieving higher accuracy in both comparisons.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为语言条件视觉感知提供了统一接口。在像素到序列的定位中，自回归坐标生成需要每个框进行多个顺序解码步骤，随着实例数量增加而提高推理成本。像素到嵌入的方法降低了这一开销，但在使用共享特殊令牌时缺乏显式空间编码。我们提出SemGeo，一种令牌高效的视觉定位框架，用单个网格令牌表示每个实例以进行粗定位。几何解码器重用视觉特征和隐藏状态，以并行方式恢复精确的离散框坐标。为了联合训练候选生成和框定位，我们引入高斯软标签，在监督微调（SFT）期间编码坐标距离。强化学习后训练进一步将框集合奖励与对模型生成候选的坐标监督相结合。该阶段在模型自身预测上训练语言模型和几何解码器，以缓解教师强制训练与推理之间的不匹配。在涵盖目标检测、指代目标检测和文档布局定位的八个基准上，SemGeo在六个基准上取得了所比较MLLM中最高的F1@mIou。在vLLM和Transformers下，它分别达到代表性定位基线平均框生成吞吐量的2.07倍和1.25倍，同时在两项比较中均实现更高准确率。

items.title_en: Sequence-based models predict TF binding with negligible contributions from motif cooperativity
items.title_zh: 基于序列的模型预测TF结合，基序协同性的贡献可忽略不计
items.abstract_en: How transcription factors (TFs) selectively recognize their genomic targets among numerous sites containing similar DNA motifs remains an open question. Cooperative binding at neighboring motif sites is widely considered a key mechanism of TF specificity, yet its genome-wide contribution remains unclear. Machine learning models can now predict TF binding directly from DNA sequence, providing opportunities to investigate its underlying determinants. Here, we leveraged BPNet models trained on ~2,000 ENCODE TF binding profiles to systematically assess motif cooperativity. Although detected at individual loci, cooperativity made a negligible contribution to genome-wide binding predictions. Nevertheless, the models captured differences in binding preferences between TFs with similar motif preferences, even within the same cellular environment. These findings highlight the need to critically assess prevailing assumptions and explore alternative mechanisms underlying selective TF binding.
items.abstract_zh: 转录因子（TF）如何在众多含有相似DNA基序的位点中选择性识别其基因组靶点，仍是一个未解问题。邻近基序位点上的协同结合被广泛认为是TF特异性的关键机制，但其在全基因组范围内的贡献仍不清楚。机器学习模型如今可直接从DNA序列预测TF结合，为研究其潜在决定因素提供了机会。在此，我们利用在约2,000个ENCODE TF结合图谱上训练的BPNet模型，系统评估基序协同性。尽管在单个位点可检测到协同性，但其对全基因组结合预测的贡献可忽略不计。尽管如此，这些模型捕捉到了具有相似基序偏好的TF之间在结合偏好上的差异，即使在同一细胞环境中也是如此。这些发现凸显了需要批判性评估现有假设，并探索选择性TF结合背后的替代机制。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming for Materials Science
items.title_zh: 面向材料科学的权重空间编程
items.abstract_en: A materials discovery campaign often begins with almost no measurements of the property it is searching for, and the models that rank candidates or screen the output of a generator then have to be built from those first few labels. Following recent work on weight-space programming, in which a language model writes the weights of a small network directly as text, we show that a general-purpose model, given the task in words, the names of the inputs and a network of 16 hidden units with every weight set to zero, can provide this starting point by filling in all of the weights from what it has learned about materials. With no labels, the networks of the strongest model rank experimental alloys at Spearman co-efficient = 0.64 to 0.79, where the best of five simple descriptors reaches 0.47 to 0.62. They rank the bulk modulus of crystals added during generative discovery loops at 0.95, where the inverse volume per atom reaches 0.89, and 35 phase-equilibrium targets computed with Thermo-Calc at a mean of 0.67, close to the 0.70 of an extrapolation from calculated binary and ternary data. As the prior mean of a Gaussian process they raise the ranking at five labels from 0.35 to 0.69 on alloys and from 0.15 to 0.95 on crystals, and they lower the regret of Bayesian optimization significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks and on 13 to 16 of 33 computed targets, depending on how multiple tests are corrected, without raising it significantly on any. The same networks also serve as the mean of a Bayesian neural network and as a screen for the samples of two crystal generators, where they do as well as standard models trained on 400 labeled structures. The gain is confined to the first tens of labels and to targets that no rule or sub-system extrapolation already ranks.
items.abstract_zh: 材料发现活动通常开始时几乎没有任何关于其所寻找性质的测量，而用于对候选排序或筛选生成器输出的模型则必须由最初少量标签构建。继近期关于权重空间编程的工作（其中语言模型直接以文本形式写出小型网络的权重）之后，我们表明，一个通用模型在获得以文字描述的任务、输入名称以及一个所有未权重均置零的16隐藏单元网络时，可以通过根据其已学习到的材料知识填充所有未权重来提供这一起点。在没有标签的情况下，最强模型的网络对实验合金的排序达到Spearman系数=0.64至0.79，而五个简单描述符中最佳者达到0.47至0.62。它们对生成式发现循环中加入的晶体体积模量的排序达到0.95，而每原子体积倒数达到0.89；对用Thermo-Calc计算的35个相平衡目标平均达到0.67，接近由计算二元和三元数据外推得到的0.70。作为高斯过程的先验均值，它们在五个标签时将合金上的排序从0.35提高到0.69，将晶体上的排序从0.15提高到0.95；并且它们在5个实验任务中的4个以及33个计算目标中的13至16个上显著降低了贝叶斯优化的遗憾值（取决于多重检验校正方式），而在任何任务上均未显著提高遗憾值。相同的网络还充当贝叶斯神经网络的均值，并作为两个晶体生成器样本的筛选器，其表现与在400个标注结构上训练的标准模型相当。增益仅限于最初的数十个标签以及尚无规则或子系统外推已经能够排序的目标。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.title_zh: 权重空间编程不需要Transformer
items.abstract_en: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.
items.abstract_zh: Transformer等标准神经架构之所以被选择，是因为它们能用梯度下降很好地训练，并在GPU上运行很快。在权重空间编程中，大语言模型（LLM）手工写出目标权重，而不进行基于梯度的训练，因此这些理由不再适用。我们应该保留Transformer吗？在最少指导下，给定十个标注示例和一个沙箱，主要针对多项选择题，我们让三个前沿LLM要么生成固定架构的权重，要么自行设计架构。当可以自由设计时，三个模型都将纯文本事实编译成由固定过程查询的稀疏表，测试准确率最高达到54.4%。一个由LLM设计的模型比同一LLM写出的最准确已发布Transformer具有更高的测试准确率，而参数约少1,800倍。在没有梯度的情况下，它们选择表，其中LLM可以说明每个权重的含义，并能找到并重写错误的权重。每个错误答案指向一行，删除一行会改变大约另一个答案。由此，我们提出一种基于联想记忆的模型，在GPU上比同等大小的Transformer快最多17倍。我们还测试了预训练权重、其他基准以及模型生成答案的任务。预训练LLM仍然更准确；该主张关注的是在编写权重时应构建哪种结构。

items.title_en: Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering
items.title_zh: 超越职位名称：用稀疏自编码器和语义聚类解读早期职业招聘广告
items.abstract_en: Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026. We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies. Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.
items.abstract_zh: 仅凭职位名称和职位描述，难以深入洞察技术岗位在不断变化的就业市场中如何不同。为评估此类岗位在工作内容和行业应用上的差异，我们使用2025年12月至2026年10月期间从美国LinkedIn收集的36,081条早期职业招聘信息，设计并比较了两种基于深度学习和Transformer表示的方法。我们首先应用PERC，即预处理（P）、嵌入（E）、降维（R）和聚类（C）的缩写。我们使用GPT-6 Luna将职位描述段落分类为团队背景、岗位任务和任职资格。随后，我们创建这些部分的组合，并考察对分段段落进行嵌入和聚类是否能产生关于不同岗位的有意义语义簇。我们使用最大均值差异（MMD）对嵌入分布之间观察到的差异进行排序，并采用预训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE）从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct第19层表示中提取特征。最后，我们使用GPT-6 Luna提出关于岗位特征模式的假设，并使用GPT-6.1 Terra研究这些模式是否存在于来自未见公司的留出职位描述中。一些示例发现包括：数据科学家招聘广告更强调机器学习模型开发，数据分析师广告更强调报告业务绩效，机器学习工程师广告更强调将已开发的模型应用于现实环境。我们还观察到，在所选月份中，数据分析师和业务分析师广告所描述的应用存在差异，尽管我们数据集的规模和覆盖不均限制了对其的解读。总体而言，我们展示了SAE和PERC在非结构化文本数据上的实际应用，并考察自动洞察提取如何支持对职位描述的人工分析。

items.title_en: Autonomous Track Racing with a Commercially Available Humanoid: System Design and Real-World Deployment
items.title_zh: 基于市售人形机器人的自主赛道竞速：系统设计与真实世界部署
items.abstract_en: Learning-based methods now let humanoids run robustly, and they have begun to compete in athletic events. Yet few reports describe a complete autonomous humanoid running system in an actual race, where the robot must follow a lane at a new venue, pace itself within hardware limits, and finish without intervention. We report such a system deployed on the Unitree G1, a commercially available general-purpose humanoid, in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events of the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026. The system integrates vision-based lane perception, path tracking, and a running policy trained by reinforcement learning with a human motion prior. To address the challenges of humanoid running, we stabilize head-camera images against body motion and use IMU-assisted leg odometry to bridge flight phases. To manage motor heating, we penalize hip-pitch torque during training, add heat-dissipation plates, and apply temperature-based speed limiting with event-specific pacing. The robot placed 13th of 74 in the 100 m, 10th of 44 in the 400 m first round before falling in the semifinal, and seventh of 35 in the 1500 m. In this deployment, thermal margin set the pace in every event, and the semifinal fall followed a lane-detection error.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习的方法如今使人形机器人能够稳健奔跑，并且它们已开始参加体育赛事。然而，鲜有报告描述在实际比赛中完整的自主人形机器人奔跑系统；在比赛中，机器人必须在新场地沿跑道行进、在硬件限制内控制配速，并在无干预情况下完赛。我们报告了这样一个系统，部署于市售通用人形机器人 Unitree G1，参加2026年世界人形机器人运动会的100米、400米和1500米项目。该系统集成了基于视觉的跑道感知、路径跟踪，以及通过带人体运动先验的强化学习训练得到的奔跑策略。为应对人形机器人奔跑的挑战，我们抑制身体运动对头部相机图像的影响，并使用IMU辅助的腿部里程计来桥接腾空阶段。为管理电机发热，我们在训练中对髋关节俯仰扭矩施加惩罚，增加散热板，并采用基于温度的速度限制与针对各项目的配速策略。机器人在100米项目中74个参赛者中排名第13；在400米第一轮44个参赛者中排名第10，随后在半决赛中摔倒；在1500米项目中35个参赛者中排名第7。在此次部署中，热裕度在每项赛事中决定了配速，而半决赛摔倒发生在一次跑道检测错误之后。

items.title_en: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: SpatialMind：面向多模态大语言模型空间推理的自适应多层级几何融合
items.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在2D视觉理解方面展现出有前景的能力，但在3D空间推理方面仍然有限。近期研究探索将3D重建模型集成到MLLMs中。然而，这些方法要么在所有任务中使用单一几何粒度，要么采用固定的多层级融合方案，而不考虑任务特定的推理需求。通过对多层级几何融合的系统实验，我们发现不同认知层次的空间任务（例如距离估计与路径规划）需要不同粒度的几何表示，这表明固定融合无法适应多样的空间推理需求。为弥合这一差距，我们提出SpatialMind，一个用于动态整合多层级几何表示的任务自适应框架。SpatialMind采用GeoFus，一个多层几何融合模块，其核心是一个同时以文本指令、视觉语义和几何表示为条件的门控网络。该网络在LLM解码器各层中自适应地调节浅层、中层和深层几何特征的贡献。此外，我们引入负熵正则化损失以缓解门控崩溃。门控可视化表明，GeoFus能够根据任务需求调整几何粒度。实验表明，SpatialMind在多个空间基准上取得有竞争力的性能，在VSI-Bench上达到72.3的最先进分数。源代码公开于 https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind。

items.title_en: Constructing Gene Regulatory Network using Chatterjee's Rank Correlation with Single-cell Transcriptomic Data
items.title_zh: 利用Chatterjee秩相关与单细胞转录组数据构建基因调控网络
items.abstract_en: Constructing gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is critical for understanding cellular systems, yet existing methods rely either on strong modeling assumptions or on computationally intensive algorithms. We introduce a multiple testing framework for GRN construction based on Chatterjee's rank correlation coefficient, a nonparametric measure of dependence that captures non-linear and non-monotone relationships. The framework overcomes several limitations of traditional methods by offering a transparent, scalable, and computationally efficient alternative to recent black-box machine learning models. Because cells in scRNA-seq data are not independent observations, we develop a data-driven algorithm for estimating robust testing cutoffs. We further exploit the asymmetric nature of Chatterjee's correlation to propose a new test for asymmetric predictive associations, yielding biologically meaningful and directionally informed GRNs. In simulations, our method matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in recovering true gene-gene dependencies and asymmetric associations, particularly for complex, non-linear dependencies. Application to real scRNA-seq data shows its utility for dissecting complex regulatory networks.
items.abstract_zh: 从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据构建基因调控网络（GRNs）对于理解细胞系统至关重要，但现有方法要么依赖强建模假设，要么依赖计算密集型算法。我们提出一种基于Chatterjee秩相关系数的GRN构建多重检验框架；该系数是一种非参数依赖度量，能够捕捉非线性和非单调关系。该框架通过提供一种透明、可扩展且计算高效的方案来替代近期的黑盒机器学习模型，从而克服传统方法的若干局限。由于scRNA-seq数据中的细胞并非独立观测，我们开发了一种数据驱动算法来估计稳健的检验截断值。我们进一步利用Chatterjee相关性的非对称性质，提出一种针对非对称预测关联的新检验，从而产生具有生物学意义且方向信息明确的GRNs。在模拟中，我们的方法在恢复真实基因-基因依赖关系和非对称关联方面达到或优于最先进方法，尤其是在复杂的非线性依赖情形下。应用于真实scRNA-seq数据表明其可用于剖析复杂调控网络。

items.title_en: Photonic Maxwells demon as an energy resource
items.title_zh: 作为能源的光子麦克斯韦妖
items.abstract_en: We propose a new realization of Maxwells demon for photons and its use as an energy resource. The starting point is a multilayer dielectric mirror that transmits photons within a certain wavelength band but reflects photons at longer wavelengths, followed by a material that irreversibly converts the wavelength. A 3D box constructed from these one-way mirrors is a self-acting Maxwells demon for photons. The first case considered is a one-way mirror for visible photons, converting blue to red as an example. The next case is a one-way mirror that transmits visible light but reflects infrared light, followed by a perfect blackbody. We analyze a 3D box with such mirrors as walls to accumulate and store blackbody radiation. Applications include solar-powered thermal energy and solar-powered thermophotovoltaics. The latter case would combine the 3D box with an ultra-low bandgap semiconductor photovoltaic cell inside. In the ideal optical limit, radiation can enter the box but cannot return through the entrance channel after conversion, allowing repeated photon recycling and nearly complete optical utilization. This can in principle move the conversion efficiency toward the thermodynamic limit for solar-energy conversion, the Landsberg limit of 93.3%.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种光子麦克斯韦妖的新实现及其作为能源的用途。起点是一种多层介电镜，它透射某一波长带内的光子，但反射更长波长的光子；其后是一种不可逆地转换波长的材料。由这些单向镜构造的三维盒是一种对光子自行作用的麦克斯韦妖。考虑的第一种情形是面向可见光子的单向镜，以将蓝光转换为红光为例。下一种情形是一种透射可见光但反射红外光的单向镜，其后接一个完美黑体。我们分析以这类镜子作为壁面的三维盒，用于积累和存储黑体辐射。应用包括太阳能驱动热能以及太阳能驱动热光伏。后一种情形会将三维盒与置于其内部的超低带隙半导体光伏电池相结合。在理想光学极限下，辐射可以进入盒内，但在转换后无法通过入口通道返回，从而允许重复的光子循环利用和近乎完全的光学利用。这原则上可使转换效率趋近太阳能转换的热力学极限，即93.3%的Landsberg极限。

items.title_en: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
items.title_zh: WoRD：用于在线目标识别的基于扩散的后验推断
items.abstract_en: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed. We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.
items.abstract_zh: 目标识别是根据智能体被观测到的行为推断其意图目标的任务。大多数现有工作聚焦于高层符号识别，将智能体到达目标的连续运动抽象掉。确实对连续轨迹进行推理的方法依赖显式动力学模型，而该模型难以获取且很少能跨设置迁移。两种方法都没有显式学习智能体如何朝每个候选目标运动，这限制了对模糊轨迹前缀的准确率，而此类知识在这些前缀上最为需要。我们提出WoRD（Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion，基于扩散的路点识别），它使用学习到的轨迹先验从部分观测中推断智能体的目标。在每一步，WoRD为每个候选目标运行一条热启动的去噪链，通过闭式对数似然梯度将每条链引向观测轨迹，并根据贝叶斯规则对所得样本重新加权，形成校准的目标后验。我们在模拟机器人设置、行人轨迹和车辆轨迹上评估WoRD，使用四个针对不同失效模式的指标。在所有三种设置中，同一推断过程在模糊前缀上保持了校准的多模态信念，而基于滤波器和基于分类器的观测器在这些前缀上会坍缩为单一模态或变得过度自信。

items.title_en: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
items.title_zh: 基于评分细则的 LLM 集成 AES：使用 LLM 集成对批判性在线推理中的学生回答进行评分
items.abstract_en: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.
items.abstract_zh: 对学生回答进行评分成本高且耗时。此外，人工标注者容易出现偏差、疲劳和评分者漂移，这进一步限制了评分的可靠性。已采用多种方法开发自动作文评分（AES）系统，以降低这些成本并解决与偏差相关的问题。这些方法从早期基于文本特征的系统到当前的机器学习和基于 Transformer 的模型。具体而言，大语言模型（LLM）为简化 AES 系统的开发提供了潜力。然而，它们受制于众所周知的局限性，例如幻觉和提示敏感性。这产生了探索混合方法潜力的需求，该方法通过集成形成来利用各个 LLM 之间的协同作用。我们评估 LLM 集成在经济学和医学教育中对学生回答进行评分时，在 103 项标准上匹配人类评分者一致性的潜力。我们使用来自先前开展的一项评估的 631 份德语回答以及由 2 至 5 名标注者给出的相应人工评分。我们在 15 个开放权重 LLM 上实验了 523 种基于评分细则的提示配置，并使用用于标注者间一致性（IAA）的 Krippendorff's alpha 和替代标注者检验（alt-test）评估其与人类评分者的一致性。我们的结果表明，用表现最佳的 LLM-提示配置替换一名人类评分者，在 103 项标准中的 91 项上保持或提高了 IAA，并且 LLM 在 90 项标准上通过了 alt-test。我们的发现表明，当前最先进的 LLM 可以支持经济学和医学教育中德语回答的 AES，减少人工工作量并实现更快的处理，同时仍需要针对人类评分进行验证。

items.title_en: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
items.title_zh: Polygraph：使用位姿图的大规模多会话轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人、车辆和可穿戴设备经常多次穿越同一环境。每次通行都会根据机载视觉或视觉惯性里程计生成自己的轨迹。这些轨迹在局部准确，但会随时间漂移，并处于不相关的坐标系中。将许多此类独立轨迹转化为一个全局一致集合，即大规模多会话轨迹优化问题。现有解决方案大多离线工作。所有会话必须预先可用，一个会话被固定为参考坐标系，然后优化单个融合地图。本文提出Polygraph，一种多会话轨迹优化流水线，可在线处理会话，一次一个关键帧和一个空间簇，且从不构建3D地图。关键帧被分组为局部簇。当一个簇闭合时，通过学习型图像检索将其与其他每个会话进行匹配。候选对通过稀疏特征匹配、单目度量深度和鲁棒位姿估计进行验证。两级共识门仅在独立证据佐证后，才允许跨会话边进入共享位姿图。廉价的增量求解使图保持最新，周期性鲁棒批量求解剔除离群值。我们在立体户外驾驶、HoloLens和iPad室内通行、使用Boston Dynamics Spot的腿式室内运动，以及大规模户外车辆和手持路线上评估Polygraph。与同一GPU型号上最接近的先前工作相比，使用其报告的计时，Polygraph运行更快，提交的闭环边更少，并在准确率上持平或有所提高。

items.title_en: CoSphere-SLAM: Multi-Agent Panoramic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Spherical Loop Closure
items.title_zh: CoSphere-SLAM：具有球面回环检测的多智能体全景高斯泼溅SLAM
items.abstract_en: Dense collaborative mapping is essential for search and rescue, building inspection, and warehouse automation, where panoramic cameras capture the entire surroundings in a single frame. Unlike pinhole agents that share views only at similar headings, panoramic agents observe overlapping scenes at any 3D orientation, yet searching full rotations also produces mutually consistent false loop closures across distinct symmetric rooms. Moreover, continuous monocular scale drift splits rigidly merged maps at revisited surfaces, while depth noise at short baselines distorts loop translation directions. To address these challenges, we propose CoSphere-SLAM, the first multi-agent Gaussian splatting SLAM framework for panoramic cameras, whose spherical loop closure aligns spherical features over $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ via fast Fourier correlation across arbitrary orientations and rejects symmetric false closures through global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ consensus. Building on these closures, directional global optimization solves a per-keyframe $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ pose graph with log-scale regularization to correct scale drift while separating optical-flow translation directions from depth-based magnitudes. Finally, omnidirectional Gaussian fusion transforms each Gaussian with its keyframe similarity and renders Gaussians at their maximum ray response to jointly refine poses and maps. Experiments on indoor and cross-session multi-agent panoramic benchmarks demonstrate that CoSphere-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art trajectory accuracy and rendering quality among single-agent and multi-agent methods. Project website: https://cosphere-slam.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 密集协作建图对于搜索与救援、建筑检测和仓库自动化至关重要，在这些场景中全景相机可在单帧中捕捉完整周围环境。与小孔智能体仅在相似朝向下共享视图不同，全景智能体可在任意3D朝向下观测到重叠场景，但搜索完整旋转也会在不同对称房间之间产生相互一致的虚假回环。此外，连续单目尺度漂移会在重访表面处分裂刚性合并的地图，而短基线下的深度噪声会扭曲回环平移方向。为应对这些挑战，我们提出CoSphere-SLAM，这是首个面向全景相机的多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM框架；其球面回环检测通过快速傅里叶相关在$\mathrm{SO}(3)$上跨任意朝向对齐球面特征，并通过全局$\mathrm{Sim}(3)$一致性拒绝对称虚假回环。基于这些回环，方向性全局优化求解带对数尺度正则化的逐关键帧$\mathrm{Sim}(3)$位姿图，以校正尺度漂移，同时将光流平移方向与基于深度的幅值分离。最后，全向高斯融合利用每个高斯的关键帧相似度对其进行变换，并在其最大射线响应处渲染高斯，以联合优化位姿和地图。在室内和跨会话多智能体全景基准上的实验表明，CoSphere-SLAM在单智能体和多智能体方法中实现了最先进的轨迹精度和渲染质量。项目网站：https://cosphere-slam.github.io。

items.title_en: Whole-genome sequencing enables improved AML diagnostics and refines assessment of TP53 allelic state and complex karyotype
items.title_zh: 全基因组测序可改进AML诊断并细化TP53等位状态与复杂核型的评估
items.abstract_en: Accurate genetic characterization is central to modern acute myeloid leukemia (AML) diagnostics, yet current standard-of-care (SoC) testing relies on multiple complementary assays. We compared paired tumor-normal whole-genome sequencing (WGS) with SoC diagnostics in a population-based cohort of 109 adult AML patients, assessing variant detection, disease classification according to ICC 2022 and WHO 2022, and risk stratification according to ELN 2022. WGS showed high concordance with SoC across variant classes. When considering all reported SoC variants together with high-confidence WGS variants as true positives, WGS showed equal to higher sensitivity than SoC for single-nucleotide variants and small insertions/deletions (97% vs 92%), structural variants (SVs; 100% vs 87%), and copy-number alterations (CNAs; 88.5% both). WGS identified clinically important lesions missed by SoC in 16 cases (15%), including FLT3-ITDs and KMT2A, NUP98 and MECOM rearrangements. Classification and risk assignments were 95-96% concordant, with WGS-driven reclassifications in 4-5% of cases, primarily through detection of cryptic SVs and myelodysplasia-related lesions. Integrated analysis of genomic alterations, including copy-neutral loss-of-heterozygosity, refined TP53 allelic state assessment and demonstrated increased genomic complexity in AML with biallelic TP53 alterations. We developed a supervised machine-learning model for complex karyotype (CK) probability, based on WGS-derived copy-number and SV burden, enabling automated identification of CK cases from WGS data. Collectively, these results support paired tumor-normal WGS as a single comprehensive assay well suited for AML diagnostics according to current classification and risk-stratification systems, while refining assessment of TP53 allelic state and karyotypic complexity.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的遗传学表征是现代急性髓系白血病（AML）诊断的核心，但当前标准治疗（SoC）检测依赖多种互补试验。我们在一个基于人群的109例成人AML患者队列中，比较了配对肿瘤-正常全基因组测序（WGS）与SoC诊断，评估了变异检测、根据ICC 2022和WHO 2022的疾病分类，以及根据ELN 2022的风险分层。WGS在各变异类别中与SoC显示出高度一致性。当将所有报告的SoC变异与高置信度WGS变异一起视为真阳性时，WGS对单核苷酸变异和小插入/缺失的敏感性等于或高于SoC（97% vs 92%），对结构变异（SVs；100% vs 87%）和拷贝数改变（CNAs；两者均为88.5%）亦然。WGS在16例（15%）中识别出SoC漏检的临床重要病变，包括FLT3-ITD以及KMT2A、NUP98和MECOM重排。分类和风险分层的符合率为95–96%，其中4–5%的病例发生由WGS驱动的重新分类，主要通过对隐匿性SVs和骨髓增生异常相关病变的检测实现。对基因组改变（包括拷贝中性杂合性缺失）的整合分析细化了TP53等位状态评估，并证明双等位TP53改变的AML具有更高的基因组复杂性。我们开发了一个监督机器学习模型来预测复杂核型（CK）概率，该模型基于WGS衍生的拷贝数和SV负荷，能够从WGS数据自动识别CK病例。总体而言，这些结果支持配对肿瘤-正常WGS作为一种单一的综合检测，非常适合根据当前分类和风险分层系统进行AML诊断，同时可细化TP53等位状态和核型复杂性的评估。

items.title_en: Ultrafast imprinting of fused ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic skyrmions
items.title_zh: 融合铁磁/反铁磁斯格明子的超快印记
items.abstract_en: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions are promising topologically protected entities for robust storage and THz transport of information. Their generation has so far relied on slow techniques or on specific magnetic structures, which limit their integration into spintronic devices. Here, we demonstrate the imprinting of antiferromagnetic skyrmions within a few picoseconds in a coupled ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic bilayer with a thermal laser pulse. We identify a threshold energy required to initiate the fused skyrmion phase and show that this can be modulated by a magnetic field, enabling deterministic nucleation of antiferromagnetic skyrmions. Compared to conventional slow field-cooling processes to control antiferromagnets we show that laser-induced skyrmion imprinting can be orders of magnitude faster and provides an experimentally feasible route towards ultrafast creation and manipulation of antiferromagnetic skyrmions.
items.abstract_zh: 反铁磁斯格明子是有前景的拓扑保护实体，可用于稳健存储和太赫兹信息传输。迄今其产生依赖缓慢技术或特定磁结构，这限制了其集成到自旋电子器件中。在此，我们展示在耦合的铁磁/反铁磁双层中，利用热激光脉冲在几皮秒内印记反铁磁斯格明子。我们确定了启动融合斯格明子相所需的阈值能量，并表明该阈值可由磁场调制，从而实现反铁磁斯格明子的确定性成核。与传统的缓慢场冷却过程控制反铁磁体相比，我们显示激光诱导的斯格明子印记可以快几个数量级，并提供了一条实验可行的途径，用于超快产生和操控反铁磁斯格明子。

items.title_en: Action-outcome coupling: a pre-investment feasibility audit for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations
items.title_zh: 动作-结果耦合：供应链运营中离线强化学习的投资前可行性审计
items.abstract_en: Prescriptive analytics initiatives in logistics, such as offline reinforcement learning and next-best-action systems, are often funded before anyone verifies that the available historical logs can support an improved decision policy. We formalise this pre-investment feasibility question via action-outcome coupling: a total-effect variance index measuring how much expected outcomes change with the logged action. Coupling provides an algorithm-independent upper bound on any policy's achievable value, expressed in monetary units per decision for both single-step and discounted sequential objectives. We also analyse the asymptotic false-licensing risk of an invalid workflow: fitting a value model and evaluating the model's greedy policy on the same data. The false-licence rate is driven mainly by the number of state cells over which selection is performed, rising from the nominal test level with one cell to near certainty with a few dozen, while overlap has a smaller effect. We then propose an audit that assigns logs to four tiers of decision support, separately for fixed and contextual policies, and returns an explicit stopping rationale. On a randomised e-commerce log, the audit endorses a fixed recommendation policy, certifying gains equal to 30 per cent of the theoretical ceiling; the remaining gap reflects bound looseness under an 80-action design. Two public logistics logs fail at different checkpoints: one because the target is an accounting identity of the action, and another because, with 27 clusters, estimated coupling stays below the design's detectability threshold even though a conservative offline learner certifies an improvement in 29 of 30 seeds.
items.abstract_zh: 物流中的规范性分析计划，例如离线强化学习和下一最佳行动系统，往往在无人验证可用历史日志能否支持改进决策策略之前就获得资助。我们通过动作-结果耦合将这一投资前可行性问题形式化：一种总效应方差指数，衡量期望结果随日志记录动作变化的程度。耦合提供了任何策略可实现价值的算法无关上界，以每决策的货币单位表示，适用于单步和折现序列目标。我们还分析了一种无效工作流的渐近错误许可风险：在同一数据上拟合价值模型并评估该模型的贪心策略。错误许可率主要由执行选择所覆盖的状态单元数量驱动，从单个单元时接近名义检验水平，上升到几十个单元时接近必然；重叠的影响较小。随后我们提出一种审计，将日志分配到四个决策支持层级，分别针对固定策略和上下文策略，并返回明确的停止理由。在一个随机化电子商务日志上，该审计支持一项固定推荐策略，证明收益等于理论上限的30%；剩余差距反映了80动作设计下界的松弛性。两个公开物流日志在不同检查点失败：一个是因为目标值是动作的会计恒等式，另一个是因为在27个簇下，估计的耦合低于设计的可检测性阈值，即使一个保守的离线学习器在30个种子中的29个上证明有改进。

items.title_en: Bookkeeping Is Not Judgement: EJBench, an Engineering Judgement Benchmark Built from a Conjugate Heat Transfer Design Campaign
items.title_zh: 记账不是判断：EJBench，一个源自共轭传热设计活动的工程判断基准
items.abstract_en: We introduce EJBench, a benchmark of engineering judgement: whether a model can predict how a design behaves at new conditions from a few earlier results, and decide on it. Unlike engineering benchmarks that test whether an agent can operate simulation or CAD software, EJBench is software-agnostic and asks what an engineer would conclude without running a simulation. Its tasks come from a conjugate heat transfer design campaign for battery cold plates, in three families: matching unlabelled test results to their operating points, choosing which stored runs to reveal before signing off a design, and ranking new duties by peak cell temperature. Every answer is taken from a converged simulation, not from an LLM judge. The best of ten frontier models, GPT-6 Astra, scores 0.71, and models state almost the same confidence on tasks they get wrong as on tasks they get right. We also post-train Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA and reinforcement learning, rewarded by the share of answer criteria the simulation results confirm; on the held-out test split its score rises from 0.071 to 0.106. We release the train, validation and test splits, the evaluation harness and the leaderboard.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍EJBench，一个工程判断基准：模型能否根据少量早期结果预测设计在新条件下的行为，并据此作出决定。与测试智能体能否操作仿真或CAD软件的工程基准不同，EJBench与软件无关，考察工程师在不运行仿真时会得出什么结论。其任务来自电池冷板的共轭传热设计活动，分为三类：将无标签测试结果匹配到其运行工况点；在签署设计前选择揭示哪些已存储运行；以及按峰值电芯温度对新工况排序。每个答案均取自收敛的仿真，而非LLM评判器。十个前沿模型中最好的GPT-6 Astra得分为0.71，且模型在答错任务上给出的置信度与答对任务几乎相同。我们还使用LoRA和强化学习对Qwen3.5-9B进行后训练，奖励为仿真结果确认的答案标准所占比例；在留出测试集上，其得分从0.071升至0.106。我们发布训练、验证和测试划分、评估工具及排行榜。

items.title_en: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning
items.title_zh: WinDEX：面向灵巧遥操作与策略学习的野外度量级三维手部运动重建
items.abstract_en: Human manipulation data are widely used to train robots for human-like dexterity. However, low-cost, large-scale collection in the wild remains challenging. Existing methods remain limited in geometrically grounded metric-scale reconstruction, real-world generalization and inference speed. We present WinDEX, integrating (1) geometric-temporal optimization for metric 3D hand annotation from in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, combined with visual-inertial SLAM for world-frame reconstruction; (2) WinDEX-Net, an end-to-end, fisheye-native network combining calibrated stereo, local detail and temporal context, with a data-model flywheel of model-assisted annotation and retraining; (3) distilled models for offline reconstruction and causal streaming, supporting reinforcement learning and teleoperation; and (4) low-cost CyberCap stereo-inertial capture, forming the WinDEX-Hand dataset with 1,000 hours of training annotations and held-out human-annotated in-the-wild 2D and independent optical motion-capture evaluation sets. Offline reconstruction runs at 43.61 FPS and causal streaming at 171 FPS. On held-out data, offline reconstruction achieves state-of-the-art accuracy: 14.5 pixels in-the-wild reprojection error and, with visual-inertial odometry, 37.29 mm world-frame joint error. We achieve 7.6 and 3.6 times the task success rates of reinforcement learning policies trained with WiLoR and HaWoR motion references, respectively, and demonstrate real-time arm-hand teleoperation. Project website: https://fruitrabbit.github.io/WinDEX/.
items.abstract_zh: 人类操作数据被广泛用于训练机器人的类人灵巧性，但野外低成本、大规模采集仍很困难，现有方法在度量尺度几何重建、真实场景泛化与推理速度上均有不足。本文提出 WinDEX，包括：从野外第一视角双目视频做几何—时序优化，获得度量级三维手部标注，并结合视觉惯性 SLAM 重建世界坐标系；WinDEX-Net，一种原生鱼眼的端到端网络，融合标定双目、局部细节与时序上下文，并构建模型辅助标注与再训练的数据—模型飞轮；面向离线重建与因果流式推理的蒸馏模型，支持强化学习与遥操作；低成本 CyberCap 双目惯性采集设备，构建含 1000 小时训练标注的 WinDEX-Hand 数据集。离线重建达 43.61 FPS、流式 171 FPS，野外重投影误差 14.5 像素，世界系关节误差 37.29 毫米。
items.highlight_zh: 野外双目视频实现度量级手部重建，策略成功率提升 7.6 倍
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：要让机器人学会类人的灵巧操作，最直接的办法是用大量人类操作数据来训练；但专业动捕实验室成本高，难以规模化，而“野外”随手拍的数据又缺少准确的度量尺度标注，模型在新场景泛化差、推理慢，难以直接服务于遥操作与强化学习。
2. 用了什么方法：作者搭了一套完整流水线。其一是几何加时序优化，从第一视角双目视频中解出带真实物理尺度（而非只看图像）的三维手部姿态，并用视觉惯性 SLAM 把结果放到统一的世界坐标系里。其二是 WinDEX-Net：直接把鱼眼图像喂进网络，端到端输出手部运动，内部同时利用标定好的双目几何、局部细节与时序上下文；再用“模型先标注、人工抽检、重新训练”的方式形成数据与模型互相促进的飞轮。其三是从大模型蒸馏出两个版本：一个用于离线高精度重建，一个因果流式版本用于实时推理，分别对应数据集标注与在线遥操作。其四是自研低成本双目加惯性传感器的手部采集设备 CyberCap，由此建成 WinDEX-Hand 数据集，含约 1000 小时训练标注，并额外保留人工标注的野外二维评测集与独立光学动捕评测集，以保证评估公正。
3. 有什么结果：离线重建速度 43.61 FPS，流式推理 171 FPS；在留出数据上，野外重投影误差为 14.5 像素，结合视觉惯性里程计后世界系关节误差为 37.29 毫米；用该数据作为运动参考训练强化学习策略，任务成功率分别达到使用 WiLoR 与 HaWoR 参考数据时的 7.6 倍与 3.6 倍，并演示了实时的手臂—手遥操作。
4. 为何重要：它把“便宜采集—自动标注—模型训练—在线部署”连成闭环，让灵巧操作数据不再依赖昂贵实验室，为机器人在真实世界学操作提供了可扩展的数据基础。

items.title_en: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
items.title_zh: TRIDENT：面向水下三维机器人视觉感知的去雾、深度与不确定性估计的高效三任务学习
items.abstract_en: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home
items.abstract_zh: 水下视觉系统常因不可避免的光传播而出现纹理模糊和色彩对比度低。这些问题会显著降低稳定机器人操作的感知能力。本文提出一种新的基于学习的传感系统，用于处理水下多维视觉任务；具体而言，我们处理三维视觉系统的图像增强、深度估计和不确定性。此外，我们提出一种快速轻量的TRIDENT模型；TRIDENT由三个并行解码器和一个主干结构组成，以实现高效特征共享。该模型被设计为可训练以表达复杂参数化。在多个标准数据集上的实验评估中，我们证明TRIDENT在图像增强和深度估计上显著优于其他现有方法。尽管执行三项任务，我们的模型在内存大小和推理时间上均比其他方法更高效。最后，我们的联合学习方法在特征匹配中表现出鲁棒性，并可从二维视觉任务无缝扩展到三维视觉任务。补充材料见https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home。

items.title_en: OCCAM: Improved Single-Cell Representation Learning and Perturbation Effect Prediction
items.title_zh: OCCAM：改进的单细胞表示学习与扰动效应预测
items.abstract_en: Predicting the effects of genetic perturbations requires models that generalize beyond observed cell contexts and gene combinations. We introduce Occam, a multilayer perceptron (MLP) framework for representation learning and perturbation-effect prediction. Occam combines cell representations learned through denoising with gene interaction, text, and protein-sequence features. It achieves the highest aggregate representation scores for perturbation information and cell-type preservation with batch integration. In cross-context few-shot prediction, a perturbation and a cell context are each observed during training, but never together. Occam better captures the measured response patterns for these unobserved combinations than four retrained competitors or direct transfer of the same perturbation's measured effects from other training cell lines. Without fine-tuning, Occam best distinguishes perturbations among the evaluated models and simple baselines in cell lines held out from predictor training, across seen and unseen assays. Predicting expression levels accurately in these settings remains challenging. For double perturbations, which target two genes simultaneously, Occam composes learned single-gene responses to better capture the combined response and reduce expression error compared with competing models and summed single-gene effects. These gains extend to both strongly additive and weakly additive responses. Together, these results support simple MLPs for cell representation learning and perturbation-effect prediction across contexts and gene combinations.
items.abstract_zh: 预测遗传扰动的效应需要模型能够泛化到未观察到的细胞背景和基因组合之外。我们介绍Occam，一种用于表示学习和扰动效应预测的多层感知机（MLP）框架。Occam将通过去噪学习到的细胞表示与基因相互作用、文本和蛋白质序列特征相结合。在扰动信息和细胞类型保留（结合批次整合）方面，它取得了最高的综合表示得分。在跨背景少样本预测中，一个扰动和一个细胞背景各自在训练期间被观察到，但从未同时出现。对于这些未观察到的组合，Occam比四个重新训练的竞争模型或从其他训练细胞系直接迁移同一扰动的实测效应更好地捕捉了实测响应模式。在没有微调的情况下，在预测器训练中留出的细胞系中，跨越已见和未见测定，Occam在受评估模型和简单基线中最好地区分扰动。在这些设置中准确预测表达水平仍然具有挑战性。对于同时靶向两个基因的双扰动，Occam组合学习到的单基因响应，与竞争模型和单基因效应相加相比，更好地捕捉联合响应并降低表达误差。这些增益扩展到强加性和弱加性响应。总之，这些结果支持使用简单MLP进行跨背景和基因组合的细胞表示学习与扰动效应预测。

items.title_en: Intrinsic Berry Curvature on the Higher-order Poincare Sphere
items.title_zh: 高阶庞加莱球上的内禀贝里曲率
items.abstract_en: Higer-order geometric phase enable versatile spin-orbit manipulation of structured light . Con ventional theories describe this phase via a total-angular-momentum dependent Berry curvature . We develop an intrinsic theory restricted to the effective two-dimensional subspace, where the Berry curvature is independent of the topological charge of the light field . In our framework, the total-angular-momentum difference does not alter the effective monopole strength, whereas it controls the solid angle enclosed by the trajectory of the state evolution, insteadly. Our theory provides a different topological interpretation of geometric phase of the structured light, which unifies the underlying structures of generalized Poincare Spheres. Furthermore, it does not impose any specific form on the physical operation of the optical element, naturally encomoassing the case of previously reported experiment, and can be applied in arbitrary state evolutions in both classical structured light and quantum spin-orbit systems .
items.abstract_zh: 高阶几何相位使结构光能够实现多功能的自旋-轨道操控。传统理论通过依赖总角动量的贝里曲率描述该相位。我们构建了一种限于有效二维子空间的内禀理论，其中贝里曲率与光场的拓扑荷无关。在我们的框架中，总角动量差不会改变有效单极强度，而是控制状态演化轨迹所包围的立体角。我们的理论为结构光的几何相位提供了一种不同的拓扑解释，统一了广义庞加莱球的底层结构。此外，该理论不对光学元件的物理操作施加任何具体形式，自然涵盖此前报道实验的情形，并可应用于经典结构光和量子自旋-轨道系统中的任意状态演化。

items.title_en: DLS: Dual-Logic Graph Neural Networks with Chaos-Fuzzy Residuals for Robust Link Prediction
items.title_zh: DLS：用于鲁棒链路预测的具有混沌-模糊残差的双逻辑图神经网络
items.abstract_en: Link prediction is a fundamental task in graph mining, critical for applications ranging from biological interaction discovery to recommender systems. While Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art results, they are fundamentally limited by the inadvertent suppression of high-frequency signals, as the recursive aggregation that stabilizes structural learning inherently leads to over-smoothing, rendering node representations indistinguishable in deep layers. This limitation is particularly severe in heterophilous graphs, where structural proximity does not imply feature similarity. In this paper, we propose DLS (Dual-Logic SAGE), a novel inductive framework designed to break the over-smoothing barrier via a "controlled instability" mechanism. Unlike conventional methods relying on static structural heuristics, DLS introduces a dynamic residual pipeline. First, a Chaotic Injection Module utilizes the Logistic Map to diversify the feature manifold, exploiting sensitivity to initial conditions to separate topologically similar but semantically distinct nodes. Second, to mitigate the aleatoric uncertainty introduced by chaotic dynamics, a Fuzzy-Logic Gating Mechanism applies soft-thresholding to filter noise and retain only high-confidence signals. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DLS effectively balances feature discrimination with robustness, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in heterophilous settings while maintaining competitive efficiency on standard homophilous graphs.
items.abstract_zh: 链路预测是图挖掘中的一项基础任务，对于从生物相互作用发现到推荐系统的应用至关重要。尽管消息传递神经网络（MPNNs）已取得最先进结果，但它们从根本上受限于对高频信号的无意抑制，因为稳定结构学习的递归聚合本质上会导致过平滑，使深层节点表示不可区分。该局限在异配图中尤为严重，其中结构邻近并不意味着特征相似。本文提出 DLS（Dual-Logic SAGE），一种新颖的归纳框架，旨在通过“受控不稳定性”机制打破过平滑障碍。与传统依赖静态结构启发式的方法不同，DLS 引入动态残差流水线。首先，混沌注入模块利用 Logistic 映射使特征流形多样化，利用对初始条件的敏感性来分离拓扑相似但语义不同的节点。其次，为缓解混沌动力学引入的偶然不确定性，模糊逻辑门控机制应用软阈值化来过滤噪声并仅保留高置信信号。在不同基准上的实验结果表明，DLS 有效平衡了特征判别性与鲁棒性，在异配设置中显著优于最先进基线，同时在标准同配图上保持有竞争力的效率。

items.title_en: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
items.title_zh: 看见不等于消解：利用对话接地的视觉与语言消歧
items.abstract_en: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉接地基准通常不考虑真实场景中的上下文不确定性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个新基准——日语歧义视觉接地对话评估（JAG-D）数据集。它由人-机器人对话多模态交互组成，涵盖源自视觉和语言类别的不同类型歧义。我们评估了不同最先进视觉语言模型（VLM）在歧义识别与消解方面的能力。我们比较了对话上下文接地在视觉歧义和语言歧义消解中的表现。实验表明，VLM 可以利用对话上下文显著改善语言歧义，尤其是日语零代词的消解。我们进一步进行比较分析，以理解接地的改善是来自对话的语义内容还是其会话结构。

items.title_en: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
items.title_zh: 学习与验证进度：面向长时程视觉-语言导航的具有进度增强执行的闭环代理规划
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程视觉语言导航（VLN）要求代理跟踪指令进度，并在局部错误传播到跨子任务之前从中恢复。然而，在专家轨迹上训练的执行器在部署期间会遇到策略引起的状态偏移，并且其停止信号不能可靠地指示子任务完成。我们提出用于VLN的学习与验证进度（LeaP-VLN），一种代理式VLN系统，通过规划--执行--验证--恢复循环，将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相结合。LeaP-VLN显式地和隐式地利用进度：显式地通过进度验证器，在代理前进之前验证子任务完成，并在路线偏离时触发双阶段恢复；隐式地通过对执行器进行进度推理和动作预测的联合训练，以增强执行器的进度意识和纠正控制。为使执行器适应这种闭环接口，我们提出两阶段进度增强课程：先在专家演示上进行行为克隆，然后在演示、专家动作纠正和进度推理监督上进行联合训练。策略生成的轨迹使执行器同时暴露于子任务内漂移和子任务间状态偏移，从而使训练与闭环执行期间遇到的偏差对齐。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中，其成功率达到最先进水平；真实世界实验进一步验证了LeaP-VLN在长时程导航中的有效性。

items.title_en: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
items.title_zh: VisDrone-ReID：一个统一的多类别目标重识别基准
items.abstract_en: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 目标重识别（Re-ID）基准仍主要局限于单类别评估，限制了能够跨多种目标类型运行的统一系统的发展。本文提出 VisDrone-ReID，一个统一的多类别 Re-ID 基准，通过一套有原则的转换流程从 VisDrone2019-MOT 数据集派生而来。该流程解决了多目标跟踪标注与 Re-ID 评估需求之间的结构不兼容问题，处理了序列范围内的身份冲突、时间冗余以及缺乏有原则的身份级训练/测试划分的问题。所得基准包含来自城市环境中采集的 80 个无人机（UAV）序列的十个目标类别——行人、人群、自行车、汽车、厢式货车、卡车、三轮车、带篷三轮车、公交车和摩托车——的 9,516 个身份和 150,016 张图像。采用留一法（LOO）评估协议以提供全面评估。跨四种代表性 Re-ID 模型（涵盖 CNN 和 Transformer 架构）的基线实验建立了该基准上的首个系统性性能参考。结果揭示所有模型均存在一致的 Rank-1 到 mAP 差距，表明 VisDrone-ReID 呈现出超越最近邻匹配的真实检索挑战。按类别分析将行人识别为最具挑战性的类别，并揭示视觉-语言预训练在语义上可区分的类别上提供了可测量的优势。VisDrone-ReID 为研究真实世界监控场景所特有的尺度变化、视角挑战和类别多样性下的多类别目标重识别提供了统一平台。

items.title_en: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
items.title_zh: Calpha：迈向通用语言模型中的原生生物分子智能
items.abstract_en: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子基础模型能准确预测蛋白质及其复合物的结构，大语言模型（LLM）能用自然语言推理，但两者彼此分离：前者的能力不属于通用 LLM，后者的推理也无法进入结构预测。Calpha 的目标是构建一个通用模型，既能折叠蛋白质与复合物、理解蛋白质序列与结构，又能让其语言推理影响所预测的结构。本报告涵盖第一步：由 LLM 输出单链蛋白质结构。Qwen3.5-9B 读取经 ESM2 残基特征增强的序列，可用文本作答，或输出一个 token 调用预训练的 SimpleFold 结构头，而该结构头仅通过 Qwen 的残基状态获得蛋白质信息。在固定折叠请求下，该结构头在 FoldBench-334 开发集取得平均 TM-score 0.808，在 CASP16 结构域上为 0.635，在 CAMEO 风格 PDB 集上为 0.900。我们将其与“ESM2-3B 编码序列 + 微调 SimpleFold-3B 结构头”的基线比较，两系统在可训练权重、训练时长和裁剪长度上也不同。对 100–299 残基的链，三个配对置信区间均包含零；在 300–600 残基时，平均差异分别为 -0.044、-0.160 和 -0.025。另一项测试中，四类英文请求在所有评测样例上都成功触发折叠。蛋白质训练使 350 题 MMLU-Pro 子集准确率从 77.4% 降至 70.3%。因此，LLM 可以从自身状态输出单链结构，但在当前比较中长链得分较低，且在所评测的 MMLU-Pro 子集上准确率下降。
items.highlight_zh: 让 LLM 从自身内部状态直接输出单链蛋白结构
items.digest_zh: 一、研究了什么问题：如今的生物分子基础模型会折叠蛋白质，大语言模型会做语言推理，但它们是两套互不相通的系统：LLM 自己不会预测结构，结构模型也不会用语言推理。论文希望把它们合成一个通用模型，让语言能力参与结构预测。这项工作只报告第一步：让 LLM 输出单链蛋白质结构。二、用了什么方法：Qwen3.5-9B 接收用 ESM2 残基特征增强的氨基酸序列，它可以像聊天一样用文字回答，也可以输出一个特殊 token，去调用预训练好的 SimpleFold 结构头。关键在于，这个结构头只能通过 Qwen 内部的残基状态获取蛋白质信息，因此结构确实“经由”语言模型产生。作者把它与“ESM2-3B 编码 + 微调 SimpleFold-3B 头”的基线对比，并说明两者在可训练权重、训练时长和裁剪长度上并不相同。三、有什么结果：在固定折叠请求下，结构头在 FoldBench-334 开发集平均 TM-score 0.808、CASP16 结构域 0.635、CAMEO 风格 PDB 集 0.900；对 100–299 残基的链，两者差异的置信区间都包含零；300–600 残基时平均差异为 -0.044、-0.160 和 -0.025，即长链上偏弱。四类英文指令均能触发折叠；但蛋白训练让 MMLU-Pro 的 350 题子集准确率从 77.4% 降到 70.3%。四、为何重要：它验证了“语言模型原生输出结构”这条路可行，同时诚实地暴露了长链精度不足和通用能力受损这两个待解问题，为后续做复合物预测与推理-结构贯通奠定基础。

items.title_en: Breaking the Fixed-Substrate Limitation of Deep Learning Ellipsometry with Pseudo-Substrate Spectra
items.title_zh: 利用伪衬底光谱突破深度学习椭偏术的固定衬底限制
items.abstract_en: A machine learning method, deep learning ellipsometry (DLE), enables direct and rapid estimation of the optical constants and structures of thin films from spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) spectra. However, conventional neural-network-based DLE models are restricted to the specific substrate used during training, and applying them to a different substrate requires ~100 h of retraining. Here, we propose a framework that overcomes this fixed-substrate limitation by introducing a two-input feature-wise linear modulation DLE (FiLM-DLE). In this model, the SE spectra of a thin-film structure are input together with those of the substrate measured before film deposition, which we term the pseudo-substrate spectra. Any substrate, including a multilayer stack, is thus represented solely by its measured SE response, analogous to the pseudo-dielectric function, so that no prior knowledge of the substrate structure is required. Trained on a virtual dataset of 165 million samples representing metal, glass, and SiO2/Si substrates with different SiO2 thicknesses, a single FiLM-DLE model, trained once, extracts thin-film optical constants and structures with high accuracy and shows strong applicability to substrates not included in the training datasets. Experimental validation on 47 thin-film samples across diverse substrates yielded sample-averaged mean absolute errors, relative to conventional manual analysis, of 0.047 for refractive index, 0.030 for extinction coefficient, and 1.52 nm for thickness, with each analysis completed in under 2 s. FiLM-DLE thus eliminates the need for a separate DLE model for each substrate and enables rapid, high-accuracy optical characterization of thin films on diverse substrates.
items.abstract_zh: 一种机器学习方法——深度学习椭偏术（DLE）——能够从光谱椭偏术（SE）光谱直接、快速地估计薄膜的光学常数和结构。然而，传统的基于神经网络的 DLE 模型受限于训练时使用的特定衬底，将其应用于不同衬底需要约 100 小时的重新训练。在此，我们提出一种框架，通过引入双输入特征级线性调制 DLE（FiLM-DLE）来克服这一固定衬底限制。在该模型中，薄膜结构的 SE 光谱与薄膜沉积前测量的衬底 SE 光谱一起输入，我们将后者称为伪衬底光谱。因此，任何衬底（包括多层堆叠）仅由其测量的 SE 响应表示，类似于伪介电函数，从而不需要衬底结构的先验知识。在包含 1.65 亿个样本、涵盖金属、玻璃以及具有不同 SiO2 厚度的 SiO2/Si 衬底的虚拟数据集上训练后，单个 FiLM-DLE 模型仅需训练一次，即可高精度提取薄膜光学常数和结构，并对未包含在训练数据集中的衬底表现出很强的适用性。在跨多种衬底的 47 个薄膜样品上进行实验验证，相对于传统人工分析，样品平均绝对误差为：折射率 0.047、消光系数 0.030、厚度 1.52 nm，每次分析在 2 秒内完成。因此，FiLM-DLE 无需为每种衬底单独建立 DLE 模型，并能够对多种衬底上的薄膜进行快速、高精度的光学表征。

items.title_en: A Copper-Inducible Yeast Biosensor with Bioluminescent Readout: Mathematical Modeling, Experimental Validation, and Photodetector Coupling for Molecular Communication in IoBNT
items.title_zh: 一种具有生物发光读出的铜诱导型酵母生物传感器：用于 IoBNT 中分子通信的数学建模、实验验证与光电探测器耦合
items.abstract_en: Engineered living biosensors constitute promising model organisms for bringing Molecular Communications (MC) closer to practical applications. However, challenges associated with their development and characterization have resulted in the relevant literature being limited in the MC domain, . In this paper, we contribute in this direction by leveraging engineered yeast as a basis to detect heavy metals such as copper. The biosensor's development is supported by a validated mathematical characterization and analysis for possible integration in an MC system. Different from the existing literature, mathematical representations of the major biological processes within the yeast copper detoxification pathway are integrated into a comprehensive framework that predicts the time evolution of the CUP1 gene, which is treated as the system output. In the engineered circuit, CUP1 was replaced with GFP, therefore making GFP fluorescence the final system output. Experimental analysis including mRNA transcript quantification and fluorometric measurements, validate the GFP reporting model to a satisfactory degree. This establishes the proposed model as a useful tool for virtual experimentation and the developed testbed as a suitable platform for further engineering of yeast-based copper sensors. The theoretical analysis is further extended by incorporating a self-sustained bioluminescent reporter for yeast, replacing GFP and enabling optical output without external light excitation. The optical response is coupled to a photodetector model, rendering the system suitable for integration into mobile monitoring devices such as Smart Pills. The presented characterization of the yeast receiver as a copper biosensor, constitutes the first step towards the development and characterization of a complete end-to-end MC based system for gut theranostics after coupling with suitable engineered probiotic senders.
items.abstract_zh: 工程化活体生物传感器是有望使分子通信（MC）更接近实际应用的模型生物。然而，与其开发和表征相关的挑战导致 MC 领域相关文献有限。本文朝此方向作出贡献，利用工程化酵母作为检测铜等重金属的基础。该生物传感器的开发得到经过验证的数学表征与分析支持，以便可能集成到 MC 系统中。与现有文献不同，酵母铜解毒通路中主要生物过程的数学表示被集成到一个综合框架中，该框架预测 CUP1 基因的时间演化，并将其视为系统输出。在工程化回路中，CUP1 被 GFP 替换，因此使 GFP 荧光成为最终系统输出。包括 mRNA 转录本定量和荧光测量在内的实验分析在令人满意的程度上验证了 GFP 报告模型。这使所提出的模型成为虚拟实验的有用工具，并使所开发的测试平台成为进一步工程化基于酵母的铜传感器的合适平台。理论分析进一步扩展，加入一种用于酵母的自持生物发光报告器，替换 GFP 并实现无需外部光激发的光输出。光学响应与光电探测器模型耦合，使该系统适合集成到移动监测设备（如智能药丸）中。所展示的将酵母接收器表征为铜生物传感器，是在与合适的工程化益生菌发送器耦合后，开发和表征用于肠道诊疗的完整端到端基于 MC 系统的第一步。
