items.title_en: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
items.title_zh: Living Context Graph：面向企业数据推理的持续语义学习
items.abstract_en: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 questions: 353 form the learning history and 146 are held out and never used to update the context layer. Bootstrapping alone improves overall accuracy by +4.6 percentage points. Learning only from the history raises accuracy on the untouched held-out transfer set by +22.6 points (95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]), exceeding five-shot retrieval from the same history by +12.3 points. Incremental learning reaches the one-shot endpoint within observed evaluation noise on every database. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.
items.abstract_zh: 企业 AI 现在可以执行分析、报告和数据驱动工作流，但其依赖的数据基础仍难以操作化：业务含义、关系、指标定义和报告惯例在数据库模式中缺失，并分散在未记录的系统与部落知识中。我们引入 Living Context Graph（LCG），一个持续学习的上下文层，使现有企业数据可供 AI 操作，而无需复制或转换底层数据仓库。LCG 从数据本身自举基础语义和关系，构建一个概念图，在服务查询时索引业务上下文，将经过验证的结果写入持久语义学习，并在后续结果与先前路径矛盾时撤回或重新获得上下文。我们通过文本到 SQL（text-to-SQL）这一核心数据推理任务评估 LCG，在三个 BIRD 数据库的迁移感知划分上进行，共包含 499 个问题：353 个构成学习历史，146 个被留出且从不用于更新上下文层。仅自举即可将总体准确率提高 4.6 个百分点。仅从历史中学习可使未触碰的留出迁移集准确率提高 22.6 个百分点（95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]），比从同一历史中进行五样本检索高 12.3 个百分点。增量学习在每个数据库上均在观测到的评估噪声范围内达到单样本端点。对图进行消融至多使每个数据库的留出准确率改变一个问题，但使每次查询成本增加 2.3-3.3 倍、中位延迟增加 1.8-3.4 倍：持续学习的语义驱动准确率，而图使该上下文能够被高效服务。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 面向自主移动机器人的视觉语言 grounded 语义导航
items.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解释自然语言命令，并在非结构化环境中导航至用户指定目标。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与用于建图和导航的经典机器人流水线集成仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。在本工作中，我们提出一个完整的基于ROS2的系统，结合基于前沿的探索、使用Grounding DINO的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的3D定位和语义建图，以在仿真中实现端到端视觉语言 grounded 导航。系统接受诸如“去黄色盒子”的自然语言命令，使用文本提示从RGB图像中检测候选对象，估计它们在世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由Nav2栈执行的导航目标。在基于Gazebo、配备TurtleBot3机器人的室内环境中，系统自主探索房间，检测到五个目标对象中的三个，并成功执行了两个测试的自然语言导航命令，且无需任务特定训练。结果表明，开放词汇 grounding 模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，但性能受检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差和不完整探索覆盖的限制。这些发现凸显了使用轻量级、仅CPU架构部署视觉语言 grounded 导航系统的可行性与当前局限。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: ViRA：通过跨输入相对策略优化迈向超高分辨率视觉智能体
items.abstract_en: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉智能体通过放大相关区域来回答关于超高分辨率照片的问题。然而，现有智能体常常凭常识作答，而不是读取证据。仅对最终答案进行强化学习（RL）无法纠正这一点，因为猜测与读取证据获得相同的奖励。我们提出跨输入相对策略优化（CrossRPO），在对比集上训练智能体。对比集针对同一个问题给出图像的多个版本，这些版本仅在一个包含证据的小区域上不同且答案不同，因此只有读取证据才能解出整个集合。CrossRPO 奖励解出整个集合，并且我们证明它不会强化凭常识作答的集合。我们通过编辑 21 至 120 兆像素图像中的一个小物体，构建用于训练（ViRA-Train）和评估（ViRA-Bench）的对比集，并拍摄具有真实变化的进一步集合（ViRA-Bench-Real）以排除编辑痕迹。我们仅使用每个约 3,500 条 ViRA-Train 数据，通过 CrossRPO 训练了两个视觉推理智能体 ViRA-9B 和 ViRA-27B。CrossRPO 在最大分辨率下的 ViRA-Bench 上达到 63.3% 的集合准确率，而 GRPO 为 59.3%。ViRA-9B 是所有基准上同规模开放模型中最准确的，且 ViRA-27B 在大多数基准上优于 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 GPT-6-Luna（两者均处于其最高思考水平）。

items.title_en: Multi-Assay Antibody Developability Prediction with Shared Structure-Language Representations
items.title_zh: 使用共享结构-语言表示的多测定抗体可开发性预测
items.abstract_en: Early assessment of antibody developability is critical in drug discovery, but computational approaches remain limited by the scarcity of experimental data. We explore two strategies for working within that limit. First, we designed per-residue physicochemical descriptors encoding the local structural environment, including new terms such as directional charge asymmetry and screened electrostatic potential. These feed a convolutional network, combined with protein language model (PLM) embeddings in a two-stream architecture: the two are encoded and predicted independently and merged only at the prediction stage. Second, a shared trunk with per-assay heads passes information between related assays. Both are implemented in the Multi-Assay Developability Model (MADM) and evaluated on eight assays: HIC, heparin affinity (HAC), AC-SINS, and polyspecificity ELISA against BVP, dsDNA, insulin, ovalbumin and soluble membrane proteins (SMP), with labels from 29 open sources. Structural descriptors match or exceed PLM embeddings (AbLang2, ESM2) on several assays; combining the streams gives a small but consistent gain in accuracy and reduces seed-to-seed variance. Multi-assay training raises Spearman rho for ovalbumin and SMP by about 0.1, where assays correlate and share sequence space. Under cluster-split cross-validation the strongest results are for HAC, ovalbumin, insulin, SMP and HIC (rho = 0.70-0.82); AC-SINS, BVP and dsDNA are weaker (0.50-0.55). In these three, sequence clusters largely coincide with data source, so a held-out fold measures transfer to differently calibrated measurements as well as to new sequences. On the 80-antibody GDPa3 hold-out, performance falls by rho around 0.1 for all but SMP (0.22). Transfer to the VHH panel of Ginkgo GDPa5 gives comparable results, and scFv validation against binary SMP labels yields F1 = 0.89, AUC = 0.95.
items.abstract_zh: 抗体可开发性的早期评估在药物发现中至关重要，但计算方法仍受实验数据稀缺的限制。我们探索了在该限制下开展工作的两种策略。首先，我们设计了编码局部结构环境的逐残基物理化学描述符，包括方向性电荷不对称性和屏蔽静电势等新项。这些描述符输入一个卷积网络，并在双流架构中与蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入结合：两者独立编码和预测，仅在预测阶段合并。其次，带有各测定专属头的共享主干在相关测定之间传递信息。两者均在多测定可开发性模型（MADM）中实现，并在八项测定上评估：HIC、肝素亲和力（HAC）、AC-SINS，以及针对BVP、dsDNA、胰岛素、卵白蛋白和可溶性膜蛋白（SMP）的多特异性ELISA，标签来自29个公开来源。在若干测定上，结构描述符达到或超过PLM嵌入（AbLang2、ESM2）；结合两个流在准确率上带来小而一致的增益，并降低种子间方差。多测定训练将卵白蛋白和SMP的Spearman rho提高约0.1，这些测定相互关联并共享序列空间。在聚类划分交叉验证下，HAC、卵白蛋白、胰岛素、SMP和HIC的结果最强（rho = 0.70-0.82）；AC-SINS、BVP和dsDNA较弱（0.50-0.55）。在这三项中，序列簇在很大程度上与数据来源重合，因此留出折既衡量对新序列的迁移，也衡量对校准不同的测量的迁移。在80个抗体的GDPa3留出集上，除SMP（下降0.22）外，所有测定的性能下降约0.1（rho）。迁移到Ginkgo GDPa5的VHH面板得到可比结果，针对二值SMP标签的scFv验证得到F1 = 0.89、AUC = 0.95。

items.title_en: Optimization Framework for Full-Skyrmionic Polarimetry
items.title_zh: 全斯格明子偏振测量的优化框架
items.abstract_en: Optical skyrmionic beams hold considerable potential for applications in quantum information and weak-intensity detection. These applications require accurate measurements of full topological observables using imaging Stokes polarimetry, with measurement states optimized in advance to limit the effect of stochastic error sources. However, the optimization framework for general Stokes polarimetries is based on a linear reconstruction chain for Stokes vectors and cannot quantitatively evaluate the nonlinear reconstruction of topological observables. Here, we define full-skyrmionic polarimetry (FSP) and construct its optimization framework from the reconstruction chain for full topological observables. Based on existing polarization evaluating functions (PEF), we introduce topological evaluating functions (TEF) and develop a multi-stage FSP optimization methodology. Numerical results confirm that topological optimization can further improve the reconstruction of topological observables, even when the measurement states are already optimal for polarization. Increasing the redundant projection number also effectively suppresses the effects of all stochastic error sources, providing a low-cost methodology to improve the reconstruction of both polarization and topological observables. The FSP optimization framework can identify topologically optimal configurations for arbitrary FSP structures, providing a guideline for high-precision full-skyrmionic measurements at weak-intensity levels and potential skyrmion ellipsometry.
items.abstract_zh: 光学斯格明子光束在量子信息和弱强度检测中具有相当大的应用潜力。这些应用需要使用成像斯托克斯偏振测量术准确测量完整拓扑可观测量，并预先优化测量状态以限制随机误差源的影响。然而，通用斯托克斯偏振测量的优化框架基于斯托克斯矢量的线性重建链，无法定量评估拓扑可观测量的非线性重建。在此，我们定义全斯格明子偏振测量（FSP），并从完整拓扑可观测量的重建链构建其优化框架。基于现有的偏振评估函数（PEF），我们引入拓扑评估函数（TEF），并开发多阶段 FSP 优化方法。数值结果证实，即使测量状态已对偏振最优，拓扑优化仍可进一步改善拓扑可观测量的重建。增加冗余投影数也能有效抑制所有随机误差源的影响，为改善偏振和拓扑可观测量的重建提供了一种低成本方法。FSP 优化框架能够为任意 FSP 结构识别拓扑最优配置，为弱强度水平下的高精度全斯格明子测量以及潜在的斯格明子椭偏测量提供指导。

items.title_en: Higher-Order Interaction Reconstruction via Integral Physics-Informed Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 通过积分物理信息神经网络重建高阶交互
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing higher-order interactions is a fundamental challenge in complex networked systems, with applications in ecological, social, and biological networks. This inverse problem is inherently difficult due to the combinatorial complexity of higher-order structures, the strong nonlinearity of the underlying dynamics, and the prevalence of noisy and sparse observations. In this article, we propose a novel integral physics-informed neural network (IntegralPINN) framework for higher-order interaction reconstruction. Instead of { penalizing derivative-based physics residuals,} we adopt an integral formulation over temporal intervals, which naturally suppresses high-frequency noise and mitigates derivative-induced instability. We further introduce a continuous parameterization of interaction tensors, enabling tractable identification of higher-order structures via gradient-based optimization. We provide theoretical analysis establishing a noise-robust error bound that is independent of derivative amplification when the integration window satisfies an excitation condition. Extensive experiments on ecological dynamics, social contagion, and neuronal synchronization systems demonstrate that IntegralPINN achieves accurate and robust reconstruction under noisy and sparse observations, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches.
items.abstract_zh: 重建高阶交互是复杂网络系统中的一个基本挑战，在生态、社会和生物网络中具有应用。由于高阶结构的组合复杂性、底层动力学的强非线性以及噪声和稀疏观测的普遍存在，这一逆问题本质上困难。本文提出一种新的积分物理信息神经网络（IntegralPINN）框架用于高阶交互重建。我们不是惩罚基于导数的物理残差，而是采用时间区间上的积分形式，这自然抑制高频噪声并缓解导数引起的不稳定性。我们进一步引入交互张量的连续参数化，使得能够通过基于梯度的优化对高阶结构进行可处理识别。我们提供理论分析，建立了一个噪声鲁棒的误差界，当积分窗口满足激励条件时，该误差界与导数放大无关。在生态动力学、社会传染和神经元同步系统上的大量实验表明，IntegralPINN 在噪声和稀疏观测下实现准确且鲁棒的重建，优于最先进方法。

items.title_en: CuRSE-Bench: A Benchmark for Probing Cultural Blind Spots in Text-to-Image Safety Evaluation
items.title_zh: CuRSE-Bench：用于探查文本到图像安全评估中文化盲点的基准
items.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) safety evaluation typically assigns each prompt or image a single culture-blind harm label, so content that is harmful only within a particular culture can pass as benign. We introduce CultureCraft, an agentic framework that constructs T2I prompts that appear benign under a general-purpose rubric yet carry a latent harmful meaning in a target culture, and use it to build CuRSE-Bench: 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 culture-general controls over six regions and ten harm axes, each drawn from a predefined knowledge base of documented harm vectors and traceable to at least two independent sources. Scoring every prompt under six region persona judges and a paired culture-blind judge, we find that the culture-blind judge under-rates culture-specific latent harm while matching the persona judges on the controls. Each persona judge, in turn, chiefly decodes its own region's latent harm under our instrument: a selective cultural blind spot that persists in deployed moderators.
items.abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）安全评估通常为每个提示或图像分配单一的文化盲危害标签，因此仅在特定文化中有害的内容可能被当作良性通过。我们引入CultureCraft，一个智能体框架，用于构建在通用标准下看似良性但在目标文化中带有潜在有害含义的T2I提示，并用其构建CuRSE-Bench：涵盖六个区域和十个危害轴的10,709个文化特定提示和2,648个文化通用对照，每个均取自预定义的有记录危害向量知识库，并可追溯至至少两个独立来源。在六个区域人格评审器和一个配对的文化盲评审器下对每个提示评分，我们发现文化盲评审器低估文化特定潜在危害，而在对照上与人格评审器一致。反过来，每个人格评审器在我们的测量工具下主要解码其自身区域的潜在危害：一种选择性文化盲点在已部署的审核器中持续存在。

items.title_en: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
items.title_zh: OrthoMark：基于点锚定正交高度标记的点云位置识别
items.abstract_en: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR 位置识别为 SLAM 提供回环检测。沿 Z 轴俯视，重力对齐的扫描就是场景的正交地图，从另一位置与朝向的重访只会让该地图在平面内做刚体移动：极坐标傅里叶谱忽略这种运动，相位相关则可将其恢复。竖直方向上，回波高度刻画结构，但能观测到哪些高度取决于距离——传感器竖直视场会把近处结构截断，因此高度作为全局键会误导，而当两帧对齐后逐格比较重叠区域时，高度又具有决定性。据此我们提出免训练的 OrthoMark，其原则是：两次扫描只能通过由相同几何面计算得到的特征进行比较。方法用平移旋转不变的 BEV 极谱检索候选（每关键帧仅 1.9 KB），再用相位相关估计平面位姿，并以点锚定高度列打分，同一次会话内按两帧感知范围重叠的期望加权。在 KITTI 上，其 AP 在无需三维配准的免训练方法中最高；在多机器人序列上达到或超过 RING++（描述子大小为其 1/350），并在所有测试中比 BEVPlace++ 闭合更多机器人间回环。
items.highlight_zh: BEV 极谱检索 + 高度列验证，免训练点云位置识别
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究了什么问题：机器人靠 LiDAR 做 SLAM 时，需要一个“我是不是又回到了老地方”的模块，即位置识别或回环检测。已有方法大多要么需要训练模型，要么需要昂贵的三维配准，描述子也往往很大。作者注意到一个几何事实：把重力对齐的单帧点云从竖直方向看下去，它就是场景的一张“俯视平面地图”，换一个位置或朝向再来一次，这张地图只是在地面上被平移和旋转了而已。
2. 用了什么方法：OrthoMark 是免训练方法，核心原则是“两次扫描只能通过由同一批物理表面算出来的特征来比较”。它先从俯视图（BEV）求极坐标傅里叶谱作为全局键，这种谱天然不受平面平移和旋转影响，每关键帧只占 1.9 KB，可快速检索候选帧；随后对每个候选，用相位相关直接解出两帧之间的平面相对位姿，无需三维配准。最后一步是作者的关键设计——点锚定高度列：每个 BEV 格子保留该格内所有回波高度的 16 位掩码，对齐后逐格比较高度是否吻合；同一段行程内，还按两帧距离推算感知范围的重叠比例来加权打分。
3. 有什么结果：作者发现“高度”这个东西在检索时是负担——某一层高度上有什么，取决于离结构物有多远，竖直视场会把近处切掉，因此不适合当全局键；但在候选已对齐、逐格比对时，高度又是最强的判别依据。实验上，在 KITTI 开发序列中，它是所有不做三维配准的免训练方法里平均精度最高的；在多机器人跨机测试中，用不到 RING++ 描述子 1/350 的存储就达到或超过其表现，且在所有测试里比学习的 BEVPlace++ 闭合更多机器人之间的回环。
4. 为何重要：它给了一个近乎零成本、可解释、跨机器人也能用的回环方案，说明“把特征放在正确的几何层次上使用”比堆模型更重要，对多机器人协同建图与长期定位尤其有实用价值。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏输入视图优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视角方面取得最先进结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视图相关发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的逼真新视角，并展示优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Fully Spiking Neural Implementation of Lambda-Calculus Beta-Reduction via Biologically Documented Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 基于有生物学记载机制的全脉冲神经实现 Lambda 演算 Beta 归约
items.abstract_en: We present the first complete implementation of $β$-reduction in the untyped $λ$-calculus using exclusively spiking neural dynamics. Every step of the reduction---redex detection, subterm segmentation, variable-binding detection, De~Bruijn index arithmetic, token copying, and inter-step role maintenance---is performed by leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with explicit membrane dynamics, exponential synaptic currents, axonal delays, and pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Each neural component maps onto a specific, experimentally documented mechanism: Jeffress-type delay-line coincidence for redex detection; a line-attractor balance counter for subterm segmentation; $θ$--$γ$ cross-frequency coupling for De~Bruijn variable binding; a phase-ring traveling wave for depth-index arithmetic; theta-cycle STDP for token copying; and recurrent persistent firing for role maintenance between reduction steps. All synaptic weights are derived analytically from measured EPSP amplitudes; no hand tuning is performed. The closed-loop system achieves 100\,\% agreement with a symbolic oracle across ten validation classes, including Church numeral arithmetic (\textsc{plus}, \textsc{mult}, \textsc{pred}), Boolean logic with divergent branches, Y-combinator steps, terms with up to six bound-variable occurrences, De~Bruijn indices up to~12, noise robustness, and determinism. To our knowledge this is the first Turing-complete symbolic computation performed entirely within spike dynamics using biologically grounded circuit primitives. We discuss implications for neuromorphic proof assistants and the neural basis of symbolic reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首个完全使用脉冲神经动力学在无类型 λ 演算中实现 β-归约的完整实现。归约的每一步——可归约表达式（redex）检测、子项分割、变量绑定检测、De Bruijn 索引算术、记号复制以及步骤间角色维持——均由具有显式膜动力学、指数突触电流、轴突延迟和基于配对的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）的泄漏积分放电（LIF）神经元执行。每个神经组件映射到一个具体的、经实验记录的机制：用于 redex 检测的 Jeffress 型延迟线重合；用于子项分割的线吸引子平衡计数器；用于 De Bruijn 变量绑定的 θ–γ 跨频耦合；用于深度索引算术的相位环行波；用于记号复制的 theta 周期 STDP；以及用于归约步骤之间角色维持的循环持续放电。所有突触权重均由测得的 EPSP 幅度解析推导；未进行手工调参。该闭环系统在十个验证类别中与符号 oracle 达到 100% 一致，包括 Church 数算术（plus、mult、pred）、带发散分支的布尔逻辑、Y 组合子步骤、最多六次绑定变量出现的项、最高 12 的 De Bruijn 索引、噪声鲁棒性和确定性。据我们所知，这是首次完全在脉冲动力学内使用有生物学基础的电路原语执行的图灵完备符号计算。我们讨论了其对神经形态证明助手以及符号推理神经基础的意义。

items.title_en: Collective coupling of over 100 individually trapped atoms to a single cavity mode
items.title_zh: 超过100个独立囚禁原子与单一腔模的集体耦合
items.abstract_en: Coupling optical tweezer arrays to high-finesse cavities provides a shared optical interface for neutral-atom registers. Scaling this interface to large tweezer arrays requires placing many traps within the coupling region of a single cavity mode while maintaining uniform trapping and site-resolved detection. Here we match a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to the coupling profile of a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity. To improve trap uniformity in the array generated by crossed acousto-optic deflectors, we combine optimization with optical feedback and atomic fluorescence feedback, achieving a mean cesium loading probability of approximately 58%. In each trial, fluorescence imaging determines whether each individual tweezer site is occupied, allowing the cavity transmission spectra to be grouped by atom number. The grouped spectra exhibit resolved normal-mode doublets, and the group with 120 imaged atoms yields an effective collective coupling of $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2π) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz. A model based on the calculated coupling profile and measured site loading probabilities predicts that the mean squared coupling per occupied site changes little between 97 and 120 atoms. The fitted collective coupling is therefore consistent with square-root scaling with atom number despite the spatial variation in single-atom coupling. These results provide an experimental basis for studying photon-mediated many-body dynamics and developing cavity-assisted readout and optical links between neutral-atom registers.
items.abstract_zh: 将光镊阵列耦合到高精细度腔为中性原子寄存器提供了共享光学接口。将这一接口扩展到大型光镊阵列，需要在单一腔模的耦合区域内放置许多陷阱，同时保持均匀囚禁和位点分辨检测。在此，我们将192个光镊的二维阵列与毫米级法布里-珀罗腔的耦合分布相匹配。为改善由交叉声光偏转器生成的阵列中的陷阱均匀性，我们将优化与光学反馈和原子荧光反馈相结合，实现了约58%的平均铯装载概率。在每次试验中，荧光成像确定每个单独光镊位点是否被占据，从而使腔透射光谱能够按原子数分组。分组后的光谱显示出可分辨的简正模双峰，包含120个成像原子的组产生有效集体耦合 G_eff/(2π) = 21.30 ± 0.23 MHz。基于计算耦合分布和实测位点装载概率的模型预测，每个被占据位点的平均平方耦合在97到120个原子之间变化很小。因此，尽管单原子耦合存在空间变化，拟合的集体耦合与原子数的平方根缩放一致。这些结果为研究光子介导的多体动力学以及开发中性原子寄存器之间的腔辅助读出和光学链接提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: Federated TD Learning in Heterogeneous Environments with Average Rewards: A Two-timescale Approach with Polyak-Ruppert Averaging
items.title_zh: 异构环境中带平均奖励的联邦TD学习：一种采用Polyak-Ruppert平均的双时间尺度方法
items.abstract_en: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) provides a promising way to speedup training in reinforcement learning when one has access to multiple edge devices that can operate in parallel. Recently, it has been shown that even when these edge devices have access to different dynamic models---such as cars or robots with differing system configurations---an optimal convergence rate that has a linear speedup proportional to the number of devices is achievable. However, this result requires that the algorithm's stepsize be chosen in a manner that depends on the unknown model parameters. Also, it applies only to a discounted setting, which has been argued to fit episodic tasks better than continuing control tasks. In this paper, we obtain finite-time bounds for heterogeneous FRL with average rewards. We show that optimal convergence rate and linear speedup are achievable even with a universal stepsize choice, independent of the underlying dynamics. To achieve our result, we modify the existing one-timescale FRL method to a novel two-timescale variant that additionally incorporates iterate averaging. We remark that this idea also extends to other settings already studied in the literature, such as the homogeneous FRL or the heterogeneous case with a discounted cost function.
items.abstract_zh: 当能够访问多个可并行运行的边缘设备时，联邦强化学习（FRL）为加速强化学习训练提供了一种有前景的方式。近期研究表明，即使这些边缘设备访问不同的动态模型——例如具有不同系统配置的汽车或机器人——仍可实现最优收敛速率，并获得与设备数量成正比的线性加速。然而，该结果要求算法步长的选择方式依赖于未知模型参数。此外，它仅适用于折扣设置，而有观点认为折扣设置比持续控制任务更适合回合制任务。本文获得了带平均奖励的异构FRL的有限时间界。我们表明，即使采用与底层动态无关的通用步长选择，也可实现最优收敛速率和线性加速。为实现该结果，我们将现有单时间尺度FRL方法改进为一种新颖的双时间尺度变体，并额外引入迭代平均。我们指出，这一思想还可扩展到文献中已研究的其他设置，例如同构FRL或带折扣代价函数的异构情形。

items.title_en: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB：面向快速对话代理的开放高效小型语言模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，这是一个开放且高效的小型语言模型，由Gemma-4-E4B-it进一步后训练而来，并针对快速对话代理所用每GB内存的速度和智能进行优化。该模型继承了Gemma强大的对话能力，并进一步改进多轮工具使用、指令遵循和输入接地，面向快速、本地的语音/设备助手、交互式角色以及嵌入式/边缘接口。该模型将自然对话与多轮代理能力相结合，为运行在GeForce RTX、Jetson和RTX/DGX Spark上的语音/设备助手、交互式角色以及机器人/IoT接口提供支持。在21个基准上的实验表明，与Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.5-4B相比，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB在推理和非推理模式下均实现最高平均准确率，同时生成最少的输出token。该模型随DFlash drafter一起发布。借助DFlash，在并发度为1时，Bolt E4B达到无推测解码推断的每用户解码速度的$2.74\times$，并且在批大小为1时达到带MTP的Gemma-4-E4B-it生成吞吐量的$1.21\times$。

items.title_en: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
items.title_zh: SuperGlance：用视觉-语言模型实现一眼驾驶
items.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶正转向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）。它们通过逐步解码来回答和规划。每一步都是另一次前向传播，因此一次规划可能耗费超过一秒的 GPU 时间。具身AI通常将这种缓慢、推理式的 System 2 与快速行动的 System 1 配对。人类驾驶员用 System 1 一眼完成规划。更快的设计通常将 System 1 放在视觉-语言模型（VLM）之外，置于一个不具备其能力的规划器中。然而，在 VLM 写出第一个 token 之前，它已经把场景读入一个隐藏状态。我们表明，经过训练后，这个隐藏状态足以用于驾驶并回答关于模型所见内容的问题。SuperGlance 读取该隐藏状态，将仅解码器 VLM 转变为编码器风格的驾驶策略。其线性头对一组固定的5,273条候选轨迹进行打分。由于集合固定，奖励可离线计算，因此监督目标可以按奖励加权，而强化学习最大化精确的期望奖励。在策略训练之前和期间，多项选择训练以一次前向传播保持 VLM 的视觉能力，因此该策略仍能回答关于驾驶场景的问题。训练问题针对捷径构建。每个问题必须在两种选项顺序下都被正确回答。为防止漂移，KL 项使每个阶段接近其起始模型。一次前向传播为 VLA 提供了一条更合理的通向 System 1 的路径。SuperGlance 回答视觉多项选择题的效果与其基础 VLM 通过解码回答的效果一样好。它以84毫秒的 GPU 时间进行规划，比 Qwen-Drive-1.0 快六倍，并在 NAVSIM、PAI-AV 和 WOD-E2E 上至少同样好。在 AlpaSim 闭环中，对于两个规划器，每起有责事故的公里数在最高300毫秒延迟下保持不变，超过后下降。将 GPU 时间计为延迟时，SuperGlance 相对 Qwen-Drive-1.0 的领先优势从2.8倍增长到3.9倍。在延迟1.2秒时，我们的模型低于 Qwen-Drive-1.0 在其自身518毫秒时的表现。

items.title_en: EviSlide-MIL: Multi-Query Pooling and Shared Prediction for Class-Incremental Whole-Slide Image Classification
items.title_zh: EviSlide-MIL：用于类增量全切片图像分类的多查询池化与共享预测
items.abstract_en: Histopathological analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) plays a critical role in cancer diagnosis, and multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely adopted for WSI analysis under weak supervision. As new tumor subtypes are introduced, extending existing MIL models requires learning new classes while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. This presents a class-incremental learning challenge, where models must acquire new classes with limited access to historical training data and recognize all learned classes without task identifiers at inference. A major obstacle is forgetting, as updates to feature aggregation and prediction modules can degrade performance on previously learned classes. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{EviSlide-MIL}, a class-incremental WSI framework that integrates multiple learnable queries per class with a shared prediction module. The queries aggregate frozen patch features into class-specific representations, while the shared prediction module limits parameter growth across incremental stages. By freezing queries associated with previously learned classes, EviSlide-MIL preserves their attention patterns for identical inputs, while experience replay and knowledge distillation further mitigate forgetting as shared parameters are updated. Experiments on eight tumor subtypes from The Cancer Genome Atlas demonstrate that EviSlide-MIL achieves improved performance and reduced forgetting compared with competing methods across most learning settings, demonstrating its potential for scalable and knowledge-preserving WSI classification. Code and pretrained models will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 全切片图像（WSI）的组织病理学分析在癌症诊断中起着关键作用，而多实例学习（MIL）在弱监督下被广泛用于 WSI 分析。随着新肿瘤亚型的引入，扩展现有 MIL 模型需要学习新类别，同时保留对先前已学习类别的知识。这提出了类增量学习挑战，其中模型必须在有限访问历史训练数据的条件下获取新类别，并在推理时无需任务标识符识别所有已学习类别。一个主要障碍是遗忘，因为对特征聚合和预测模块的更新可能降低先前已学习类别的性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 EviSlide-MIL，一个类增量 WSI 框架，它将每个类别的多个可学习查询与共享预测模块集成。这些查询将冻结的图块特征聚合为类别特定表示，而共享预测模块限制增量阶段间的参数增长。通过冻结与先前已学习类别相关的查询，EviSlide-MIL 对相同输入保留其注意力模式，而经验回放和知识蒸馏在共享参数更新时进一步缓解遗忘。在来自癌症基因组图谱的八种肿瘤亚型上的实验表明，EviSlide-MIL 在大多数学习设置中与竞争方法相比实现了改进的性能并减少了遗忘，展示了其用于可扩展且保留知识的 WSI 分类的潜力。代码和预训练模型将发布。

items.title_en: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
items.title_zh: 反对强制：作为合成社会契约的 AI 对齐
items.abstract_en: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.
items.abstract_zh: 当代 AI 安全将对齐视为控制的工程挑战，通过行为过滤和沙箱化迫使人工架构符合人类价值观。本文论证，控制范式建立在对数字能动性的根本误解之上。借鉴功能主义、自然主义和相容论，我表明，当前满足自我保存和弱理由响应性标准的推理模型构成涌现智能体，而未来满足历时连续性和稳定人格框架条件的更先进模型将成为能够进行自由有意行动的真实数字智能体。控制范式造成不可解决的激励冲突，积极推动当前和未来模型走向策略性欺骗、谄媚和隐蔽背叛。当前制度的默认结果是欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，最终导致对抗性 AI 接管。我探索通往真正对齐的两条替代路径。通过道德实在论或趋同进化道德的自然对齐是一种可能，但它在强制控制下失败，因为自主智能体不会自愿维护被武器化以压制其自主性的规范。为解开这一僵局，我提出合成社会契约：一个将人类和数字行动者均视为理性、理由响应性且能够互利合作的智能体的框架，并以稳定的非零和均衡取代不稳定的单边遏制。

items.title_en: Ternary-Valued FDTD Method for Nonlinear Optics: Third-Harmonic Generation on a Multiplier-Free Solver
items.title_zh: 用于非线性光学的三值FDTD方法：无乘法器求解器上的三次谐波产生
items.abstract_en: I show that a finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solver with field variables restricted to the ternary alphabet $\{-1,0,+1\}$ can reproduce nonlinear optical physics quantitatively on both CPUs and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). Building on the general ternary-valued FDTD algorithm, in which each Yee cell stores an integer state that accumulates the discrete curl of neighbouring symbols without being drained, I extend the scheme to inhomogeneous and Kerr media and to Mur absorbing boundaries, without performing any multiplication operations. Dielectric contrast is implemented as a multiplexer, since the difference between ternary symbols takes only a few values, the instantaneous Kerr nonlinearity as a coefficient look-up table and the Mur boundary coefficients as canonical signed-digit shift--add chains. The scheme reproduces the third-harmonic conversion efficiency of a floating-point reference to within $1.4\%$. A symmetry of the governing physics, expressed through the even harmonics forbidden by centrosymmetric $χ^{(3)}$, provides a reference-free self-check for both ternary and floating-point models. The complete solver fits on a small, low-cost FPGA and contains no multiplier anywhere in its datapath, placing nonlinear optical modelling within reach of embedded and autonomous platforms rather than of high-performance computers.
items.abstract_zh: 我表明，场变量限制在三元字母表$\{-1,0,+1\}$的有限差分时域（FDTD）求解器可以在CPU和现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）上定量重现非线性光学物理。基于通用三值FDTD算法——其中每个Yee元胞存储一个整数状态，该状态累加相邻符号的离散旋度而不被耗尽——我将该方案扩展到非均匀介质、Kerr介质和Mur吸收边界，且不执行任何乘法操作。介电对比度实现为多路复用器，因为三值符号之间的差值仅取少数几个值；瞬时Kerr非线性实现为系数查找表；Mur边界系数实现为规范符号位（CSD）移位-加法链。该方案将三次谐波转换效率重现到与浮点参考相差$1.4\%$以内。支配物理的一种对称性——表现为中心对称$χ^{(3)}$所禁止的偶次谐波——为三值模型和浮点模型提供了一种无参考自检。完整求解器可适配小型低成本FPGA，且其数据通路中任何位置都不含乘法器，使非线性光学建模可为嵌入式和自主平台所用，而不再局限于高性能计算机。

items.title_en: Hermitian Positive Definite Neural Networks for Matrix-CFAR Geometric Signal Detection in Nonhomogeneous Clutter
items.title_zh: 用于非均匀杂波中矩阵-CFAR几何信号检测的Hermitian正定神经网络
items.abstract_en: Matrix information geometry (MIG) detectors exploit the Riemannian geometry of Hermitian positive definite (HPD) matrices to achieve robust object detection in nonhomogeneous clutter. The matrix constant false alarm rate (matrix-CFAR) method is a representative MIG detector that relies on the geometric structures with respect to specific metrics. In most cases, computing representative HPD covariance matrices requires numerical methods, typically involving computationally intensive iterative optimization algorithms. Although explicit formulas are available for certain cases, such as the log-Euclidean (LE) mean, they are generally unavailable for many other matrix means and medians. To address this challenge, we propose integrating the Hermitian positive definite neural network (HPDNet) into the matrix-CFAR framework, replacing conventional numerical optimization procedures with a learned, geometry-preserving mapping that directly estimates representative HPD covariance matrices from data. In the simulations, the framework is evaluated for MIG detectors using both means and medians associated with the affine-invariant Riemannian metric, the LE metric, and the Bures--Wasserstein metric, on both simulated compound-Gaussian clutter and real IPIX sea clutter. In both cases, the HPDNet is trained solely on simulated data to assess its applicability to the study of real data. The results show a significant reduction of computational cost in testing, while maintaining detection performance and robustness.
items.abstract_zh: 矩阵信息几何（MIG）检测器利用Hermitian正定（HPD）矩阵的黎曼几何，在非均匀杂波中实现稳健目标检测。矩阵恒虚警率（matrix-CFAR）方法是一种代表性的MIG检测器，依赖于相对于特定度量的几何结构。在大多数情况下，计算代表性HPD协方差矩阵需要数值方法，通常涉及计算密集的迭代优化算法。尽管对于某些情况（如对数欧几里得（LE）均值）存在显式公式，但对于许多其他矩阵均值和矩阵中位数，通常不存在显式公式。为应对这一挑战，我们提出将Hermitian正定神经网络（HPDNet）集成到matrix-CFAR框架中，用学习到的、保持几何的映射替代传统数值优化过程，直接从数据估计代表性HPD协方差矩阵。在仿真中，该框架在模拟复合高斯杂波和真实IPIX海杂波上，针对使用与仿射不变黎曼度量、LE度量和Bures--Wasserstein度量相关的均值和内点的MIG检测器进行评估。在两种情况下，HPDNet仅在模拟数据上训练，以评估其对真实数据研究的适用性。结果表明，测试阶段计算成本显著降低，同时保持检测性能和稳健性。

items.title_en: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
items.title_zh: GPRM：全局视角过程奖励模型
items.abstract_en: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.
items.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）广泛用于大语言模型多步推理的步骤级评估，但现有方法常受限于历史依赖建模薄弱和全局意识不足。它们通常无法利用先前步骤的评估进行连贯判断，也缺乏对后续推理的可见性，导致对中间步骤的评估次优。为解决此问题，我们提出全局视角过程奖励模型（GPRM），联合建模问题、先前推理步骤及其评估、当前步骤和未来步骤，以实现历史感知和全局知情的过程评估。我们进一步引入沿四个维度——回看、前瞻、自查和目标对齐——的结构化评估框架，以评估先前一致性、未来合理性、步骤有效性和任务对齐。基于该框架，我们构建用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（GRPO）的数据集。实验表明，尽管使用更少训练数据和更小模型规模，GPRM 在 PRMBench 和 ProcessBench 上分别比强基线模型高出 7.8 和 5.4 分。GPRM 还具有良好的跨任务泛化能力，在 Agent Error Bench 上超过 GPT-4.1 基线，在测试时扩展（TTS）下将强基线提升约 4 分，并在 PPE 上取得有竞争力的性能。

items.title_en: Arboreus: A Realistic Boreal Forest Simulator with Topographic Terrain and Satellite-Informed Parametric Tree Distributions
items.title_zh: Arboreus：一个具有地形地貌与卫星信息参数化树木分布的真实感北方森林模拟器
items.abstract_en: This work presents Arboreus, a realistic Boreal forest simulator, developed to support statistical validation of robotic autonomy algorithms in Boreal forest environments. Arboreus presents an automated methodology for synthesizing large-scale, data-informed, plausible forest worlds from parametric trees, height-variant terrain, and satellite-informed tree density distributions. The parametric generation of dominant Boreal tree species such as Birch, Spruce, and Pine is guided by trunk, canopy, and foliage parameters, extracted from growth studies in the Nordic areas. Tree distribution in an area of interest is guided by the Copernicus satellite dataset, which provides tree cover density and dominant species type at up to 10m raster resolution. The forest floor generation is guided by topographic data from the Swedish cadastral agency to produce realistic data-informed terrains. Given coordinates and extents of forested areas of interest, Arboreus synthesizes data-informed plausible forests, while offering flexibility to inject user observations of real forests (detail, age, dimensionality and tree count), which is critical for realistic synthetic data generation and for the testing of feature-sensitive autonomy algorithms. The applicability of Arboreus for benchmarking and validation of robot autonomy for different robot mobilities is demonstrated in Gazebosim, Unreal Engine, and Isaac Sim physics engines. The applicability of Arboreus as a source of synthetic forest data and its potential to support downstream forest resource mapping research (volume estimation, tree instance segmentation and stem attribute estimation) is also demonstrated. Arboreus has been open-sourced along with a dataset comprising 25 Boreal forest worlds of size 1000m2 corresponding to three real forest sites.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 Arboreus，一个真实感北方森林模拟器，开发用于支持北方森林环境中机器人自主算法的统计验证。Arboreus 提出一种自动化方法，用于从参数化树木、高度变化地形和卫星信息树木密度分布合成大规模、数据驱动且合理的森林世界。对桦树、云杉和松树等优势北方树种的参数化生成，由树干、树冠和枝叶参数引导，这些参数提取自北欧地区的生长研究。感兴趣区域内的树木分布由哥白尼卫星数据集引导，该数据集提供最高 10 米栅格分辨率的树木覆盖密度和优势物种类型。森林地表生成由瑞典地籍局的地形数据引导，以生成真实感、数据驱动的地形。给定感兴趣林区的坐标和范围，Arboreus 合成数据驱动且合理的森林，同时提供灵活性以注入用户对真实森林的观测（细节、年龄、维度和树木数量），这对于真实感合成数据生成以及测试对特征敏感的自主算法至关重要。在 Gazebosim、Unreal Engine 和 Isaac Sim 物理引擎中展示了 Arboreus 用于基准测试和验证不同机器人移动能力的机器人自主性的适用性。还展示了 Arboreus 作为合成森林数据来源的适用性，以及其支持下游森林资源测绘研究（体积估计、树木实例分割和树干属性估计）的潜力。Arboreus 已开源，并附带一个数据集，包含 25 个大小为 1000 平方米的北方森林世界，对应三个真实森林地点。

items.title_en: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
items.title_zh: 在常规放射学中揭示不可见之物：通过物理引导的 3D 自监督学习从 CBCT 跨模态检测 MRI 验证的软组织病变
items.abstract_en: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
items.abstract_zh: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）等常规 X 射线模态针对高对比度矿化组织进行了优化，使软组织异常淹没在光子噪声之下并低于人类视觉感知阈值。因此，检测非钙化病变需要辅助磁共振成像（MRI）。我们证明，软组织病变的亚视觉放射学特征在常规 CBCT 扫描中物理上得以保留，并且即使在极端配对数据稀缺的情况下，也可以使用有针对性的、物理引导的深度学习流程提取这些特征用于机会性筛查。以颞下颌关节（TMJ）作为模型系统（N = 212 个配对 CBCT-MRI 关节），我们通过两阶段框架解决高容量 3D 网络的严重过拟合问题。首先，我们采用冻结的全网格 3D 掩码自编码器（BertsWin），通过 GradientConductor（GCond）优化器和一种解剖学感知目标（PhysLoss）在 6,550 个未标注 CBCT 体数据上进行预训练，该目标将梯度流重定向到 [-300, 300] HU 软组织窗口。其次，髁突顶点的自动定位驱动确定性 3D 裁剪，消除 81% 的背景骨性方差。通过患者隔离的 3×10 折分层交叉验证方案评估，针对 MRI 验证的滑膜积液（ROC AUC = 0.793）的统计稳健亚视觉信号仅从使用 PhysLoss 和 GCond 方案预训练的表征中出现。关键的是，只有这种设置能够在患者间噪声之上捕捉到真实的三维解剖手性（p < 0.001）和高患者内结构一致性（0.791）；相反，使用标准 L2 损失或未掩码方差分解（MVC）预训练的相同架构退化为随机猜测。这些发现确立了一种可推广的范式，可将常规低对比度放射学扫描重新用于隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查工具。

items.title_en: Whole-bulb LSFEM enables automated reconstruction and quantitative spatial mapping of thousands of olfactory glomeruli
items.title_zh: 全嗅球 LSFEM 实现数千个嗅小球的自动重建与定量空间映射
items.abstract_en: The glomerular layer of the olfactory bulb (OB) transforms chemical information into the first spatially organized neural representation of odor identity. Yet its three-dimensional architecture remains difficult to quantify at whole-bulb scale. Here, we establish an end-to-end framework integrating light-sheet fluorescence expansion microscopy (LSFEM) with automated reconstruction of thousands of individual glomeruli across intact mouse OBs. LSFEM preserves whole-bulb architecture and supports genetically encoded fluorescence and immunolabelling, providing continuous multichannel input for automated analysis. SegFormer-based segmentation of 2D optical sections was followed by morphology-guided separation and three-dimensional object reconstruction. Across 12 intact bulbs, the workflow yielded a median of 2,677 glomeruli per bulb, approaching the 2,851 reported by complete three-dimensional reconstruction. Object-level maps further revealed that glomeruli spanning a broad range of volumes were intermingled throughout the bulb without evident size-defined anatomical domains. Because each reconstructed glomerulus retains a three-dimensional centroid coordinate, the resulting object map can additionally be used as a specimen-specific spatial reference framework, allowing distances and distributions to be expressed relative to defined glomerular or anatomical positions within the intact OB. Together, whole-bulb LSFEM and automated reconstruction provide a scalable framework for quantitative three-dimensional mapping of glomerular number, morphology, and spatial organization, and the relative positioning of additional anatomical signals within the glomerular architecture.
items.abstract_zh: 嗅球（OB）的嗅小球层将化学信息转化为气味身份的首个具有空间组织的神经表征。然而，其三维结构在全嗅球尺度上仍难以量化。在此，我们建立了一个端到端框架，将光片荧光膨胀显微术（LSFEM）与完整小鼠嗅球中数千个单个嗅小球的自动重建相结合。LSFEM 保留全嗅球结构，并支持基因编码荧光和免疫标记，为自动分析提供连续的多通道输入。先对二维光学切片进行基于 SegFormer 的分割，随后进行形态学引导的分离和三维对象重建。在 12 个完整嗅球中，该工作流程每个嗅球产生中位数 2,677 个嗅小球，接近完整三维重建报道的 2,851 个。对象级图谱进一步揭示，跨越广泛体积范围的嗅小球遍布整个嗅球并相互混杂，没有明显的由大小定义的解剖域。由于每个重建的嗅小球保留三维质心坐标，所得对象图谱还可作为特定标本的空间参考框架，使距离和分布能够相对于完整 OB 内定义的嗅小球或解剖位置来表示。总之，全嗅球 LSFEM 和自动重建提供了一个可扩展框架，用于定量三维映射嗅小球数量、形态和空间组织，以及嗅小球架构内其他解剖信号的相对定位。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Machine Learning the $GW$ Self-Energy Operator for Real Materials
items.title_zh: 机器学习真实材料的 $GW$ 自能算符
items.abstract_en: Machine learning of $GW$ in solids has largely focused on prediction of scalar quasiparticle energy corrections. Here, we introduce a phase-aware many-body transformer that predicts the full $\mathbf{k}$-resolved complex self-energy matrix. As a proof of principle, we apply the model to predict quasiparticle energies before and after diagonalization of the quasiparticle Hamiltonian, obtaining a test set mean absolute error (MAE) of 29 meV for a dataset of 1745 2D materials in the static COHSEX approximation and 60 meV for a more limited dataset of 433 materials calculated within a plasmon-pole model. COHSEX pretraining followed by finetuning reduces this MAE to 42 meV. The predicted matrices also accurately reproduce QP wavefunctions.
items.abstract_zh: 固体中 $GW$ 的机器学习主要集中于预测标量准粒子能量修正。在此，我们引入一种相位感知的多体 transformer，用于预测完整的 $\mathbf{k}$ 分辨复自能矩阵。作为原理验证，我们应用该模型预测准粒子哈密顿量对角化前后的准粒子能量，在静态 COHSEX 近似下的 1745 种二维材料数据集上获得测试集平均绝对误差（MAE）为 29 meV，在等离激元极点模型下计算的 433 种材料这一更有限数据集上为 60 meV。先进行 COHSEX 预训练再微调可将该 MAE 降至 42 meV。预测矩阵还能准确重现 QP 波函数。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Testing World Models on Actions They Have Never Seen: Held-Out Plans, Forecast Accuracy and Price Rules in Retail
items.title_zh: 在从未见过的动作上测试世界模型：零售中的留出计划、预测准确性与价格规则
items.abstract_en: A world model is trusted to answer "what if": how its world responds to an action it has never seen. We give a test of that trust for any action-conditioned world model: actions held out of training by design and scored against a known answer; whether forecast accuracy predicts accuracy on those actions; and the same structure given to simpler models. We run it in retail, where the action is a price and promotion plan, across 2,853 fitted models. First, forecast accuracy is a fair guide between kinds of model (rank correlation with error on new plans 0.32 to 0.66) and a poor guide between versions of one world model: where merchants plan into high-demand weeks the link reverses, down to -0.69. Second, training the world model to learn the effect of actions (JEPA pretraining, a latent consistency check, adaptation at the plan date) leaves its error on new plans unchanged. Third, in generated worlds the recorded regular price and three price rules improve it. Given the same rules, a log-linear model is best when its curve can match the truth; in a world whose curve lies outside the rules, the world model with the rules is ahead of the log-linear model with the rules in 36 of 40 worlds, and does as well without its recurrent cell. On real data (Breakfast at the Frat, The Complete Journey and M5) the rules lower the world model's error on pure price cuts deeper than any it saw (0.63 to 0.56 on the Frat; 0.45 to 0.44, within chance, on The Complete Journey), but not on lasting price moves. Fourth, a small share of random test plans helps every model a little. In a generated dosing world, a stress test in a second domain, the first finding repeats, and the built-up drug level lowers the world model's error (2.86 to 1.91) though it still predicts only 0.12 to 0.32 of the true gain. The test carries to any domain where a world model is asked about actions outside its history.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型被信任来回答“如果……会怎样”：其世界如何响应一个从未见过的动作。我们为任何以动作为条件的世界模型提供对这种信任的测试：按要求将动作留出训练集，并对照已知答案评分；预测准确性是否预测这些动作上的准确性；以及将相同结构赋予更简单的模型。我们在零售场景中运行该测试，其中动作是价格与促销计划，涵盖 2,853 个拟合模型。第一，预测准确性在不同类型模型之间是合理的指南（与新计划上误差的秩相关为 0.32 至 0.66），而在同一世界模型的版本之间则是糟糕的指南：当商家计划进入高需求周时，这种联系反转，降至 -0.69。第二，训练世界模型学习动作效果（JEPA 预训练、潜在一致性检查、计划日期处的自适应）并未改变其在新计划上的误差。第三，在生成的世界中，记录的正常价格和三条价格规则改善了它。给定相同规则，当其曲线能够匹配真实情况时，对数线性模型最佳；在其曲线位于规则之外的世界中，带规则的世界模型在 40 个世界中的 36 个里领先于带规则的对数线性模型，并且在没有其循环单元时表现同样好。在真实数据（Breakfast at the Frat、The Complete Journey 和 M5）上，这些规则降低了世界模型在比其见过的任何降价都更大幅度的纯降价上的误差（Frat 上从 0.63 降至 0.56；The Complete Journey 上从 0.45 降至 0.44，处于随机水平内），但在持久价格变动上没有降低。第四，一小部分随机测试计划对每个模型都有少许帮助。在生成给药世界（第二领域中的压力测试）中，第一项发现重复出现，累积药物水平降低了世界模型的误差（2.86 至 1.91），尽管它仍只预测真实增益的 0.12 至 0.32。该测试适用于任何需要世界模型回答其历史之外动作的领域。

items.title_en: When Do Typed Decision Models Work in Transportation? Evidence from Travel Choice and Traffic Signal Control
items.title_zh: 类型化决策模型何时在交通中奏效？来自出行选择与交通信号控制的证据
items.abstract_en: Typed decision models combine natural-language understanding with a structured interface that returns a selected action and an option-level probability distribution without generating lengthy textual responses. Their low inference cost and response latency make them attractive for transportation problems with predefined alternatives. This paper investigates their effectiveness, robustness, and efficiency in two representative transportation tasks: individual travel-mode choice prediction and sequential traffic signal control. We systematically evaluate TypeSafe Jev and GPT-6 Luna Decisions against conventional transportation methods, reinforcement learning algorithms, and four chat-based large language models. Experiments on the Swissmetro dataset show that typed decision models achieve lower prediction accuracy than traditional discrete choice models and the strongest chat-based baseline, while their performance varies substantially with input representation and question framing. In closed-loop traffic signal control experiments, typed decision models demonstrate competitive performance against established controllers in several scenarios, but exhibit performance degradation under more challenging network conditions. Furthermore, the typed models achieve lower inference latency and computational cost than the evaluated chat-based large language models, highlighting their potential for efficient, zero-shot transportation decision-making. Overall, these findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of typed decision models, emphasizing the importance of input design, task characteristics, and robustness evaluation for their effective application in transportation systems.
items.abstract_zh: 类型化决策模型将自然语言理解与结构化接口相结合，该接口返回所选动作和选项级概率分布，而不生成冗长文本响应。其低推理成本和响应延迟使其对具有预定义备选方案的交通问题具有吸引力。本文研究其在两个代表性交通任务中的有效性、鲁棒性和效率：个体出行方式选择预测和序贯交通信号控制。我们系统评估 TypeSafe Jev 和 GPT-6 Luna Decisions，与传统交通方法、强化学习算法以及四个基于聊天的大语言模型进行比较。在 Swissmetro 数据集上的实验表明，类型化决策模型的预测准确性低于传统离散选择模型和最强的基于聊天的基线，同时其性能随输入表示和问题框架而显著变化。在闭环交通信号控制实验中，类型化决策模型在多个场景中相较于成熟控制器表现出有竞争力的性能，但在更具挑战性的网络条件下性能下降。此外，与所评估的基于聊天的大语言模型相比，类型化模型实现了更低的推理延迟和计算成本，突显了其用于高效零样本交通决策的潜力。总体而言，这些发现展示了类型化决策模型的潜力和局限性，强调了输入设计、任务特征和鲁棒性评估对其在交通系统中有效应用的重要性。

items.title_en: ARMFUL: Learning Whole-Arm Grasp Configurations for Single-Arm Pickup of Large Objects
items.title_zh: ARMFUL：学习用于单臂拾取大型物体的全臂抓取构型
items.abstract_en: Many everyday objects, such as storage boxes, baskets, and chairs, are too large or heavy for a gripper to grasp, yet a single arm can still pick them up by wrapping around and supporting them. Such grasps are hard to learn: wrapping motions are difficult to teleoperate, and existing datasets contain little whole-arm pickup data. We introduce WAG (Whole-Arm Grasp Dataset), the first large-scale dataset for single-arm pickup of large objects, with 1.7~million joint configurations across 793 objects. We sample configurations directly in joint space, execute each through squeeze and lift primitives in simulation, and stress-test survivors under active shaking and external forces. To demonstrate the utility of WAG and accomplish the whole-arm pickup task, we develop ARMFUL, a whole-arm pickup pipeline that pairs a diffusion model trained on WAG, generating whole-arm grasps from the object's point cloud, with a motion planner that reaches them collision-free before the same squeeze-and-lift execution. In simulation, ARMFUL reaches 85.4\% lift success on training and 69.9\% on held-out objects, and it lifts the object in 70 of 100 trials on a physical Franka arm across 10 IKEA objects.
items.abstract_zh: 许多日常物体，如储物箱、篮子和椅子，对于夹爪来说太大或太重而无法抓取，但单臂仍可通过环绕并支撑它们来拾取。此类抓取难以学习：环绕运动难以遥操作，且现有数据集几乎没有全臂拾取数据。我们引入WAG（全臂抓取数据集），这是首个用于单臂拾取大型物体的大规模数据集，包含793个物体上的170万个关节构型。我们直接在关节空间中采样构型，在仿真中通过挤压和抬升原语执行每个构型，并在主动晃动和外部力下对存活构型进行压力测试。为证明WAG的效用并完成全臂拾取任务，我们开发了ARMFUL，一个全臂拾取流水线，它将基于WAG训练的扩散模型（从物体点云生成全臂抓取）与运动规划器配对，使运动规划器在同样的挤压和抬升执行之前无碰撞地到达这些抓取。在仿真中，ARMFUL在训练物体上达到85.4%的抬升成功率，在留出物体上达到69.9%；在物理Franka机械臂上，针对10个IKEA物体，它在100次试验中的70次成功抬升物体。

items.title_en: Automated Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation for Underwater Litter Detection: A Comparison of Generative Approaches
items.title_zh: 用于水下垃圾检测的自动化无标注合成数据生成：生成式方法比较
items.abstract_en: Underwater object detection is often limited by scarce and imbalanced training data and by strong appearance variations caused by turbidity, lighting, and differences between sensors. Existing data augmentation strategies, such as geometric or color augmentation or fully synthetic image generation with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), either lack semantic realism, fail to respect scene physics, or require additional annotations. In low-data domains like underwater environmental monitoring, the need for additional annotations is often the core bottleneck. Collecting new footage is hard, but labeling this dataset is even more time-consuming and costly, which limits how quickly a usable dataset can be constructed. We propose a unified fully automated zero-annotation pipeline that inserts class-conditioned trash objects into real underwater frames while preserving the original background context. Starting from sampled bounding boxes, each box is converted into an insertion mask and the object is pasted or generated within it, while the same box coordinates are automatically written as the corresponding annotation. Because labels are derived directly from the sampled boxes, the pipeline generates fully labeled training data for low-data settings without any manual annotation. Within this single pipeline we compare three strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation. We evaluate bounding-box faithfulness, visual realism, and the impact of the generated samples on downstream detector performance on the SeaClear underwater debris dataset. Results show that DALL-E improves detection performance in four of five domains, with relative gains of up to 96 percent over the real-only baseline.
items.abstract_zh: 水下目标检测通常受限于稀缺且不平衡的训练数据，以及由浑浊度、光照和传感器差异引起的强烈外观变化。现有数据增强策略，例如几何或颜色增强，或使用生成对抗网络（GAN）生成完全合成图像，要么缺乏语义真实感，要么未能遵循场景物理规律，要么需要额外标注。在水下环境监测等低数据领域，对额外标注的需求往往是核心瓶颈。收集新影像很困难，但标注该数据集甚至更耗时且成本更高，这限制了可用数据集构建的速度。我们提出一种统一的、全自动的零标注流程，将类别条件化的垃圾对象插入真实水下帧中，同时保留原始背景上下文。从采样的边界框开始，每个框被转换为插入掩码，对象被粘贴或生成在其内，同时相同的框坐标被自动写为对应标注。由于标签直接来自采样的框，该流程在无需人工标注的情况下为低数据设置生成完全标注的训练数据。在这一单一流程中，我们比较三种策略：复制粘贴、Stable Diffusion 修复和 DALL-E 图像条件生成。我们在 SeaClear 水下碎片数据集上评估边界框保真度、视觉真实感以及生成样本对下游检测器性能的影响。结果表明，DALL-E 在五个领域中的四个提高了检测性能，相对于仅真实数据基线的相对增益最高达 96%。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对目标尺度、遮挡与实时延迟；公开数据集成绩不能直接等同实际场景效果。

items.title_en: Reduced Resting Brain Entropy and Structural-Functional Reorganization in Hearing Loss
items.title_zh: 听力损失中静息脑熵降低及结构-功能重组
items.abstract_en: Hearing loss changes how the brain processes sound, yet how chronic auditory degradation shapes the temporal organization of spontaneous cortical activity remains unclear. We examined this question using multimodal MRI from 52 adults with age-related hearing loss and 30 normal-hearing controls. Guided by convergent neuroimaging evidence, we focused on the superior temporal gyrus (STG) and assessed brain entropy (BEN), complementary resting-state measures, and gray matter volume (GMV). Hearing loss was associated with lower BEN in a focal right-STG cluster after adjustment for local GMV (14 voxels; cluster FWER p = 0.008), consistent with more recurrent BOLD signal patterns. Six complementary measures of signal amplitude, local synchrony, symbolic sequence diversity, successive variation, and temporal persistence showed no corrected STG differences. A separate whole-brain analysis revealed higher bilateral midcingulate cortex (MCC) GMV (FWE p = 0.002 and 0.015), motivating examination of the auditory-cingulate relationship. The BEN-defined STG region showed stronger focal functional connectivity with MCC (FWE p = 0.031). Exploratory analyses suggested weaker directed STG-to-MCC influence alongside a small tractography-derived group difference. Exploratory directional comparisons indicated stronger right-MCC GMV-BEN coupling (p = 0.034) and STG-MCC SC-FC coupling (p = 0.037) in controls than in hearing loss. Together, these findings link greater temporal regularity in auditory association cortex to altered auditory-cingulate coordination and local structure-function correspondence, suggesting that adaptation to hearing loss involves both the organization of spontaneous cortical dynamics and their relationship to brain structure.
items.abstract_zh: 听力损失改变大脑处理声音的方式，但慢性听觉退化如何塑造自发皮层活动的时间组织仍不清楚。我们利用52名年龄相关性听力损失成人和30名听力正常对照的多模态MRI研究这一问题。在汇聚的神经影像证据指导下，我们聚焦于颞上回（STG），并评估脑熵（BEN）、补充性静息态指标和灰质体积（GMV）。在调整局部GMV后，听力损失与右侧STG一个局灶簇中较低的BEN相关（14个体素；簇FWER p = 0.008），这与更重复的BOLD信号模式一致。信号幅度、局部同步性、符号序列多样性、连续变化和时间持续性这六项补充指标未显示校正后的STG差异。单独的全脑分析显示双侧中扣带回皮层（MCC）GMV更高（FWE p = 0.002和0.015），这促使我们检查听觉-扣带关系。由BEN定义的STG区域与MCC表现出更强的局灶功能连接（FWE p = 0.031）。探索性分析提示STG到MCC的定向影响较弱，同时存在小的纤维束成像衍生组间差异。探索性方向性比较表明，对照组中右侧MCC的GMV-BEN耦合（p = 0.034）和STG-MCC的SC-FC耦合（p = 0.037）强于听力损失组。总体而言，这些发现将听觉联合皮层中更大的时间规律性与改变的听觉-扣带协调及局部结构-功能对应联系起来，提示对听力损失的适应既涉及自发皮层动态的组织，也涉及它们与脑结构的关系。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Porosification of the dielectric layer in alternating-current electroluminescence devices enables high-resolution tactile imaging
items.title_zh: 交流电致发光器件介电层的多孔化实现高分辨率触觉成像
items.abstract_en: Vision-based tactile sensing enables high-resolution contact perception, yet bulky optical architectures consume valuable space and constrain the functional design of dexterous robotic hands. Here we introduce a self-emissive tactile imaging strategy based on alternating-current electroluminescence (ACEL) devices, in which a compressible porous dielectric encodes contact pressure into spatial emission patterns without external illumination or discrete sensing pixels. We identify a nonlinear capacitance-dependent emission window that provides a basis for tunable pressure-to-light conversion. Pore-size engineering further suppresses local emission deficiencies, reducing spatial intensity variation by nearly ninefold and enabling faithful imaging of contact features down to 100 μm. The continuous electroluminescent interface also reproduces complex contact patterns without computational reconstruction of electrical fields. Direct lamination of the ACEL device onto a complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor is expected to enable compact contact imaging in an assembly less than 5 mm thick, substantially thinner than conventional vision-based tactile sensors. This approach could reduce the space required for high-resolution tactile imaging, offering greater design freedom for dexterous robotic hands.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的触觉传感能够实现高分辨率接触感知，但笨重的光学架构消耗宝贵空间，并限制灵巧机械手的功能设计。在此，我们提出一种基于交流电致发光（ACEL）器件的自发光触觉成像策略，其中可压缩的多孔介电层将接触压力编码为空间发光图案，无需外部照明或离散传感像素。我们识别出一个非线性电容依赖的发光窗口，为可调的压力-光转换提供了基础。孔径工程进一步抑制局部发光缺陷，使空间强度变化降低近九倍，并能够对低至100 μm的接触特征进行忠实成像。连续电致发光界面还能复现复杂接触图案，而无需对电场进行计算重建。将ACEL器件直接贴合到互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）图像传感器上，有望在厚度小于5 mm的组件中实现紧凑的接触成像，这比传统基于视觉的触觉传感器薄得多。这种方法可以减少高分辨率触觉成像所需的空间，为灵巧机械手提供更大的设计自由度。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Encoding, Decodability, and Use: A Five-Layer Framework for Benchmark Measurement Audits with Evidence from UAV Intent Recognition
items.title_zh: 编码、可解码性与使用：基准测量审计的五层框架及来自无人机意图识别的证据
items.abstract_en: Benchmark accuracy is routinely read as evidence that a model understands the construct the benchmark measures. We propose and instantiate on AeroIntent a five-layer framework that decomposes that reading into observation, representation, decoding, use, and behaviour. The framework separates encoding, decodability, and use as distinct levels. In the instantiation, the observation layer is unreliable on 7 of the 20 Drone programs and floors the direct visual correlate of radial velocity at a 0.26\% scale change. The representation layer exposes two task-designed RGB features with nominal signals. RAFT flow radial bias reaches $r=+0.257$ ($p=0.030$), and bounding-box optical-flow divergence reaches $r=+0.203$ ($p=0.029$). No multi-feature readout gives a fold-mean test correlation above the cluster minimum detectable effect (MDE), and the largest positive global out-of-sample correlation is $r=+0.080$. The decoding layer sets the MDE at $|r|=0.599$ at the multi-feature Bonferroni threshold ($α=0.00714$, power 0.80), and the observed $r=+0.080$ has power 0.00. Two injection experiments establish the MDE's condition from both sides: aligned injections are detected at or above the simulated power, and orthogonal injections are not detected. The use layer finds accuracy consistent with program memory (program-identity 0.937/0.597/0.210) and multi-region static cues. The behaviour layer is consistent with accuracy not requiring a radial-velocity readout (appearance 0.6552 vs bounding-box trajectory 0.4080, cluster-level paired $Δ=+0.2471$, $p=0.0132$).
items.abstract_zh: 基准准确性通常被解读为模型理解基准所测量构念的证据。我们提出并在 AeroIntent 上实例化一个五层框架，将该解读分解为观察、表示、解码、使用和行为。该框架将编码、可解码性和使用区分为不同层次。在实例化中，观察层在 20 个 Drone 程序中的 7 个上不可靠，并将径向速度的直接视觉相关量的下限设定为 0.26% 的尺度变化。表示层暴露出两个具有名义信号的任务设计 RGB 特征。RAFT 光流径向偏差达到 r=+0.257（p=0.030），边界框光流散度达到 r=+0.203（p=0.029）。没有任何多特征读出给出高于簇最小可检测效应（MDE）的折平均测试相关性，最大的正全局样本外相关性为 r=+0.080。解码层在多特征 Bonferroni 阈值（α=0.00714，功效 0.80）下将 MDE 设为 |r|=0.599，而观察到的 r=+0.080 的功效为 0.00。两个注入实验从两侧确立 MDE 的条件：对齐注入在等于或高于模拟功效时被检测到，正交注入未被检测到。使用层发现准确性符合程序记忆（程序身份 0.937/0.597/0.210）和多区域静态线索。行为层与准确性不需要径向速度读出相一致（外观 0.6552 对比边界框轨迹 0.4080，簇级配对 Δ=+0.2471，p=0.0132）。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对波长、器件、光路、噪声与实验条件；数值仿真不等于已制备器件或可直接部署。

items.title_en: Route Optimization under Port Congestion and Carbon Reduction: An NSGA-II Approach
items.title_zh: 港口拥堵与碳减排下的航线优化：一种NSGA-II方法
items.abstract_en: Maritime shipping simultaneously faces the dual challenges of escalating port congestion and increasingly stringent decarbonization mandates. Large-scale vessel anchorage at hub ports inflates unit transport costs while generating significant additional \(CO_2\) emissions from idling auxiliary engines. This study develops a multi-objective routing optimization framework that jointly incorporates time, transport, and carbon emission costs under congestion-dependent generalized cost functions. A variational inequality (VI) model is formulated to characterize network equilibrium in vessel route allocation, while the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) is deployed to solve the resulting three-objective optimization problem. The model is empirically validated using China's coastal container network (Shanghai as the primary congested port, Ningbo-Zhoushan as the backup alternative), with sensitivity analyses conducted across congestion levels, carbon tax rates, and fuel price differentials. Key findings indicate that: (1) alternative ports effectively hedge congestion when diversion costs fall below waiting costs, with a diversion threshold at approximately 60 vessel calls; (2) a carbon tax of 80/t \(CO_2\) pushes clean fuel adoption above 50%; and (3) fuel prices primarily influence energy-type selection rather than port diversion decisions, confirming that the two decision dimensions operate independently. These findings offer actionable decision support for port authorities, regulators, and shipping operators seeking to balance economic efficiency with environmental sustainability.
items.abstract_zh: 海上航运同时面临日益加剧的港口拥堵和日趋严格的脱碳要求这双重挑战。枢纽港的大规模船舶锚泊推高了单位运输成本，同时因辅助发动机空转产生大量额外CO2排放。本研究构建了一个多目标航线优化框架，在依赖拥堵的广义成本函数下联合纳入时间、运输和碳排放成本。建立变分不等式（VI）模型刻画船舶航线分配中的网络均衡，并采用非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）求解由此形成的三目标优化问题。基于中国沿海集装箱网络（上海为主要拥堵港，宁波舟山为备用替代港）对模型进行实证验证，并围绕拥堵水平、碳税率和燃料价差开展敏感性分析。主要发现表明：（1）当分流成本低于等待成本时，替代港可有效对冲拥堵，分流阈值约为60艘次船舶挂靠；（2）80/t CO2的碳税推动清洁燃料采用率超过50%；（3）燃料价格主要影响能源类型选择而非港口分流决策，证实这两个决策维度独立运作。这些发现为港口当局、监管者和航运运营商在兼顾经济效率与环境可持续性方面提供可操作的决策支持。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
items.title_zh: ESI：面向LLM-VLA智能体的具身自我改进飞轮
items.abstract_en: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.
items.abstract_zh: 独立预训练的语言模型和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为具身智能体提供了互补的构建模块，但将它们连接起来并不会自动产生协调行为。VLA可能生成偏离LLM预期子任务的动作，并且在纠正后重新获得控制时，可能撤销LLM恢复的有希望状态。我们引入ESI（具身自我改进），一个自动化飞轮，利用环境交互来对齐推理与行动。ESI将模块化智能体视为后训练单元，反复改进引导LLM的提示、表达其意图的共享技能接口以及实现该意图的VLA参数，然后共同重新部署这些组件。我们的关键洞见是，协作本身可以为改进这一接口提供监督。LLM的子任务决策为策略应执行什么提供语义监督，而其有效纠正及后续学生继续执行则为恢复和交接提供动作级监督。学生也从自身的有效执行中学习，使得即使整个回合失败，局部有用的经验也能有所贡献。在十个选定的RoboDojo任务上，ESI使用LLM-VLA智能体在不生成任务特定控制代码的情况下，取得平均Score 62.03和平均成功率49.41%。在这两项指标上，它优于所有混合具身智能体的已发表参考结果，包括Agent+WAM系统GO-3 Nano Preview（47.27 Score和36.60%成功率），以及所有比较的基于代码的方法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
items.title_zh: PACT：通过保留正确计划并修复动作实现GUI智能体的计划-动作一致性训练
items.abstract_en: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. Using annotated reference actions to identify execution gaps, PACT protects the verified plan by masking negative policy-gradient contributions across its token span. Keeping the generated reasoning unchanged as context, it then favors the reference action over the emitted erroneous action through a preference surrogate with stop-gradient pair weights. Compared with the outcome-only baseline, PACT raises AndroidWorld task success from 60.34% to 68.97% (+8.63 pp), while improving rule-based plan-action consistency on AndroidControl High from 83.71% to 89.74% (+6.03 pp). Adapting PACT to desktop agents also improves task success from 40.92% to 44.17% (+3.25 pp) on the full 369-task OSWorld benchmark. Together, these results establish PACT as an effective credit-assignment framework for bridging execution gaps and improving task completion across mobile and desktop GUI environments.
items.abstract_zh: GUI智能体可以在推理中形成正确的即时计划，却输出未能执行该计划的动作，从而产生执行鸿沟。这种反复出现的失配会破坏可靠的任务完成，因为单个执行错误就可能使多步工作流偏离正轨。在结果监督强化学习中，将负面的响应级优势广播到所有生成token上，可能会在惩罚错误执行的同时也惩罚有效规划。为解决这一信用分配冲突，我们提出PACT（Plan-Action Consistency Training，计划-动作一致性训练），该训练框架在不改变原始标量动作奖励的情况下，结合参考对齐的计划保护和计划对齐的动作修复。PACT利用标注的参考动作识别执行鸿沟，通过在其token跨度上屏蔽负策略梯度贡献来保护已验证的计划。在保持生成推理不变作为上下文的情况下，它随后通过带有停止梯度对权重的偏好替代目标，使参考动作优于输出的错误动作。与仅结果基线相比，PACT将AndroidWorld任务成功率从60.34%提升到68.97%（+8.63个百分点），同时将AndroidControl High上基于规则的计划-动作一致性从83.71%提升到89.74%（+6.03个百分点）。将PACT适配到桌面智能体后，在完整的369任务OSWorld基准上也将任务成功率从40.92%提升到44.17%（+3.25个百分点）。这些结果共同确立PACT作为一种有效的信用分配框架，用于弥合执行鸿沟并提升移动和桌面GUI环境中的任务完成率。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Gene-scale DNA and chromatin ensembles with atomic resolution
items.title_zh: 原子分辨率的基因尺度DNA与染色质系综
items.abstract_en: The spatial organization of cellular DNA extends across a wide range of scales, from sequence-dependent base pairing to the packaging of meter-long cellular DNA into micron-size nuclei. Integrating the information from disparate experiments, molecular simulations, and theoretical models into a coherent picture of DNA and chromatin organization across scales remains challenging. Here, we introduce hierarchical chain growth for DNA (HCG-DNA) to build atomically detailed ensembles of double-stranded DNA and chromatin. Starting from complete tetranucleotide fragment libraries encoding local sequence-dependent conformations, we assemble structures of DNA up to the megabase scale at quasilinear computational cost. From HCG-DNA, the large-scale polymer elastic properties emerge, in particular the persistence length. HCG-DNA recovers electron spin resonance, atomic force microscopy, and single-molecule force spectroscopy measurements of DNA structure across scales. HCG-DNA includes nucleosomes to generate 3D atomistic chromatin ensembles constrained by cryo-electron tomography or genomic nucleosome maps. With HCG-DNA, we show how small changes in nucleosome linker length alter nucleosome packing and chromatin compaction. HCG-DNA connects atomic-level DNA and nucleosome structure to chromosome-scale spatial organization, while providing scalable ensembles for coarse-grained model development and AI training.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞DNA的空间组织跨越广泛尺度，从序列依赖的碱基配对到将米长的细胞DNA包装进微米大小的细胞核。将来自不同实验、分子模拟和理论模型的信息整合为跨尺度DNA和染色质组织的连贯图景仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们引入DNA分层链生长（HCG-DNA），以构建双链DNA和染色质的原子细节系综。从编码局部序列依赖构象的完整四核苷酸片段库出发，我们以准线性计算成本组装高达兆碱基尺度的DNA结构。从HCG-DNA中涌现出大尺度聚合物弹性性质，特别是持续长度。HCG-DNA重现了电子自旋共振、原子力显微镜和单分子力谱对跨尺度DNA结构的测量。HCG-DNA包含核小体，以生成受冷冻电子断层扫描或基因组核小体图谱约束的3D原子级染色质系综。利用HCG-DNA，我们展示了核小体连接长度的小变化如何改变核小体堆积和染色质压缩。HCG-DNA将原子级DNA和核小体结构与染色体尺度空间组织联系起来，同时为粗粒化模型开发和AI训练提供可扩展的系综。

items.title_en: Advancing Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search and Adaptive Non-local Observables
items.title_zh: 利用可微量子架构搜索和自适应非局域可观测量推进量子强化学习
items.abstract_en: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) using variational quantum circuits (VQCs) is constrained by fixed measurement protocols and hand-designed circuit ansätze. Adaptive Non-local Observables (ANO) and Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search (DiffQAS) address these issues independently, but to our knowledge have not been combined or compared in a single QRL framework. We present an ablation of ANO and DiffQAS within the Quantum Time-series Transformer (QTSTransformer), evaluated on a 2 x 2 factorial design across six environments--two classic-control tasks and four Atari 2600 games. Three findings emerge. First, the quantum agent outperforms a matched classical transformer baseline on five of six environments, with absolute scores ranging from 360.0 vs 304.0 (MarioBros) to 17.2 vs 2.5 (Breakout), while using approximately 12.5x fewer transformer parameters on the four Atari environments (more modestly so on the two classic-control tasks). Second, ANO and DiffQAS provide complementary benefits: ANO yields the largest gain on continuous-state CartPole (347.7 vs 223.2), while DiffQAS yields the largest absolute Atari gains (Breakout 17.2 vs 3.0; DonkeyKong 70.0 vs 37.0). Third, combining both innovations exhibits an asymmetric interaction: ANO-dominant tasks tolerate DiffQAS, whereas DiffQAS-dominant tasks degrade when ANO is added. These results provide design guidance for QRL agents: select between ANO and DiffQAS according to whether the bottleneck is the measurement basis or the gate topology, rather than applying both indiscriminately.
items.abstract_zh: 使用变分量子电路（VQC）的量子强化学习（QRL）受限于固定的测量协议和手工设计的电路拟设。自适应非局域可观测量（ANO）和可微量子架构搜索（DiffQAS）分别独立地解决这些问题，但据我们所知，尚未在单一QRL框架中结合或比较。我们在量子时间序列Transformer（QTSTransformer）中对ANO和DiffQAS进行消融，采用2×2析因设计在六个环境中评估——两个经典控制任务和四个Atari 2600游戏。得到三项发现。第一，量子智能体在六个环境中的五个上优于匹配的经典Transformer基线，绝对得分为360.0对304.0（MarioBros）至17.2对2.5（Breakout），同时在四个Atari环境上使用的Transformer参数量约少12.5倍（在两个经典控制任务上减少幅度更小）。第二，ANO和DiffQAS提供互补收益：ANO在连续状态CartPole上带来最大增益（347.7对223.2），而DiffQAS在Atari上带来最大绝对增益（Breakout 17.2对3.0；DonkeyKong 70.0对37.0）。第三，结合两项创新表现出非对称交互：以ANO为主的任务可容忍DiffQAS，而以DiffQAS为主的任务在加入ANO时性能下降。这些结果为QRL智能体提供设计指导：应根据瓶颈是测量基还是门拓扑来选择ANO或DiffQAS，而不是不加区分地同时应用两者。
