items.title_en: Spatially local mini-batching for implicit neural representations
items.title_zh: 隐式神经表示的空间局部小批量训练
items.abstract_en: Neural surrogates based on implicit neural representations (INRs) are typically trained on mini-batches spread over the whole domain, since a generic INR loses accuracy when every point of a batch lies in one small region. We show that low-rank neural representations (LRNRs), INRs whose weight matrices are products of shared bases with coefficients emitted by a small hypernetwork, can be trained with spatially local mini-batches. Each step uses the points of one time snapshot of an adaptive-mesh numerical solution inside one small cell, with snapshots and cells drawn according to the refinement of the mesh. We posit that such training is enabled by the structural property of LRNRs, as a local step reaches the shared bases only through the $r$ coefficients of each layer, and keeps one cell from rewriting the network. By a Kolmogorov-width argument, we show that when restricted to a small cell, the hidden states of LRNRs lie close to a low-dimensional subspace, which suggests the local steps only affect low-rank subspaces of the shared bases. On six hyperbolic-conservation-law problems with solutions computed using adaptive mesh refinement, one local training recipe reaches 1.1-2.3% relative $L^2$ error with a tenth of the parameters of a dense network of the same width. Finally, we provide a comparison by training a hypernetwork-SIREN, a DeepONet, and a Fourier neural operator (FNO) of the same size with the same local batches and training budget. We observe that these baselines reach 16-78% where the LRNR reaches 4.9%. Interestingly, we also observe that local training has a significant effect on the per-cell low-dimensional structure even in a wide generic hypernetwork-SIREN.
items.abstract_zh: 基于隐式神经表示（INR）的神经代理通常在整个域上分布的小批量上训练，因为当一批中的每个点都位于一个小区域时，通用INR会损失精度。我们表明，低秩神经表示（LRNR）——其权重矩阵是共享基的乘积，而系数由小型超网络输出——可以用空间局部小批量进行训练。每一步使用自适应网格数值解在单个小单元内一个时间快照的点，快照和单元根据网格细化程度抽取。我们假设这种训练之所以可行，是因为LRNR的结构性质：局部步骤仅通过每一层的r个系数触及共享基，并防止单个单元重写网络。通过柯尔莫哥洛夫宽度论证，我们表明当限制在小单元内时，LRNR的隐藏状态接近一个低维子空间，这表明局部步骤仅影响共享基的低秩子空间。在六个双曲守恒律问题上（解使用自适应网格加密计算），一种局部训练方案在参数量为同宽度稠密网络十分之一的情况下达到1.1–2.3%的相对L2误差。最后，我们通过用相同的局部批次和训练预算训练相同规模的超网络-SIREN、DeepONet和傅里叶神经算子（FNO）进行比较。我们观察到这些基线达到16–78%，而LRNR达到4.9%。有趣的是，我们还观察到，即使在宽泛的通用超网络-SIREN中，局部训练也对逐单元低维结构产生显著影响。

items.title_en: Teaching Language Models to Narrow Boolean Patent Searches from Search Feedback
items.title_zh: 教语言模型从搜索反馈中收窄布尔专利检索
items.abstract_en: Patent prior-art searchers issue Boolean queries line by line, broadening to find relevant documents and narrowing until candidates can be screened. We distill 38,397 Japan Patent Office search reports into executable expert strategies, re-execute them, and evaluate generated strategies by citation recall and the smallest set containing each citation. Prompted models write valid, high-recall strategies but leave citations in sets too large to screen. We adapt a generator offline from scored rollouts in two forms: strategy-level learning from a screening-aware strategy score, and line-level learning from citation-preserving narrowing credit, which upweights the query lines keeping a found citation in a smaller set. On shared rollouts, line-level credit outperforms strategy-level scores on screening measures; iterated, it cuts the median citation-containing set from 768 to under 50 and places more citations in sets under 100 documents than experts, at lower recall. Strategy-level preference learning reaches near-complete recall; the two forms are complementary.
items.abstract_zh: 专利现有技术检索人员逐行提交布尔查询，先拓宽以找到相关文献，再收窄直至候选文献可被筛选。我们将38,397份日本特许厅（JPO）检索报告蒸馏为可执行的专家策略，重新执行这些策略，并通过引用召回率以及包含每条引用的最小集合来评估生成的策略。经提示的模型会写出有效且高召回的策略，但会把引用留在过大而无法筛选的集合中。我们从带评分的 rollout 中以两种形式离线适配生成器：基于筛选感知策略分数的策略级学习，以及基于保留引用的收窄信用的行级学习；后者提高那些使已找到引用保留在更小集合中的查询行的权重。在共享 rollout 上，行级信用在筛选指标上优于策略级分数；迭代后，它将包含引用的集合中位数从768降到50以下，并在较低召回率下将更多引用放入少于100篇文献的集合中，数量超过专家。策略级偏好学习达到接近完全的召回率；这两种形式互补。

items.title_en: CADENCE: Learning Acyclic Gaits for Model-Based Quadruped Locomotion
items.title_zh: CADENCE：为基于模型的四足运动学习非周期步态
items.abstract_en: Model-based quadruped controllers usually step on a cyclic gait, which lifts the legs in a fixed order on a fixed period, wherever the safe footholds are. We present CADENCE, a learned step planner with a small action space. Every 40 ms, it picks one of at most 65 discrete choices: no step, or one leg's step to a safe foothold. It also predicts a swing time. We train CADENCE by reinforcement learning on top of a convex model predictive controller (MPC). Nothing prescribes a gait: there is no gait schedule, and the reward has no gait term, only a cost per step. The one structural constraint is that at most two legs may swing at once. The policy we analyzed developed an acyclic gait, with no fixed period or stepping order, yet it still paired diagonal legs. An inverse footstep model (IFM), fitted on a controller's logged steps, turns each foothold into a command. With only the IFM refitted, on fewer than 20,000 steps, CADENCE ran frozen on OCS2's nonlinear MPC. In simulated trials on a range of terrains (26% to 49% voids) and speeds (0.1 m/s and 0.2 m/s), it succeeded in 85.1% (mean of five seeds), against 67.8% for OCS2-Trot, 65.5% for OCS2-Single, and 39.6% in a static walk ablation of CADENCE. At 49% voids, it succeeded in 72.9%, against 43.0% for OCS2-Trot.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的四足控制器通常采用周期性步态，无论安全落脚点在哪里，都按固定顺序和固定周期抬腿。我们提出CADENCE，一种具有小动作空间的学习型落脚规划器。每40 ms，它从至多65个离散选项中选择一个：不迈步，或某条腿迈向安全落脚点。它还预测摆动时间。我们在凸模型预测控制器（MPC）之上通过强化学习训练CADENCE。没有任何机制规定步态：没有步态调度，奖励中也没有步态项，只有每步成本。唯一的结构约束是至多两条腿可同时摆动。我们分析得到的策略发展出非周期步态，没有固定周期或迈步顺序，但仍将对角腿配对。逆落脚模型（IFM）在控制器的记录步态上拟合，将每个落脚点转换为命令。仅重新拟合IFM，在少于20,000步的情况下，CADENCE以冻结策略运行在OCS2的非线性MPC上。在一系列地形（空洞占比26%至49%）和速度（0.1 m/s和0.2 m/s）的仿真试验中，它以85.1%的成功率（五个种子的均值）成功，而OCS2-Trot为67.8%，OCS2-Single为65.5%，CADENCE的静态行走消融为39.6%。在49%空洞占比下，其成功率为72.9%，而OCS2-Trot为43.0%。

items.title_en: GlyphAtlas: Disentangling Stroke Detail from Layout for Scene Text Synthesis
items.title_zh: GlyphAtlas：将笔画细节与布局解耦，用于场景文本合成
items.abstract_en: Scene text synthesis requires stroke-accurate characters rendered in a specified layout, as well as visual coherence with the surrounding scene. To achieve this, existing methods commonly pre-render the target text at its intended locations to form a glyph image that jointly specifies layout and glyph structure. However, this representation ties the resolution of each glyph to its target region, limiting fine-grained stroke guidance for small, densely packed, or structurally complex text. To tackle this, we propose GlyphAtlas, a scene text synthesis framework that retains the glyph image as a spatial anchor and supplies fine-grained stroke references through a dedicated glyph atlas. The atlas renders and encodes each character or word in a separate cell, decoupling reference resolution from target-region size. We further introduce atlas-anchored attention, which lets each text region retrieve stroke detail only from its corresponding atlas cells to refine the coarse glyph structure provided by the glyph image. This coarse-to-fine conditioning simplifies stroke rendering while preserving explicit layout correspondence. We optimize GlyphAtlas with a mask-weighted flow matching objective and a timestep-weighted text perceptual loss for writing accuracy and background consistency. Random resolution augmentation of atlas cells supports adjustable atlas budgets at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GlyphAtlas achieves stroke-accurate synthesis of small, dense, and structurally complex text, zero-shot transfer to languages unseen during task-specific training, and leading performance in scenes with many text regions. project page: https://fr0zencrane.github.io/project-glyphatlas/
items.abstract_zh: 场景文本合成要求在指定布局中渲染笔画准确的字符，并与周围场景保持视觉连贯。为此，现有方法通常先在目标位置预渲染目标文本，形成同时指定布局和字形结构的字形图像。然而，这种表示将每个字形的分辨率与其目标区域绑定，限制了对小型、密集或结构复杂文本的细粒度笔画引导。为解决这一问题，我们提出 GlyphAtlas，一种场景文本合成框架，它保留字形图像作为空间锚点，并通过专用字形图集提供细粒度笔画参考。该图集在独立单元格中渲染并编码每个字符或单词，使参考分辨率与目标区域大小解耦。我们进一步引入图集锚定注意力，使每个文本区域仅从其对应的图集单元格中检索笔画细节，以细化字形图像提供的粗粒度字形结构。这种由粗到细的条件化简化了笔画渲染，同时保留了显式的布局对应关系。我们用掩码加权流匹配目标和时间步加权文本感知损失优化 GlyphAtlas，以提升书写准确性和背景一致性。图集单元格的随机分辨率增强支持推理时可调的图集预算。大量实验表明，GlyphAtlas 能对小型、密集和结构复杂的文本实现笔画准确的合成，可零样本迁移到任务特定训练中未见过的语言，并在包含许多文本区域的场景中取得领先性能。项目页面：https://fr0zencrane.github.io/project-glyphatlas/

items.title_en: FasL blockade suppresses liver metastasis and prolongs survival in small-cell lung cancer
items.title_zh: FasL阻断抑制小细胞肺癌肝转移并延长生存
items.abstract_en: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive malignancy characterised by early metastatic dissemination, frequent relapse and poor long-term survival. Despite advances in immunotherapy, durable disease control remains challenging, highlighting the need to identify therapeutic vulnerabilities beyond conventional tumour-cell killing and immune checkpoint inhibition. Here, we uncover an unexpected contribution of Fas-Fas ligand (FasL) signalling to SCLC metastatic progression and demonstrate the therapeutic potential of targeting this pathway. Using an autochthonous Rb1/Trp53-deficient mouse model, we show that genetic Fas deletion markedly suppresses liver metastatic disease, identifying a previously unrecognised contribution of Fas signalling to metastatic progression. Notably, despite this antimetastatic effect, Fas deletion during tumour initiation did not improve survival and was accompanied by pronounced alterations in pulmonary tissue architecture. As these alterations may reflect adverse consequences of Fas deletion in non-malignant pulmonary populations, we reasoned that pharmacological FasL blockade in established disease could provide therapeutic benefit while circumventing the detrimental consequences for pulmonary tissue homeostasis associated with genetic Fas deletion. Remarkably, only six administrations of a soluble Fas-Fc fusion protein over three weeks significantly prolonged survival and substantially reduced the incidence and burden of liver metastases. FasL blockade was also associated with enhanced inflammatory and immune-response transcriptional signatures in the liver, while its combination with anti-PD-1 increased pulmonary immune-cell accumulation without conferring additional survival benefit. These data suggest that the biological consequences of targeting this pathway may depend on the timing and cellular context of intervention. Together, our findings identify Fas-FasL signalling as an unexpected regulator of SCLC metastatic progression and establish FasL blockade as a promising therapeutic strategy capable of prolonging survival in established disease beyond conventional immune checkpoint inhibition.
items.abstract_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种侵袭性恶性肿瘤，其特征是早期转移播散、频繁复发和长期生存差。尽管免疫治疗取得进展，持久的疾病控制仍具挑战，这凸显出需要识别超越传统肿瘤细胞杀伤和免疫检查点抑制的治疗脆弱性。在此，我们揭示了Fas-Fas配体（FasL）信号对SCLC转移进展的意外贡献，并证明了靶向该通路的治疗潜力。使用自发Rb1/Trp53缺陷小鼠模型，我们显示遗传性Fas缺失显著抑制肝转移性疾病，从而识别出Fas信号对转移进展此前未被认识到的贡献。值得注意的是，尽管有这种抗转移效应，肿瘤起始期间的Fas缺失并未改善生存，并伴随肺组织结构的明显改变。由于这些改变可能反映Fas缺失在非恶性肺群体中的不良后果，我们推断，在已建立疾病中进行药理学FasL阻断可提供治疗获益，同时规避与遗传性Fas缺失相关的对肺组织稳态的有害后果。引人注目的是，在三周内仅六次给予可溶性Fas-Fc融合蛋白，就显著延长了生存，并大幅降低了肝转移的发生率和负荷。FasL阻断还与肝脏中炎症和免疫应答转录特征的增强相关，而将其与抗PD-1联合使用增加了肺部免疫细胞积聚，但未带来额外的生存获益。这些数据表明，靶向该通路的生物学后果可能取决于干预的时机和细胞背景。总之，我们的发现将Fas-FasL信号识别为SCLC转移进展的意外调节因子，并确立FasL阻断为一种有前景的治疗策略，能够在已建立疾病中延长生存，超越传统免疫检查点抑制。

items.title_en: Machine-learned active spaces enable quantum calculations of spin-state energetics of transition-metal complexes on quantum hardware
items.title_zh: 机器学习活性空间使过渡金属配合物自旋态能量学可在量子硬件上进行量子计算
items.abstract_en: Multireference calculations on transition-metal complexes, on classical or quantum hardware, depend on the choice of active space. The orbitals that belong in it are those that are strongly entangled in the correlated wavefunction, but measuring this entanglement requires the very correlated calculation that the active space is meant to make affordable. Here we present SpinAware, a machine-learning model that predicts density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) single-orbital entropies and orbital-pair mutual information from the unrestricted Hartree-Fock (UHF) solution of each spin state, without any correlated calculation. Each of the 20 highest occupied and 20 lowest unoccupied orbitals is described by 60 descriptors computed from the UHF solution, among them the differences between its alpha and beta occupations and energies, its metal-d and ligand character, and its exchange coupling to the other orbitals, and a transformer predicts the entropy of each orbital in the context of all others. Trained on 3454 spin-pure DMRG calculations on mononuclear Cr-Ni complexes, the model transfers to experimentally characterized complexes with ligands, binding topologies, oxidation states and metals absent from training. Over 11 spin states it reproduces the DMRG entropy profiles with a mean absolute error of 0.027, and combining the predicted entropies with the predicted mutual information gives a candidate pool that contains 99% of the DMRG-active orbitals of the benchmark spin states while keeping, on average, only 15 of the 40 orbitals. Natural-orbital occupation scans then select compact active spaces from this pool for a nickel and a cobalt complex. Sample-based quantum diagonalization with samples from IBM quantum processors reproduces the exact CASCI energies of these spaces to within 0.3 kcal/mol and their spin-state gaps to within 0.10 kcal/mol for up to 32 qubits.
items.abstract_zh: 在经典或量子硬件上对过渡金属配合物进行多参考计算，取决于活性空间的选择。属于活性空间的轨道是那些在相关波函数中强纠缠的轨道，但测量这种纠缠需要活性空间原本旨在使其可负担的相关计算本身。我们提出SpinAware，一种机器学习模型，可从每个自旋态的无限制Hartree-Fock（UHF）解预测密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）单轨道熵和轨道对互信息，而无需任何相关计算。20个最高占据轨道和20个最低未占据轨道中的每一个都由从UHF解计算的60个描述符描述，其中包括其α和β占据数与能量之差、其金属d和配体特征，以及其与其他轨道的交换耦合；Transformer在所有其他轨道的上下文中预测每个轨道的熵。在3454个单核Cr-Ni配合物的自旋纯DMRG计算上训练后，该模型可迁移到实验表征的配合物，这些配合物的配体、结合拓扑、氧化态和金属在训练中未出现。在11个自旋态上，它以0.027的平均绝对误差重现DMRG熵分布；将预测熵与预测互信息结合，得到一个候选池，该候选池包含基准自旋态中99%的DMRG活性轨道，同时平均仅保留40个轨道中的15个。随后，自然轨道占据扫描从该池中为镍和钴配合物选择紧凑的活性空间。使用来自IBM量子处理器的样本进行基于样本的量子对角化，可在最多32个量子比特下将这些空间的精确CASCI能量重现至0.3 kcal/mol以内，并将其自旋态能隙重现至0.10 kcal/mol以内。

items.title_en: From very fine Vertical Resolution to Range Super-Resolution on BIOMASS P-BAND SAR Data
items.title_zh: 从极高垂直分辨率到BIOMASS P波段SAR数据的距离超分辨率
items.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates range super-resolution over arid regions using SAR tomography data with very fine vertical resolution from the European Space Agency's BIOMASS mission. As the first civilian spaceborne P-band SAR mission, BIOMASS is operating with a bandwidth limited to 6~MHz by International Telecommunication Union regulations, yielding a native slant-range resolution of approximately 25 m. The large spatial baseline data acquired during the commissioning phase in July and August 2025 provide a valuable opportunity to enhance range resolution based on the InSAR wavenumber shift principle. According to this principle, a wider effective bandwidth can be synthesized by combining complementary sub-bands of the ground reflectivity spectrum sampled across acquisitions at different look angles. Unlike existing literature, this paper offers a novel interpretation of this problem from the perspective of SAR tomography. Furthermore, the proposed method also accounts for residual topography errors. The range resolution enhancement performance is validated using all 20 available acquisitions from the July-August 2025 commissioning phase over Lop Nur, China, and Wadi al-Hayat, Libya, achieving spatial detail comparable to optical satellite imagery in a grid finer than 2 m. Furthermore, the reconstructed range spectrum of the central Libyan oasis exhibits an effective bandwidth exceeding 70 MHz. The point spread function (PSF) of a point like target in the scene demonstrates a slant-range resolution finer than 2.1 m, representing more than a twelvefold improvement over the native resolution.
items.abstract_zh: 本文利用来自欧洲空间局BIOMASS任务的具有极细垂直分辨率的SAR层析数据，展示干旱区域的距离超分辨率。作为首个民用星载P波段SAR任务，BIOMASS受国际电信联盟规定限制，带宽被限制在6 MHz，产生约25 m的原始斜距分辨率。2025年7月和8月调试阶段获取的大空间基线数据为基于InSAR波数偏移原理增强距离分辨率提供了宝贵机会。根据该原理，通过组合在不同视角观测中采样的地面反射率谱的互补子带，可以合成更宽的有效带宽。与现有文献不同，本文从SAR层析的角度对该问题提供了新的解释。此外，所提方法还考虑了残余地形误差。使用2025年7—8月调试阶段在中国罗布泊和利比亚Wadi al-Hayat的全部20次可用观测，验证了距离分辨率增强性能，在细于2 m的网格中实现了与光学卫星影像相当的空间细节。此外，利比亚中部绿洲的重构距离谱显示出超过70 MHz的有效带宽。场景中类点目标的点扩散函数（PSF）表明斜距分辨率细于2.1 m，比原始分辨率提高超过十二倍。

items.title_en: RLDE: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Iterative Document Editing
items.title_zh: RLDE：用于可解释迭代文档编辑的强化学习框架
items.abstract_en: Improving the quality, clarity, and flow of long documents remains a challenging problem in NLP, as human editing typically occurs through iterative refinement rather than a single-pass rewrite. Most existing automated systems act as black-box generators or rely on supervised learning, limiting interpretability and failing to capture the sequential nature of revisions. In this paper, we propose RLDE, an automated end-to-end metric-driven RL framework that formulates document revision as a reference-free MDP problem (unsupervised with respect to paired document-revision targets). Working with a limited action space (NOOP, INSERT, DELETE, REPLACE), RLDE leverages Pointer Networks for dynamic span selection at the token level and sends generative actions to the frozen BART-base model to obtain context-aware suggestions. PPO agents learn to optimize a multi-objective reward function based on readability, perplexity, and grammar metrics with the help of a novel SBERT-based Semantic Preservation Penalty constraint to avoid deletion degeneracy. Evaluations on the BEA-2019 dataset showed statistically significant results (p < 0.01) across all metrics, where Flesch Reading Ease increased from 49.8 to 59.4, perplexity decreased from 63.7 to 39.8, while preserving 93% of semantic information. When compared to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompt-engineered models like GPT-4 and LLaMA-2, RLDE shows high performance at a very low computational inference cost. Moreover, the quality of edits generated by RLDE has been verified via human evaluations, scoring 4.9/5 for meaning preservation and 4.4/5 for edit quality.
items.abstract_zh: 提升长文档的质量、清晰度和行文流畅性仍是NLP中的难题，因为人工编辑通常通过迭代细化而非单遍重写完成。现有大多数自动化系统充当黑箱生成器或依赖监督学习，限制了可解释性，且未能捕捉修订的顺序性质。本文提出RLDE，一个端到端、指标驱动的自动化强化学习框架，将文档修订表述为无参考的MDP问题（相对于成对文档-修订目标而言为无监督）。在有限动作空间（NOOP、INSERT、DELETE、REPLACE）下，RLDE利用指针网络进行token级动态跨度选择，并将生成动作发送给冻结的BART-base模型以获得上下文感知建议。PPO智能体学习优化基于可读性、困惑度和语法指标的多目标奖励函数，并借助一种新的基于SBERT的语义保持惩罚约束来避免删除退化。在BEA-2019数据集上的评估显示，所有指标均具有统计显著性（p < 0.01），其中Flesch Reading Ease从49.8升至59.4，困惑度从63.7降至39.8，同时保留93%的语义信息。与GPT-4和LLaMA-2等思维链（CoT）提示工程模型相比，RLDE以极低的计算推理成本表现出高性能。此外，RLDE生成编辑的质量已通过人工评估验证，在意义保持上得分为4.9/5，在编辑质量上得分为4.4/5。

items.title_en: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
items.title_zh: Magflow：工业级 6D 磁悬浮的可微仿真
items.abstract_en: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.
items.abstract_zh: 六自由度磁悬浮原则上可实现无摩擦传输和微米级定位，但其动力学复杂且不稳定，使低层控制本质上具有挑战性。工业系统通常依赖深度的软硬件协同设计，即联合设计动子和定子几何结构，以实现电磁力计算的紧凑手工近似，从而在千赫兹速率下保持控制的计算可行性。然而，这种方法对工作空间和所支持动子拓扑的范围施加了过于保守的约束。我们没有将底层物理简化为手工近似，而是直接计算物理。我们提出 Magflow，一个用于 6D 磁悬浮的全可微、GPU 并行仿真器。它被用于训练首个面向工业级 6D 磁悬浮系统的神经控制器，该控制器完全从仿真物理中学习。我们表明，学到的神经控制器可从仿真零样本迁移到真实硬件，同时满足 4 kHz 的硬实时约束。学到的控制器实现了定性上新的行为，甚至能使一种不存在手工解方案的动子拓扑悬浮。这些结果表明，协同设计并非 6D 磁悬浮控制的物理必要性。更广泛地说，从仿真物理中学习控制可以在高要求工业领域中找出控制工程无法触及的解决方案。源代码和演示视频公开于 https://sites.google.com/view/magflow。

items.title_en: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
items.title_zh: LynnReal-Hand：以手部控制解锁世界交互
items.abstract_en: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型能够通过文本和相机控制进行探索，但直接的对象交互需要更精细的控制。手提供了自然的接口，然而由于复杂的手-物动力学和高要求的实时计算，将连续手部运动转化为连贯的视觉响应仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 LynnReal-Hand，一种手控视频世界模型，将精确的交互建模与高效的流式生成统一起来。我们整理了 10 万个交互片段，涵盖多样的真实和合成环境，并开发了手部感知监督，以改善细粒度手部运动和对象交互。在此基础上，我们学习用于少步生成的因果流映射，并引入区域感知分数蒸馏，结合互补的视频和图像先验来细化交互动力学和视觉外观。为进一步降低推理延迟，我们提出 Ultra-Fast-VAE，一种紧凑的视频解码器，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持高重建保真度。在 HandBench 上的大量评估表明，与现有方法相比，其具有更优的手部跟随准确性和视觉质量。我们的全序列模型达到 181.67 的 FVD 和 93.02 的 MANO Dice 分数，而三步因果模型保持 92.49 的 MANO Dice 分数。对于实时交互，在单张 H200 上进行 540p 流式传输达到 18.03 FPS，延迟为 741ms，优化后的峰值 GPU 内存占用仅为 34.89GB。我们将发布数据集、模型权重以及完整的训练和推理代码，以支持手控视频世界模型的研究。

items.title_en: Native-like 3D colonoids reveal mechanisms of colonic drug disposition
items.title_zh: 类天然3D结肠类器官揭示结肠药物处置机制
items.abstract_en: Intestinal organoid research in drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADME-T) has focused predominantly on small intestinal enteroids, leaving colonic drug handling comparatively unexplored. Here, we established and characterized adult colonic stem cell-based three-dimensional (3D) organoid (colonoid) models as physiologically relevant New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). Donor-matched mucosal tissue, isolated primary epithelial cells, and 3D colonoids were characterized using global and targeted proteomics, fixed and live-cell microscopy, functional ADME-T assays and targeted lipidomics. This complementary analysis identified isolated primary epithelial cells as a more representative native epithelial reference than excised mucosal tissue. Suspended differentiated apical- and basal-out colonoid configurations more closely matched this reference across the assessed characteristics. Together, these two configurations provided access to both apical and basolateral epithelial surfaces, enabling functional studies of key drug transporters (P-gp, BCRP) and metabolizing enzymes (CYP3A4, UGT1A, SULT1A) in a native-like setting. Measurement of intracellular bioavailability (Fic), reflecting drug availability to intracellular targets, revealed lipophilicity-dependent microvillar absorption mechanisms. Hydrophilic compounds exploited the enlarged membrane surface provided by microvilli, whereas highly permeable lipophilic compounds seemingly entered only at the microvillus tips. Compared with HEK293 cells, an established reference model for Fic measurements, colonoids combined native-like epithelial geometry with higher phospholipid content and generally stronger intracellular drug binding, highlighting the importance of both architecture and cellular composition for studying colonic drug disposition. These colonoid models provide a physiologically relevant platform for investigating colonic ADME-T and reveal how microvillar architecture shapes intracellular drug bioavailability.
items.abstract_zh: 肠道类器官在药物吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADME-T）方面的研究主要集中在小肠肠类器官，结肠药物处置相对未被探索。在此，我们建立并表征了基于成体结肠干细胞的三维（3D）类器官（结肠类器官）模型，作为生理相关的新方法学（NAMs）。使用全局和靶向蛋白质组学、固定和活细胞显微镜、功能性ADME-T测定和靶向脂质组学对供体匹配的黏膜组织、分离的原代上皮细胞和3D结肠类器官进行表征。这种互补分析确定，分离的原代上皮细胞是比切除的黏膜组织更具代表性的天然上皮参考。悬浮分化的顶端朝外和基底朝外结肠类器官构型在所评估特征上更接近该参考。这两种构型共同提供了对顶端和基底外侧上皮表面的访问，从而能够在类天然环境中对关键药物转运体（P-gp、BCRP）和代谢酶（CYP3A4、UGT1A、SULT1A）进行功能研究。细胞内生物利用度（Fic）的测量反映了药物对细胞内靶点的可利用性，揭示了依赖亲脂性的微绒毛吸收机制。亲水性化合物利用了微绒毛提供的增大的膜表面，而高渗透性亲脂性化合物似乎仅在微绒毛尖端进入。与Fic测量的既定参考模型HEK293细胞相比，结肠类器官结合了类天然上皮几何结构和更高的磷脂含量以及总体上更强的细胞内药物结合，突出了结构和细胞组成对研究结肠药物处置的重要性。这些结肠类器官模型为研究结肠ADME-T提供了一个生理相关平台，并揭示了微绒毛结构如何塑造细胞内药物生物利用度。

items.title_en: Performance analysis of a Rydberg atom THz radiometer concept
items.title_zh: 里德堡原子太赫兹辐射计概念的性能分析
items.abstract_en: THz receiver technology lies between electronics and photonics; as such, its implementation is not as mature. This warrants investigation into alternative THz receivers such as Rydberg atom sensors, which are highly susceptible to electric fields. In particular, the conversion architecture has been demonstrated to coherently transduce thermal radiation. This system offers room-temperature operation and does not necessarily require a local oscillator at the frequency of the input signal. We provide an assessment of the feasibility of such sensors for THz radiometry within the context of Earth observation.
items.abstract_zh: 太赫兹接收机技术介于电子学与光子学之间；因此，其实现尚不成熟。这有必要研究替代性太赫兹接收机，例如对电场高度敏感的里德堡原子传感器。特别是，已有研究证明该转换架构可相干转换热辐射。该系统可在室温下工作，且不一定需要位于输入信号频率处的本振。我们在地球观测背景下评估了此类传感器用于太赫兹辐射测量的可行性。

items.title_en: Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 相干光学神经网络中参数高效酉变换的架构原则
items.abstract_en: Coherent optical neural networks based on interferometric architectures offer a promising route toward high-throughput, energy-efficient computation by exploiting the multiple degrees of freedom of light, including spatial, temporal, and spectral modes. However, practical implementations are constrained by the number of tunable parameters due to fabrication complexity, device footprint, and control overhead. In such parameter-constrained settings, achieving high expressive power remains a central challenge. We identify two key architectural requirements for maintaining high expressive power under these constraints: (i) statistical uniformity in the implemented transformations and (ii) strong mixing capability per parameter, which enables rapid and unbiased redistribution of information across modes. To realize these requirements, we develop a logarithmic-depth butterfly-topology architecture whose fundamental building block is a single phase-shifter--beam-splitter pair, in contrast to conventional rectangular mesh architectures based on Mach-Zehnder interferometers. Computational evaluations show that, particularly at restricted parameter counts, the proposed architecture achieves lower matrix-reconstruction errors and higher classification accuracies than conventional meshes in both feedforward and recurrent networks. We further quantify these design principles using graph-theoretic measures, expected squared moduli of transformation-matrix entries, and matrix-reconstruction error. The resulting framework provides a quantitative and physically interpretable basis for parameter-efficient optical neural networks.
items.abstract_zh: 基于干涉架构的相干光学神经网络通过利用光的多个自由度（包括空间、时间和光谱模式），为高通量、节能计算提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，由于制造复杂性、器件占用面积和控制开销，实际实现受到可调参数数量的限制。在此类参数受限的设置中，实现高表达能力仍然是核心挑战。我们确定了在这些约束下保持高表达能力的两个关键架构要求：（i）所实现变换的统计均匀性，以及（ii）每个参数的强混合能力，从而能够跨模式快速且无偏地重新分配信息。为满足这些要求，我们开发了一种对数深度的蝶形拓扑架构，其基本构建模块是单个移相器—分束器对，这与基于马赫-曾德尔干涉仪的传统矩形网格架构形成对比。计算评估表明，特别是在参数数量受限时，所提出的架构在前馈和循环网络中均比传统网格实现更低的矩阵重构误差和更高的分类准确率。我们进一步使用图论度量、变换矩阵元素的期望平方模以及矩阵重构误差来量化这些设计原则。所得框架为参数高效的光学神经网络提供了定量且物理上可解释的基础。

items.title_en: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech
items.title_zh: Marimba：一种用于语音的系统1模型
items.abstract_en: Speech applications require decisions about term presence, turn completion, and language within an audio window. We present Marimba, an interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features. Lexical questions use zero-shot scoring of ASR transcripts; non-lexical questions use a question-conditioned head and a separate layer-18 turn-end readout. Language identification uses the ASR model's own language scores. On private conversational test sets, decoder AUROC is 0.80-0.92; on public read speech it is 0.92-0.97. Speech Commands four-way accuracy is 0.93; binary lexical ECE is at most 0.08. Personal-information detection, which passes the greedy transcript to a private, curated PII pipeline, reaches item-level F1 0.904 on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese speech (1.000 on reference transcripts). Layer-12 speaker readouts detect speaker change with AUROC 0.966-0.980 on AMI and VoxConverse, above an ECAPA baseline, and count speakers (0, 1, 2, or 3+) more accurately than pyannote 3.1. The turn-end readout reaches AUROC 0.930 versus Smart Turn v3.2 at 0.982 on Smart Turn's own test set. On a subset of ICSI meetings labeled by next speaker, AUROC is 0.716 versus 0.712; the paired confidence interval includes zero.
items.abstract_zh: 语音应用需要在一个音频窗口内对术语是否存在、话轮完成和语言做出决策。我们提出Marimba，一种基于冻结Qwen3-ASR 0.6B特征的类型化语音决策接口。词汇问题使用ASR转录文本的零样本评分；非词汇问题使用问题条件头和一个单独的第18层话轮结束读出。语言识别使用ASR模型自身的语言分数。在私有对话测试集上，解码器AUROC为0.80-0.92；在公开朗读语音上为0.92-0.97。Speech Commands四分类准确率为0.93；二值词汇ECE至多为0.08。个人信息检测将贪婪转录文本传给私有、精心构建的PII流水线，在合成巴西葡萄牙语语音上达到条目级F1 0.904（参考转录文本上为1.000）。第12层说话人读出在AMI和VoxConverse上以AUROC 0.966-0.980检测说话人变化，高于ECAPA基线，并且比pyannote 3.1更准确地计数说话人（0、1、2或3+）。话轮结束读出达到AUROC 0.930，而Smart Turn v3.2在其自身测试集上为0.982。在按下一说话人标注的ICSI会议子集上，AUROC为0.716 vs. 0.712；配对置信区间包含零。

items.title_en: Sideslip-Conditioned Drift Trajectory Planning with Flow Matching and Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: 侧滑角条件化的漂移轨迹规划：流匹配与控制屏障函数
items.abstract_en: Drifting, the deliberate control of a vehicle at large sideslip angles, is relevant to both motorsport and recovery from unexpected oversteer. Existing autonomous drifting methods typically determine drift intensity through predefined reference trajectories, optimization objectives, or learned policy rewards, rather than accepting a desired sideslip angle as an explicit input. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first generative drift trajectory planner explicitly conditioned on a requested peak sideslip angle. A conditional flow matching model is trained on demonstrated drift laps with hindsight-derived sideslip labels and refined through reinforcement fine-tuning. A control barrier function (CBF) correction is then applied to satisfy model-based road, tire friction, and actuator constraints at the planning waypoints. In closed-loop experiments in the racing simulator Assetto Corsa, a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks the generated plans for six requested sideslip angles from 20 deg to 45 deg, with 30 laps (approximately 75 km) per request. The median peak sideslip angle measured across drift-corner passes follows the requested angle, with a mean absolute error of 1.2 deg across the six conditions. Ablation experiments show that reinforcement fine-tuning improves conditioning accuracy, while CBF correction substantially reduces off-road and spin events.
items.abstract_zh: 漂移是在大侧滑角下对车辆进行有意控制，与赛车运动和从意外转向过度中恢复均相关。现有自主漂移方法通常通过预定义参考轨迹、优化目标或学习到的策略奖励来确定漂移强度，而不是将期望侧滑角作为显式输入。据我们所知，我们提出了首个显式以请求的峰值侧滑角为条件的生成式漂移轨迹规划器。条件流匹配模型在演示漂移圈上训练，并使用事后推导的侧滑角标签，再通过强化学习微调进行改进。随后应用控制屏障函数（CBF）修正，以在规划路点处满足基于模型的道路、轮胎摩擦和执行器约束。在赛车仿真器 Assetto Corsa 的闭环实验中，非线性模型预测控制器跟踪针对 20 度至 45 度六个请求侧滑角生成的规划，每个请求 30 圈（约 75 km）。在漂移弯道通过中测得的中位峰值侧滑角跟随请求角度，六个条件下的平均绝对误差为 1.2 度。消融实验表明，强化学习微调提高了条件化精度，而 CBF 修正大幅减少了越野和打转事件。

items.title_en: Unified Residual Translation for Paired Image Restoration
items.title_zh: 用于配对图像恢复的统一残差转换
items.abstract_en: Paired image restoration spans changes in imaging contrast, sensor modality, and spatial resolution. These settings differ in their input channels and target grids, raising the question of how much of the prediction pipeline must be specialized to each task. We present the Unified Residual Translator (URT), which separates fixed channel and scale mapping from learned residual prediction. A deterministic reference uses channel averaging, replication, or bicubic interpolation to match the target dimensions, while a NAFNet encoder-decoder predicts an additive correction from the complete input. Separately trained instances share the prediction rule, $\ell_1$ objective, and optimizer across MRI contrast synthesis, visible-to-infrared translation, SAR-to-optical translation, and real-camera super-resolution. Across six task and scale settings, URT achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM among the evaluated baselines on IXI, SEN1-2, and RealSR $\times3$ and $\times4$. It reaches 30.774dB on IXI and 13.478dB on SEN1-2, with luminance PSNR of 33.596, 28.742, and 27.342dB at the three RealSR scales. On LLVIP, it ranks second in PSNR and SSIM. A study of four spectral alternatives identifies complementary benefits of fitted references and bandwise residual gains. Together, these results support explicit dimensional alignment and learned residual correction as a common formulation for heterogeneous paired imaging tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 配对图像恢复涵盖成像对比度、传感器模态和空间分辨率的变化。这些设置在其输入通道和目标网格上不同，提出了预测流水线中有多少必须针对每个任务专门化的问题。我们提出统一残差转换器（URT），它将固定的通道和尺度映射与学习到的残差预测分离。确定性参考使用通道平均、复制或双三次插值来匹配目标维度，而 NAFNet 编码器-解码器从完整输入预测加性校正。分别训练的实例在 MRI 对比度合成、可见光到红外转换、SAR 到光学转换和真实相机超分辨率中共享预测规则、ℓ₁ 目标和优化器。在六种任务和尺度设置中，URT 在 IXI、SEN1-2 以及 RealSR ×3 和 ×4 上在评估基线中取得最高 PSNR 和 SSIM。它在 IXI 上达到 30.774dB，在 SEN1-2 上达到 13.478dB，在三个 RealSR 尺度上的亮度 PSNR 分别为 33.596、28.742 和 27.342dB。在 LLVIP 上，其在 PSNR 和 SSIM 上排名第二。对四种谱替代方案的研究确定了拟合参考和逐带残差增益的互补优势。总之，这些结果支持将显式维度对齐和学习到的残差校正作为异构配对成像任务的一种通用表述。

items.title_en: Human-Agentic AI Collaboration Workflow for Trend Analysis of ChatGPT Applications in Healthcare
items.title_zh: 用于 ChatGPT 医疗保健应用趋势分析的人类-智能体式 AI 协作工作流
items.abstract_en: Background: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have demonstrated strong potential to transform healthcare research and practice. However, LLMs are probabilistic and generate inherently variable outputs, which create risk and uncertainty in healthcare applications. Therefore, analyzing the current research landscape of ChatGPT applications is imperative to understand applied techniques and related concerns and to facilitate their practical integration into healthcare information systems. Objective: Leveraging LLM-based agentic AI with domain experts to analyze trends in ChatGPT healthcare applications and to examine the collaborative and interpretative capacities of LLM agents in broader contexts beyond narrowly defined topics. Methods: The review used a systematic search of the PubMed and Web of Science databases, following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, and focused on ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors. To support the review process, an adaptive, iterative LLM-based agentic AI with a human-in-the-loop mechanism was employed for automated metadata extraction, identification, classification, and knowledge synthesis. The extracted information was subsequently used for temporal and thematic analyses, citation network construction, and main-path analysis. Results: Across 192 papers, the review identified 511 ChatGPT application types, 690 concern items, and 368 influence usage factors distinct from traditional IT, achieving a metadata error rate of 1.04%. The human-agentic AI workflow enabled efficient synthesis of contextual information across studies, addressing the growing challenge of timely evidence integration in medical knowledge. The findings provide insights into the evolving trajectories of ChatGPT applications in healthcare and demonstrate the value of an expert-validated human-agentic AI workflow in supporting literature analysis and streamlining review processes. Conclusion: This review provides a comprehensive overview of emerging ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors in healthcare. The study further provides meaningful insights into the operational mechanisms of agentic AI, demonstrating the potential of human-AI collaboration for medical informatics research.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：随着人工智能（AI）的快速发展，ChatGPT 等大语言模型（LLM）已展现出改变医疗保健研究和实践的强大潜力。然而，LLM 具有概率性并产生本质上可变的输出，这在医疗保健应用中带来风险和不确定性。因此，分析 ChatGPT 应用的当前研究格局对于理解应用技术和相关关切、并促进其实际整合到医疗保健信息系统中至关重要。目的：利用基于 LLM 的智能体式 AI 与领域专家共同分析 ChatGPT 医疗保健应用的趋势，并考察 LLM 智能体在超出狭义主题的更广泛情境中的协作与解释能力。方法：本综述按照 PRISMA-ScR 指南，对 PubMed 和 Web of Science 数据库进行系统检索，重点关注 ChatGPT 应用、相关关切、应用技术和使用因素。为支持综述过程，采用具有人在回路机制的自适应、迭代式基于 LLM 的智能体式 AI，用于自动元数据提取、识别、分类和知识综合。提取的信息随后用于时间和主题分析、引文网络构建以及主路径分析。结果：在 192 篇论文中，本综述识别出 511 种 ChatGPT 应用类型、690 个关切条目和 368 个不同于传统 IT 的影响使用因素，元数据错误率为 1.04%。人类-智能体式 AI 工作流能够高效综合各研究的上下文信息，应对医学知识中及时证据整合日益增长的挑战。研究结果提供了关于 ChatGPT 在医疗保健中应用演变轨迹的见解，并展示了经专家验证的人类-智能体式 AI 工作流在支持文献分析和简化综述流程方面的价值。结论：本综述全面概述了医疗保健中新兴的 ChatGPT 应用、相关关切、应用技术和使用因素。该研究进一步提供了关于智能体式 AI 运行机制的有意义见解，展示了人-AI 协作在医学信息学研究中的潜力。

items.title_en: Quantum simulation of neutral-meson mixing and decay on a reprogrammable photonic processor
items.title_zh: 在可重编程光子处理器上对中性介子混合与衰变的量子模拟
items.abstract_en: Neutral mesons oscillate into their antiparticles while decaying, so their dynamics is generated by a non-Hermitian effective Hamiltonian which a quantum simulator restricted to unitary operations cannot implement directly. We propose a reprogrammable photonic processor that simulates this open-system evolution through dilation and analyze it at the circuit level. The effective Hamiltonian is reconstructed exactly from measured lifetimes, mass and width differences, and the CP-violation parameter $|q/p|$. Through a singular-value decomposition and a single ancilla that encodes the total decay probability, its propagator is embedded in a four-mode unitary, which is compiled at each time step into a rectangular interferometer on a hexagonal mesh of tunable Mach-Zehnder units. Circuit simulations including coupler, propagation, and bend losses show that one fixed device, reprogrammed only through its control voltages, reproduces the flavor oscillation and decay of neutral kaons and of $B_d$ and $B_s$ mesons, with $x=Δm/Γ$ from 0.77 to 26.9. Over 500 time steps per system, the mean fidelity lies between 0.99979 and 0.99982, and no step falls below 0.9996. Because every optical path crosses nine tunable units, uniform insertion loss reduces only the transmitted power, whereas unit-to-unit loss variations lower the fidelity quadratically, $1-\langle F\rangle \simeq 0.08σ^2$ for a loss standard deviation $σ$ in dB. A leading-order analysis traces this coefficient to the routing of light through the mesh, reproduces the fitted value to within 2%, and explains why it is the same for all three mesons; a mean fidelity of 0.999 tolerates $σ\approx 0.11$ dB. The ancillary outputs encode the total decay probability without postselection, and the reported probabilities are normalized to the collected optical power.
items.abstract_zh: 中性介子在其反粒子态之间振荡的同时发生衰变，因此其动力学由非厄米有效哈密顿量生成，而受限于酉操作的量子模拟器无法直接实现该演化。我们提出一种可重编程光子处理器，通过扩张（dilation）模拟这种开放系统演化，并在电路层面进行分析。有效哈密顿量由测得的寿命、质量差和宽度差以及 CP 破坏参数 |q/p| 精确重建。通过奇异值分解和一个编码总衰变概率的辅助比特，其传播子被嵌入一个四模酉操作中；该酉操作在每个时间步被编译为六边形网格上由可调马赫-曾德尔单元构成的矩形干涉仪。包含耦合器、传播和弯曲损耗的电路仿真表明，一个固定器件仅通过其控制电压重新编程，即可复现中性 K 介子以及 B_d 和 B_s 介子的味振荡与衰变，其中 x=Δm/Γ 从 0.77 到 26.9。每个系统超过 500 个时间步中，平均保真度介于 0.99979 和 0.99982 之间，且没有任何一步低于 0.9996。由于每条光路经过九个可调单元，均匀插入损耗仅降低透射功率，而单元间损耗变化以二次方式降低保真度：对于以 dB 为单位的损耗标准差 σ，1-⟨F⟩ ≃ 0.08σ²。领先阶分析将该系数追溯到光通过网格的路由，将拟合值复现到 2% 以内，并解释了为何三种介子均相同；平均保真度 0.999 可容忍 σ≈0.11 dB。辅助输出无需后选择即可编码总衰变概率，所报告的概率相对于收集到的光功率归一化。

items.title_en: Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
items.title_zh: 得分更高的编程模型并未完成更多工作
items.abstract_en: New coding models advertise themselves on score improvements of coding benchmarks. Yet no study has tested if a model that scores higher on these benchmarks gets more real work done. On June 12, 2026, a U.S. export control directive banned access to Claude Fable 5 for 19 days, which forced users to switch to other models. During this time, most former Fable 5 users switched to Opus 4.8 (11 points lower on SWE-Bench Pro compared to Fable 5). We treat this suspension as a natural experiment, where the people and projects stayed the same and only the model changed, so we could isolate the effect of Fable 5 on user productivity. We tracked GitHub pull requests of 297 Fable 5 users before, during, and after the suspension. We used 8,908 developers who stayed on Opus 4.8 all the time as the control group. We also repeated the comparison across five model upgrades before and after the suspension in 2026 (1,208 developers, 15,442 pull requests). Fitting a difference-in-differences model with developer and date fixed effects, we found that having access to Fable 5 increased the 7-day merge rate of pull requests by only 1.4 percentage points [-1.4; +4.3], which was not statistically significant. Similarly, no significant increases of merge rates were found with the upgrades (weighted mean: -0.9 percentage points [-1.9; +0.2]); all five estimates were negative (95% intervals included 0, did not differ from each other). We also did not observe a significant increase in the number of pull requests merged per week (+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]).
items.abstract_zh: 新的编程模型以编码基准分数的提升作为宣传点。然而，尚无研究检验在这些基准上得分更高的模型是否能完成更多实际工作。2026年6月12日，一项美国出口管制指令禁止访问 Claude Fable 5，持续19天，迫使用户转向其他模型。在此期间，大多数原先的 Fable 5 用户转向 Opus 4.8（在 SWE-Bench Pro 上比 Fable 5 低11分）。我们将此次暂停视为一项自然实验：人员和项目保持不变，只有模型发生变化，因此可以分离出 Fable 5 对用户生产力的影响。我们追踪了297名 Fable 5 用户在暂停前、暂停期间和暂停后的 GitHub 拉取请求。我们使用始终留在 Opus 4.8 上的8,908名开发者作为对照组。我们还在2026年暂停前后重复了五次模型升级的比较（1,208名开发者，15,442个拉取请求）。拟合带有开发者和日期固定效应的双重差分模型后，我们发现能够访问 Fable 5 仅使拉取请求的7天合并率提高1.4个百分点 [-1.4; +4.3]，且不具统计显著性。类似地，模型升级也未发现合并率的显著提高（加权均值：-0.9个百分点 [-1.9; +0.2]）；全部五个估计值均为负（95%区间包含0，彼此之间无差异）。我们也没有观察到每周合并的拉取请求数量显著增加（+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]）。

items.title_en: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
items.title_zh: 不变量感知的框架强制执行以保护LLM智能体免受静默API故障影响
items.abstract_en: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning from the same check leaves 70.1% wrong, so enforcement is the key. On new fault types, the harness alone cuts wrong answers from 61.1% to 24.5%. It avoids wrong answers by abstaining rather than recovering.
items.abstract_zh: LLM智能体通过调用API并信任结果来回答问题。API可能静默失败。它忽略请求的一部分，例如名称错误的过滤器，却返回HTTP 200和看似合理但错误的结果。当前修复方法，如检查清单、评审模型和LLM评判器，要求模型捕捉该问题。但模型常常看到了问题仍然给出答案。我们提出SilentGuard，它将决策从模型转移到运行工具调用的执行框架。它根据任何正确API都必须满足的不变量测试每个结果，并扣留违反某个不变量的值。我们在15个公共研究API中的11个发现静默故障，计数被夸大最高达691倍。当前修复方法使超过70%的答案仍然错误，智能体报告了评判器标记的计数的77.4%。在7个开源模型上，SilentGuard将其目标故障上的错误答案从74.0%降至1.7%，且在无故障任务上无损失。在三个前沿模型上，错误答案从70.2%降至0.5%。同一检查仅发出警告时仍有70.1%错误，因此强制执行是关键。在新故障类型上，仅该执行框架就将错误答案从61.1%降至24.5%。它通过弃权而非恢复来避免错误答案。

items.title_en: Levio: Smart Actuated Back-Exoskeleton via Retrofit of a Commercial Passive Device
items.title_zh: Levio：通过对商用被动装置进行改装实现的智能驱动背部外骨骼
items.abstract_en: Passive back exoskeletons show promising benefits for reducing occupational musculoskeletal disorders. However, their assistance cannot be modulated towards the task requirements. Active exoskeletons offer opportunities for pose-specific assistance, but, developing these systems from scratch for research can be time consuming. Therefore, here, we present an accelerated design pipeline that retrofits a Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) passive back exoskeleton, Laevo Flex, with COTS actuation (CubeMars AK10-9) and sensing (IMUs and load-cell) paradigms. Levio was able to provide assistance based on the user's pose. Nine participants performed stoop lifting with the original Laevo and the retrofit Levio system, in transparent and assisted modes. Compared to Laevo, Levio modulated the assistance provided between the bending and lifting phases of the stoop task. The passive assistance offered by Laevo was $25.2 \pm 4.3$ Nm and $30.6 \pm 9.5$ Nm respectively during the bending and lifting phases of the stoop tasks. Levio reduced the resistive torque during bending to $17.9 \pm 4.6$ Nm and offered increased assistance of $37.7 \pm 6.4$ Nm during lifting. Moreover, participants reported higher usability scores and lowest mean global discomfort score while using the Levio when compared to Laevo. These benefits demonstrates retrofitting passive exoskeletons is a viable direction for rapid prototyping of wearable exoskeletons for lifting.
items.abstract_zh: 被动背部外骨骼在减少职业性肌肉骨骼疾病方面显示出有前景的益处。然而，其辅助无法根据任务需求进行调节。主动外骨骼为针对姿势的辅助提供了机会，但为研究从头开发这些系统可能耗时。因此，我们在此提出一种加速设计流程，用商用现成品（COTS）驱动（CubeMars AK10-9）和传感（IMU与称重传感器）范式改装商用现成品（COTS）被动背部外骨骼 Laevo Flex。Levio 能够根据用户的姿势提供辅助。九名参与者使用原始 Laevo 和改装后的 Levio 系统，在透明模式和辅助模式下执行弯腰提举。与 Laevo 相比，Levio 在弯腰任务的弯曲和提举阶段之间调节所提供的辅助。Laevo 提供的被动辅助在弯腰任务的弯曲和提举阶段分别为 25.2 ± 4.3 Nm 和 30.6 ± 9.5 Nm。Levio 将弯曲期间的阻力矩降低至 17.9 ± 4.6 Nm，并在提举期间提供 37.7 ± 6.4 Nm 的更高辅助。此外，与 Laevo 相比，参与者报告使用 Levio 时可用性评分更高，平均整体不适评分最低。这些益处表明，改装被动外骨骼是快速原型开发用于提举的可穿戴外骨骼的可行方向。

items.title_en: REVEAL: Reconstructing Video Amodal Content via Language and Flow Guidance
items.title_zh: REVEAL：通过语言与光流引导重建视频非模态内容
items.abstract_en: Amodal perception enables humans to perceive entire objects even when parts are occluded, a remarkable cognitive skill that artificial intelligence struggles to replicate. Recent diffusion-based methods have extended amodal completion from images to videos, yet they lack auxiliary priors to guide the reconstruction of heavily occluded content and to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences. We present REVEAL (REconstructing VidEo Amodal content via Language and flow guidance), a unified diffusion-based framework that integrates complementary motion and semantic priors for video amodal completion. A user-provided text query serves a dual role: it drives open-vocabulary video segmentation to obtain visible masks, and it provides semantic guidance for texture reconstruction. For amodal segmentation, we introduce optical flow guidance: by warping visible masks from previous frames to the current frame, the flow-warped mask propagates visible content into occluded regions and approximates the object's current shape, providing a strong shape prior even under simultaneous deformation and occlusion. For texture completion, text guidance constrains the reconstruction of occluded appearance while providing a stable semantic reference that helps maintain visual coherence throughout the reconstruction. We also contribute LAVAT, a new benchmark featuring long video sequences paired with text descriptions, enabling evaluation of text-guided video amodal completion under heavy occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks while maintaining high-quality temporal consistency over extended sequences. The project page is available at: https://uark-aicv.github.io/REVEAL/.
items.abstract_zh: 非模态感知使人类即使在部分被遮挡时也能感知整个物体，这是人工智能难以复制的显著认知能力。近期基于扩散的方法已将非模态补全从图像扩展到视频，但它们缺乏辅助先验来指导严重遮挡内容的重建，并在长序列上保持时间一致性。我们提出 REVEAL（通过语言与光流引导重建视频非模态内容），这是一个统一的基于扩散的框架，集成了互补的运动和语义先验用于视频非模态补全。用户提供的文本查询发挥双重作用：它驱动开放词汇视频分割以获得可见掩码，并为纹理重建提供语义引导。对于非模态分割，我们引入光流引导：通过将先前帧的可见掩码变换到当前帧，光流变换后的掩码将可见内容传播到遮挡区域，并近似物体当前形状，即使在同时发生形变和遮挡时也提供强形状先验。对于纹理补全，文本引导约束遮挡外观的重建，同时提供稳定的语义参考，有助于在整个重建过程中保持视觉连贯性。我们还贡献了 LAVAT，这是一个新基准，包含长视频序列及文本描述，能够在严重遮挡下评估文本引导的视频非模态补全。大量实验表明，REVEAL 在现有基准上达到最先进性能，同时在扩展序列上保持高质量的时间一致性。项目页面见：https://uark-aicv.github.io/REVEAL/。

items.title_en: Integrating multiple imputation with harmonization in multisite neuroimaging data: implications for site effects and biological inference
items.title_zh: 将多重插补与协调化整合于多站点神经影像数据：对站点效应与生物学推断的意义
items.abstract_en: Multisite neuroimaging harmonization in Alzheimer's disease research with missing data has received limited attention in the literature. Here, we evaluated the performance of several harmonization methods in conjunction with multiple imputation (MI) to address missing data, using baseline [18F]flortaucipir tau positron emission tomography (PET) data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). We compared complete case and MICE-imputed datasets (m = 5) across the original ADNI-preprocessed data and four statistical harmonization approaches: ComBat with and without covariates, quantile normalization, and quantile regression. Weighted average standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs) across six Braak regions were analyzed for each dataset-method combination. We assessed harmonization effectiveness using covariate-adjusted intraclass correlation coefficients and site-level pairwise differences, and evaluated biological effect preservation using Hedges' g, regression coefficients, and statistical significance for comparisons between cognitively impaired and unimpaired participants. For imputed analyses, effect sizes and regression coefficients were pooled using Rubin's rules, with statistical inference based on the pooled estimates. Post-processing harmonization reduced site-level variability compared to the original data, with method performance varying across evaluation metrics, while overall harmonization quality remained comparable after MI. Disease group differences remained statistically significant across all combinations, exhibiting a consistent regional pattern, strongest in Braak I and weakest in Braak VI. MI modestly increased effect size and coefficient estimates, with improved precision reflected by median standard error ratios below 1 (0.89 for effect sizes and 0.93 for coefficients). These findings indicate that integrating MI with harmonization preserves disease group differences and improves statistical efficiency without compromising harmonization performance, supporting a practical framework for multisite neuroimaging studies.
items.abstract_zh: 在阿尔茨海默病研究中，针对缺失数据的多站点神经影像协调化在文献中受到的关注有限。在此，我们使用阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）的基线[18F]flortaucipir tau正电子发射断层扫描（PET）数据，评估了几种协调化方法与多重插补（MI）结合以处理缺失数据的性能。我们在原始ADNI预处理数据以及四种统计协调化方法：带协变量和不带协变量的ComBat、分位数归一化和分位数回归上，比较了完整案例数据集和MICE插补数据集（m = 5）。对每种数据集-方法组合，分析了六个Braak区域内的加权平均标准化摄取值比（SUVR）。我们使用协变量调整的组内相关系数和站点级两两差异评估协调化有效性，并使用Hedges' g、回归系数以及认知受损与未受损参与者比较的统计显著性评估生物学效应保留情况。对于插补分析，使用Rubin规则合并效应量和回归系数，统计推断基于合并估计。与原始数据相比，后处理协调化降低了站点级变异性，方法性能因评估指标而异，而MI后整体协调化质量保持可比。疾病组差异在所有组合中均保持统计显著，呈现一致的区域模式，在Braak I最强，在Braak VI最弱。MI适度增加了效应量和系数估计，精度提高体现为中位标准误比低于1（效应量为0.89，系数为0.93）。这些发现表明，将MI与协调化整合可保留疾病组差异并提高统计效率，而不损害协调化性能，支持多站点神经影像研究的实用框架。

items.title_en: Performance of Fusion-Based Quantum Computing with Imperfect Photon Indistinguishability
items.title_zh: 基于聚变的量子计算在不完美光子不可区分性下的性能
items.abstract_en: Fusion-based quantum computation (FBQC) is a promising route to fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing, connecting small entangled resource states through linear-optical fusion measurements. While logical encoding can substantially improve resilience to photon loss, whether these benefits extend to other noise remain an open question. In this work, we show that this is not generally the case when accounting for partial photon distinguishability during resource state generation and fusion measurement. We develop hardware-motivated noise models to capture these effects and investigate their impact on fault tolerance in the 6-ring fusion network. We compare unencoded and Shor(2,2)-encoded resource states prepared using all-photonic and emitter-assisted repeat-until-success (RUS) schemes. For the all-photonic construction, encoding reduces the distinguishability threshold from 0.136% to 0.08%. In contrast, the RUS construction tolerates more distinguishability, with comparable unencoded and encoded thresholds (0.256% and 0.271%, respectively). These results expose a fundamental limitation of evaluating logical encodings under idealized resource-state assumptions and demonstrate that resource-state generation can critically determine the fault tolerance of photonic architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 基于聚变的量子计算（FBQC）是实现容错光子量子计算的一条有前景的路径，它通过线性光学聚变测量连接小型纠缠资源态。虽然逻辑编码可以显著提高对光子损耗的抵抗力，但这些益处是否扩展到其他噪声仍是一个开放问题。在本工作中，我们表明，在考虑资源态生成和聚变测量期间的部分光子可区分性时，情况通常并非如此。我们开发了受硬件启发的噪声模型来刻画这些效应，并研究它们对6环聚变网络中容错性的影响。我们比较了使用全光子和发射器辅助的重复直至成功（RUS）方案制备的未编码和 Shor(2,2) 编码资源态。对于全光子构造，编码将可区分性阈值从0.136%降低到0.08%。相比之下，RUS 构造容忍更高的可区分性，未编码和编码的阈值相当（分别为0.256%和0.271%）。这些结果揭示了在理想化资源态假设下评估逻辑编码的基本局限，并表明资源态生成可以关键性地决定光子架构的容错性。

items.title_en: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
items.title_zh: 在笔记本电脑 iGPU 上使用 SFT 和 QLoRA 为 MATLAB 信号处理代码微调 Gemma 4 边缘模型
items.abstract_en: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to the Gemma 4 edge models E2B and E4B with 66 checked examples covering 11 signal-processing MATLAB subtasks, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on the integrated GPU (iGPU) of a laptop, and deploy the 8-bit integer (int8) models with the adapters through OpenVINO. On held-out variants scored by deterministic checkers, the pass rate rises from 18/66 to 37/66 (LoRA) and 37/66 (QLoRA) for E2B and from 32/66 to 47/66 for E4B (QLoRA). Reading all 159 failing programs shows that the adapters remove most errors of convention, such as the sign of a lag, units and array shapes, but few errors in building signals and noise. Applied at run time, the adapter costs 17-19% of the generation speed.
items.abstract_zh: 可在笔记本电脑上运行的小型语言模型对于离线编写信号处理代码具有吸引力，但它们会在数字信号处理（DSP）约定上产生系统性错误。我们对 Gemma 4 边缘模型 E2B 和 E4B 应用监督微调（SFT），使用66个经检查的示例，覆盖11个信号处理 MATLAB 子任务，并在笔记本电脑的集成 GPU（iGPU）上使用低秩适配（LoRA）和量化 LoRA（QLoRA），通过 OpenVINO 部署带适配器的8位整数（int8）模型。在由确定性检查器评分的留出变体上，E2B 的通过率从18/66提高到37/66（LoRA）和37/66（QLoRA），E4B 的通过率从32/66提高到47/66（QLoRA）。阅读所有159个失败程序表明，适配器消除了大多数约定类错误，例如滞后的符号、单位和数组形状，但构建信号和噪声的错误很少。在运行时应用时，适配器占用17–19%的生成速度。

items.title_en: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
items.title_zh: 偏见头测量了什么？头级偏见归因中的不可识别性
items.abstract_en: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.
items.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型中的社会偏见定位到单个注意力头并通过消融移除的方法，其验证依据是它们对公平性指标的影响，而从未有证据表明用于选择这些头的统计量测量的是偏见。我们在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上审计这一点。头图与一个标签盲的响应长度图分别以 ρ = -0.950 和 -0.768 相关，似乎识别出一个表面混杂因素。破坏长度-标签耦合的干预否定了这一解读：在提示固定时，响应长度解释该统计量方差的1%。真正解释它的是提示身份，占方差的64%，其排序对长度并非单调。在任何固定提示内，公平性标签、响应长度和受保护群体标记的存在以 φ = 0.95 共线，部分是由标注规则的定义所致，因此任何观察性分析都无法将该图归因于其中任何一个，且该家族中没有方法执行能够做到这一点的实验。实质性主张独立地不成立：在两种参考解读下，偏见选择性在两个模型上都不是后层集中的，且我们测试的任何头集合在消融时都没有降低不公平率。其补集在相反标签上评分时可靠地破坏拒绝行为（p = 2.7×10⁻⁵），表明该流程能在此尺度上检测到效应。

items.title_en: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
items.title_zh: Linglong Agent Service：用于集中式智能体推理与分布式执行的运行时
items.abstract_en: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session. Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at https://github.com/mz24cn/agents.
items.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体可以使用远程工具和云沙箱，但整合推理、会话状态和异构执行站点仍是一个运行时设计问题。我们提出 Linglong Agent Service（agentsvc），一个自托管 HTTP 服务和可嵌入 Python 运行时，它将执行站点视为与模型、工具和上下文并列的可配置维度。父服务保留推理编排、工具描述和对话历史；每个推理请求选择一个子环境用于文件、shell、终端和 MCP 操作。直接 HTTP 和子端发起的 WebSocket 隧道承载相同的应用接口，包括可移植请求上下文和集中管理的更新。正常核心路径不需要第三方 Python 包，仅有一个可选的 Windows 伪终端依赖。我们进一步提出 online_debugger，作为执行站点分离的进程级特例：一个经过插桩的程序提交异常证据，在事件进程内执行会话范围的检查工具，并恢复同一诊断会话。其默认提示要求对源代码更改提供先失败后通过的复现证据，而运行时补丁激活和失败调用恢复仍未实现。我们通过受约束的期望效用推理解释该设计，将具体机制与 Hermes Agent、Pi、Codex 和 Claude Code 进行比较，并报告实现和回归测试证据。当前证据确立了可执行契约，而非性能优势、修复准确性或生产恢复能力。源代码在 MIT 许可证下开源，地址为 https://github.com/mz24cn/agents。

items.title_en: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
items.title_zh: vividRGB：在RGB照片中通过强制聚焦注意力进行多种视觉线索检测
items.abstract_en: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.
items.abstract_zh: 自然照片包含密集、重叠的结构，这些结构在全图视觉编码器生成的特征图中可能仅被弱表达。我们提出强制聚焦注意力（FFA）及其Python实现vividRGB。FFA是一种与编码器无关的推理时流程：将冻结编码器应用于放大且重叠的局部裁剪，对逆对齐反射取平均，并在源坐标中重建特征场。我们使用DINOv3 ViT-B/16评估来自草地植被、真菌网络、空中森林、珊瑚礁和浮游植物显微成像的50张高分辨率照片。在五个领域中，5%或10%聚焦的FFA产生的平均RGB边缘边界F1高于直接DINOv3编码和自动SAM3掩码。FFA的领域均值为0.244至0.596，而直接DINOv3为0.028–0.076，SAM3为0.020–0.090。定性特征图也显示出更精细的外观结构。这些结果关注的是RGB边缘保留，而非经过验证的物种、性状或生物分割。更窄的聚焦通常改善边界保留，但提取时间和GPU能耗急剧增加，且在更细设置下收益递减。FFA可能适用于相对较小、高分辨率且密集视觉线索重要的生态图像集合。alpha版本vividRGB 0.1.0和带版本的研究资源支持可复现的线索检查。

items.title_en: Partial microglial depletion attenuates Purkinje cell degeneration and reshapes both glial and inflammatory responses in a mouse model of selective neurodegeneration
items.title_zh: 部分小胶质细胞耗竭减轻浦肯野细胞变性，并重塑选择性神经退行性变小鼠模型中的胶质与炎症反应
items.abstract_en: Background The microglial population contributes to the inflammatory environment during neurodegeneration. Its role in neuronal loss remains hard to distinguish from its response to injury. We investigated how early pharmacological reduction of this population affects Purkinje cell preservation, behaviour and the cerebellar glial response. Methods We administered PLX5622 to Purkinje cell degeneration (PCD) and wild-type (WT) mice from postnatal day (P) 15 to P24 and compared them with their respective untreated controls. We assessed motor coordination, spontaneous behaviours and novel-object recognition at P17, P21 and P25. At P25, we quantified regional Purkinje cell preservation, glial immunoreactivity and microglial abundance and morphology. We assessed selected transcripts in whole-cerebellum samples by reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). Results At P25, treated PCD mice showed better motor coordination, improvements in selected spontaneous behaviours and greater novel-object discrimination. Greater Purkinje cell preservation coincided with lower glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) immunoreactivity in lobes IV-V and VIII. Microglial density decreased in all four PCD regions analysed. The territory encompassed by the processes of residual microglia expanded in both genotypes. In PCD mice, CD68-positive tissue area decreased in lobes I-II and IV-V, and the proportion of Iba1-positive area occupied by CD68 decreased in IV-V. CD45, CD16/32 and CD206 immunoreactivity decreased alongside selective reductions in immune, inflammatory and phagocytosis-associated transcripts. Treated WT mice showed early behavioural changes, including reduced novel-object discrimination. Conclusions Early PLX5622 treatment can modify the outcome of genetically driven cerebellar degeneration in PCD mice. The benefits achieved with partial microglial depletion provide a preclinical rationale for testing how the timing and extent of glial modulation influence neuronal protection during active degeneration.
items.abstract_zh: 背景 小胶质细胞群体在神经退行性变过程中参与形成炎症环境。其在神经元丢失中的作用仍难以与其对损伤的反应相区分。我们研究了早期药物性减少该群体如何影响浦肯野细胞保留、行为以及小脑胶质反应。方法 我们从出生后第15天（P15）至P24向浦肯野细胞变性（PCD）小鼠和野生型（WT）小鼠施用 PLX5622，并与各自未处理的对照进行比较。我们在 P17、P21 和 P25 评估运动协调、自发行为和新物体识别。在 P25，我们量化区域浦肯野细胞保留、胶质免疫反应性以及小胶质细胞丰度和形态。我们通过逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）评估全小脑样本中的选定转录本。结果 在 P25，接受治疗的 PCD 小鼠表现出更好的运动协调、部分自发行为的改善以及更强的新物体辨别能力。浦肯野细胞保留增加与 IV-V 叶和 VIII 叶中较低的胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）免疫反应性相吻合。分析的四个 PCD 区域中小胶质细胞密度均下降。残余小胶质细胞突起所覆盖的区域在两种基因型中均扩大。在 PCD 小鼠中，I-II 叶和 IV-V 叶中 CD68 阳性组织面积减少，IV-V 叶中 CD68 占据的 Iba1 阳性面积比例下降。CD45、CD16/32 和 CD206 免疫反应性降低，同时免疫、炎症和吞噬相关转录本出现选择性减少。接受治疗的 WT 小鼠表现出早期行为变化，包括新物体辨别能力降低。结论 早期 PLX5622 治疗可改变 PCD 小鼠遗传驱动小脑变性的结局。部分小胶质细胞耗竭所获得的益处为测试胶质调控的时机和程度如何影响活跃变性过程中的神经元保护提供了临床前依据。

items.title_en: Unique continuation for the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian
items.title_zh: Pauli-Fierz 哈密顿量的唯一延拓
items.abstract_en: We prove a unique continuation property for eigenstates of the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian, viewed as functions of the electron configuration with values in the spin-photon space. The vector potential may lie in $L^6_\mathrm{loc}$, with its divergence, curl, and the scalar potential in $L^p_\mathrm{loc}$ for some $p>2$. As an application, we prove a Hohenberg-Kohn theorem at positive coupling strength: the spin-summed ground-state density and combined current density determine the external potentials up to a gauge transformation and an additive constant.
items.abstract_zh: 我们证明 Pauli-Fierz 哈密顿量本征态的唯一延拓性质，将其视为以自旋-光子空间为取值、关于电子位形的函数。矢量势可属于 L^6_loc，其散度、旋度和标量势可属于 L^p_loc（对某个 p>2）。作为应用，我们证明正耦合强度下的 Hohenberg-Kohn 定理：自旋求和基态密度与组合电流密度在规范变换和相差一个加性常数意义下确定外部势。

items.title_en: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
items.title_zh: 降低观测频率下学习型与运动学轨迹预测的比较
items.abstract_en: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.
items.abstract_zh: 用于自动驾驶的轨迹预测模型通常在以固定采样频率采样的数据上训练，而通过车联万物（V2X）通信接收的位置以 1–10 Hz 到达。我们研究仅使用观测历史的学习型预测器在历史频率降低时，是否仍保持相对于恒速（CV）和恒加速（CA）模型的优势。在 Argoverse 2 运动预测数据集上，将焦点智能体的 5 s 历史从 10 Hz 下采样到 5、2 和 1 Hz，并在不使用地图或邻近智能体的情况下预测 6 s 未来。将针对每个频率训练的基于 LSTM 的循环神经网络（RNN）与在 10 Hz 训练并经线性插值后应用于稀疏历史的同一网络进行比较。假设和阈值在训练前固定，主要 RNN 各用十个随机种子训练，24,984 个测试场景上的结果具有跨场景和种子的 bootstrap 置信区间。频率特定 RNN 的平均位移误差在 5 Hz 时增加 3.1%，在 2 Hz 时增加 10.1%，在 1 Hz 时增加 20.3%。与我们的假设相反，其相对于更优运动学模型的优势在直线运动上并未消失，并且在每个频率下，在直线运动和转弯上均为 24–30%，而对于行人，CV 更准确。经插值的 10 Hz 模型在低至 2 Hz 时其准确率最多比频率特定模型低 1.3%，但在 1 Hz 时低 11.5%。每个假设仅得到部分支持。

items.title_en: Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI
items.title_zh: 极性组合假设：来自 NLI 中否定的因果证据
items.abstract_en: We investigate how language models process negation in natural language inference (NLI). We propose the \textit{Polarity Composition Hypothesis}, a high-level causal model of this computation. Behavioral evaluations show that language-model predictions largely conform to the proposed hypothesis. Using Distributed Alignment Search, we identify causally effective subspaces aligned with the variables in the polarity-composition hypothesis. These representations transfer across negation forms and partially to a subset of MNLI. We release the dataset and code.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究语言模型如何在自然语言推理（NLI）中处理否定。我们提出“极性组合假设”，这是该计算的一个高层因果模型。行为评估表明，语言模型的预测在很大程度上符合所提出的假设。使用分布式对齐搜索（Distributed Alignment Search），我们识别出与极性组合假设中各变量对齐的因果有效子空间。这些表示可跨否定形式迁移，并部分迁移到 MNLI 的一个子集。我们发布数据集和代码。

items.title_en: WTR-Drive: World-Task Decomposition with Structured Risk Supervision for End-to-End Driving
items.title_zh: WTR-Drive：用于端到端驾驶的带结构化风险监督的世界-任务分解
items.abstract_en: Proposal-conditioned scene predictions can lack a common object-level reference across candidate trajectories. Aggregate planning scores also leave the objects and times associated with violations implicit. We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.
items.abstract_zh: 以提议为条件的场景预测可能缺乏跨候选轨迹的共同对象级参考。聚合规划分数也使与违规相关的对象和时间保持隐式。我们提出 WTR-Drive（World-Task-Risk Driving），一种基于 Drive-JEPA 的规划器，将共享场景估计与以提议为条件的推理分离。与提议无关的世界记忆通过在每一轮细化时重新读取原始视觉特征来估计对象状态、地图结构和未来运动。提议反馈更新残差任务分支，而不写回世界记忆。该分支通过候选特定的检索和门控视觉反馈引导细化。最终任务读出提供以候选为条件的特征用于评分。我们从现有的候选评分 rollout 中导出结构化风险目标，而无需额外的模拟器调用。对于有责碰撞和碰撞时间违规，目标编码事件存在性、与共享对象槽的关联以及首次违规时间箱。在 NAVSIM navtest 划分上，WTR-Drive 在 v1 上达到 94.66 PDMS，在 v2 上达到 88.24 EPDMS（专家帧顺序评估）。这些分数分别比已发表的 Drive-JEPA 值高 0.96 和 0.44 分。候选级分析表明，更高的最佳候选分数可以与较低的所选轨迹分数共存，揭示了候选质量与选择有效性之间的差距。

items.title_en: $π^4$: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
items.title_zh: $π^4$：用于 4D 场景几何与运动的基础模型
items.abstract_en: $π^4$ is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, $π^4$ achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.
items.abstract_zh: $π^4$ 是一个用于 4D 场景感知的统一基础模型。从野外多样、未标定的 RGB 观测——单张图像、无序图像集合或视频序列——中，它恢复稠密几何、相机位姿和度量尺度，并且对于多图像输入，还恢复 2D/3D 点轨迹和运动物体掩码。它将几何分支与几何条件化的运动分支耦合，后者预测图像空间对应关系，并利用重建的目标视图几何将这些对应关系提升到 3D。在多种基准上，$π^4$ 在几何评估中取得最佳总体平均排名，同时在单视图和多视图 2D/3D 点跟踪以及运动物体分割中具有有竞争力的性能。借助共享主干，完整的几何与运动系统包含约 0.5B 参数——不到大多数基线规模的一半。它在一次前向传播中生成联合重建和轨迹，包括具有数千张输入图像的大规模场景，尽管训练时上下文最多为 64 个视图。我们进一步介绍支撑这些能力的数据和训练方案，以及对关键设计选择的实证研究。代码和模型见 https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4。

items.title_en: An In-Silico Audit of Topographic Organization in a Multimodal Brain-Response Model
items.title_zh: 多模态脑响应模型中拓扑组织的计算机模拟审计
items.abstract_en: TRIBE v2 (d'Ascoli et al., 2026) predicts fMRI responses across the cortical surface from video, audio and text. Its authors validated it with category-selective localizers (faces, places, bodies, words) and language contrasts, but not with the classic topographic organization of sensory cortex: retinotopy, tonotopy, and motion selectivity in area MT+. There is a clear architectural reason to expect retinotopy to fail: TRIBE's video features are averaged over space before the response head, which should discard visual-field position. I present mapping stimuli, a fitting pipeline adapted from standard fMRI mapping analyses, and a stand-in model with known ground truth that serves as a positive and negative control, and apply them to TRIBE v2's predictions, comparing the fitted maps with human atlases using spin tests. TRIBE v2 shows a sharp split. There is no contralateral hemifield response and no polar-angle map, robustly across stimulus controls. There is no tonotopic gradient in primary auditory cortex: best frequencies span an interquartile range of only 0.14 octaves across core and belt, and the null persists with loudness-equalized tones. An eccentricity-like gradient appears only when the ring geometry changes, consistent with global image statistics rather than a positional code. In contrast, motion selectivity is strong and precisely localized: 22% of the 1% most motion-selective vertices fall in MT+, which covers 0.42% of cortex. In-silico experiments that depend on feature identity appear viable with TRIBE v2, while those that depend on visual-field or frequency position are not supported by the current model.
items.abstract_zh: TRIBE v2（d'Ascoli等，2026）从视频、音频和文本预测整个皮层表面的fMRI响应。其作者用类别选择性定位器（面孔、场景、身体、词语）和语言对比对其进行了验证，但未用感觉皮层的经典拓扑组织进行验证：视网膜拓扑、音调拓扑以及MT+区的运动选择性。存在明确的架构原因预期视网膜拓扑会失败：TRIBE的视频特征在响应头之前对空间进行了平均，这应会丢弃视野位置。我提出映射刺激、一种改编自标准fMRI映射分析的拟合流程，以及一个具有已知真实值并作为阳性和阴性对照的替代模型，并将其应用于TRIBE v2的预测，使用旋转检验将拟合图与人类图谱进行比较。TRIBE v2显示出明显分化。在多种刺激控制下稳健地不存在对侧半视野响应，也不存在极角图。初级听觉皮层中没有音调拓扑梯度：在核心区和带区，最佳频率的四分位距仅为0.14个倍频程，且在响度均衡的音调下零结果仍然存在。类偏心度梯度仅在环形几何改变时出现，这与全局图像统计一致，而非位置编码。相比之下，运动选择性强且定位精确：运动选择性最强的1%顶点中有22%落在MT+，而MT+仅占皮层0.42%。依赖特征身份的计算机模拟实验在TRIBE v2上似乎可行，而依赖视野或频率位置的实验则不受当前模型支持。

items.title_en: Quantum state tomography with measurement-conditioned diffusion models
items.title_zh: 基于测量条件扩散模型的量子态层析
items.abstract_en: We introduce Diff-QST, a measurement-conditioned diffusion model for quantum state tomography that learns from an ensemble of input states and reconstructs a physical density operator from noisy, possibly incomplete Pauli measurements in two or three denoising steps. In simulations of two to five qubits, Diff-QST has higher mean fidelity than maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE) and a semidefinite-programming least-squares estimator (SDP) in all 120 tested conditions at nominal noise. After training, GPU reconstruction is faster than both in condition-averaged time at every system size and, at four and five qubits, in every condition. At four and five qubits, though not at two and three, Diff-QST also has higher fidelity than an architecture-matched regression baseline trained without diffusion. At five qubits, over the tested numbers of observables and shots per observable, it reaches a specified fidelity with 25%-67% fewer total shots than this baseline. Under state and noise distributions that differ from those used in training, Diff-QST retains its fidelity advantage over MLE and SDP in most tested conditions, although it can reverse. Diff-QST is therefore suited to fast tomography from noisy, incomplete Pauli measurements of states represented by its training ensemble.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Diff-QST，一种用于量子态层析的测量条件扩散模型，它从输入态集合中学习，并在两到三个去噪步骤中从含噪、可能不完整的泡利测量中重建物理密度算符。在二至五个量子比特的模拟中，在标称噪声下的全部 120 个测试条件中，Diff-QST 的平均保真度高于最大似然估计（MLE）和半定规划最小二乘估计器（SDP）。训练后，GPU 重建在每个系统规模上的条件平均时间都快于二者，并且在四和五个量子比特时在每个条件下都更快。在四和五个量子比特时（但二和三个量子比特时并非如此），Diff-QST 的保真度也高于未使用扩散训练、架构匹配的回归基线。在五个量子比特时，在所测试的可观测量数量与每个可观测量测量次数范围内，它以比该基线少 25%-67% 的总测量次数达到指定保真度。在与训练所用分布不同的状态和噪声分布下，Diff-QST 在大多数测试条件中保持相对 MLE 和 SDP 的保真度优势，尽管该优势可能反转。因此，Diff-QST 适用于从其训练集合所表示状态的含噪、不完整泡利测量中进行快速层析。

items.title_en: MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
items.title_zh: 面向多语言适配的 MoE--LoRA 方法：一项系统的实证研究
items.abstract_en: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 路由低秩适配器提供了一种参数高效的手段，可提升大语言模型（LLM）跨任务性能。因此，人们假设它们也可用于改善 LLM 对低资源语言的支持；当前 LLM 对英语的服务远好于对全球数千种其他语言的服务。然而，该假设从未在共享的多语言评估协议下得到实证验证。我们正是通过在一个冻结基座模型上使用 200 种独特语言、在超过 9,000 个评估设置中比较八种低秩适配（LoRA）方法，来填补这一空白。我们的结果表明，缩减规模的搜索可以识别 LoRA 方法的可行配置，但不能可靠预测其相对性能，因为排名最高的配置在规模扩大时从不是最佳。LoRA 可靠地改善语言模型在翻译数据上的拟合，持续降低阅读理解性能，并使低资源语言受益最大。这些发现表明，LoRA 方法应被视为有针对性的工具，而不是提升 LLM 多语言能力的通用手段。

items.title_en: Semantics First, Pixels Later: Mission-Driven Event Streams for Drone Video over Bandwidth-Starved Links
items.title_zh: 语义优先，像素在后：带宽匮乏链路上面向无人机视频的任务驱动事件流
items.abstract_en: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator's questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream's rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.
items.abstract_zh: 带宽匮乏链路上的监视无人机无法发送操作员所需的视频，然而操作员的问题往往与像素无关：三个人是否聚集、何时以及何地？我们研究在 1 Mbps 直至 1 kbps 的链路上，取而代之应该传输什么，以及以什么顺序传输。BPS 是一种行为基元流，先发送语义，后发送像素：它在机上运行检测器和跟踪器，并在位置和图像之前发送由 16-125 字节的任务卡选择的多帧事件的短记录（平均 25 字节）。我们在预注册协议下，使用留出集，通过地面侧语言模型据此回答的内容来衡量它，并与同一模型视觉微调所读取的 H.265、地面运行我们自身感知的 H.265、量化轨迹流以及机上字幕进行比较。在开发集上（84% 的问题关于聚集，且大多为一个地点），事件流在 0.13 kbps 下回答了 74.3% 的问题。什么都不接收的读取器回答 57.4%，视频读取器在 100 kbps 下回答 59.6%，在源帧上回答 64.7%。当地面改为对视频运行我们的感知时，视频在 100 kbps（约为该流率的 800 倍）下与事件流相当，并在 64 kbps 及以下落后。轨迹流以 96 倍的字节量与之相当，并在 17 倍字节量时低 0.03。在留出数据上结果较弱：当事件取自标注轨迹（一种预言机）时，该流在 100 kbps 下优于 H.265（+0.13），但在使用机上感知时并非如此（+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]），并且并不比什么都不接收更好。单独通过仿真链路发送时，事件记录在 1 Mbps 下回答 0.739，在 0.3 kbps 下仍有 0.724；每帧轨迹流可维持到 1 kbps，而带地面侧感知的视频可维持到约 100 kbps。在 Jetson Orin Nano 上，未改动的流水线以 4.5 fps 运行，并漏掉大多数事件。
